speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are really classic.

Then there are the covered headlights that came from
the DB5 reflecting the fashion at the time.

The tail fin-like design of the rear end
is quite American in style...

But then this was an era where Italian design was
influenced by American motorcars.

It's this classic feel combined with modern
details that give the DB5 its character.

It really is one of the most unique cars from the
DB series.

Of course it became famous because of James Bond,
but it remains a classic in its own right.
zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。

从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。

尾部的立鳍设计很有美式腔调……

那个时代的意大利也正受到美国车型设计的影响。

经典氛围和现代化细节造就了DB5的个性。

它是DB系列中最为独特的一款车，

虽说成为“邦德”车令它名声大噪，但它本身也不失为一
款经典车型。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.

Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.

It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.
zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是Gran Turismo当中比较受欢迎的一款R34 Skyline……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款能作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。

在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。

但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。

这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！

它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。

只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，

还分成了“M001” Carrera Cup版本、“M002” RS Touring版
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。

对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.

The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!

The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!]
zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，

但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。

换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！

它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。

有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。

名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。

说句真心话，它离我心目中的完美汽车越来越近了！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himse�f.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!
zh:
这是一辆让人热血沸腾的车！

当你从某个特定角度看它的时候，它的线条以一颗轮胎
为始，以另一颗轮胎为终。它的座舱占据了大约车身的1/2。

车辆肩线的高度完全由悬挂的行程决定……座舱后半部
分的重量正落在驱动轮上，

产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧
面弧线流动……

带着庞大的推力径直冲向长长的车头！

它有破竹的清澈，更有清溪的纯净，简洁的设计带有经
典的日本风韵。

仿佛结合了天使的大胆以及魔鬼的邪恶细节。

“魂动”设计的巅峰，就在此刻，此处！

像这样横空出世般的赛车版本……

可能与广岛工厂的设计总监本身就是一名赛车手有关。

噢，我已经迫不及待想听听它的转子引�(�轰鸣的声音了！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the world.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.
zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……

你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。

在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受到了全球车迷
的喜爱。

当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，

那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The A80 Supra...

...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.

With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin,
it has a proper greenhouse.

And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...

...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!

The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.

The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.

The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.
zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……

这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。

环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。

这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，

变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。

简洁的车型与Castrol的涂装相得益彰。

原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。

再加上80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！<next id=2000306 type=

car: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Notice how the tires are positioned far out at the corners,
while the cabin tapers gracefully toward the rear.

It’s a winning combination, wouldn’t you agree?

The design conveys a remarkable sense of genuine agility,
no matter the vehicle’s height.

It's a type of beauty that is common with cars like
the Honda CR-Z.

Front-end designs of recent Toyotas are fairly aggressive
looking even unmodified.

In this case, they've taken that and run with it, for the
kind of car a real gearhead would appreciate.

The expression of the fascia isn't bad, but it's disappointing
that it reminds you of an older Peugeot from afar.

The car is packed with good things so it would be nice if the
model sticks and is loved on the streets for a long time.

It makes you want to see a different model like the Renault R5
Turbo where an adult could dress up and drive it in style.<next id=2000406 type=9ԙ
zh:
你看，轮胎被远远地放在四角，座舱自然向后收窄，

这就叫强强联合，你说对不对？

即便车身高度很高，依然给人以灵活的感觉。

这种美感在诸如本田CR-Z等车型中相当常见。

最近几年的丰田在车身前部设计方面相当具有侵略性。

在这一台上也是如此，而且绝对能让真正的爱车人
满心欢喜。

前饰板的设计不算太坏，但还是有点令人失望。
从远处看，它会让你想起标致的老爷车。

丰田在这款车里塞进了很多不错的特性，
希望普罗大众会喜欢它吧，让它证明自己……

我很高兴能看到一台跟雷诺R5涡轮增压版同类型的其他车型
出现在市场上，成为成熟车手的心头好。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Historically, many road cars that served as the basis
for rally machines have been especially appealing.

Cars like the Mini Cooper S, Audi quattro
and Lancia Delta...

...all began as practical, utility-focused family cars.

Yet beneath that everyday form, they carried
serious performance potential.

Of course, a true rally car could not be driven on public roads.

From a design standpoint, the challenge was to express that
expanded capability within the framework of a road car.

The Evo V introduced larger wheels with pronounced overfenders.

It gave the traditional three-box sedan
the stance of a performance machine.

Combined with signature rally elements such as large
fog lights and a prominent rear wing...

...it completed the purposeful yet refined design of the
second-generation Lancer Evolution.
zh:
从历史上看，许多被用作拉力赛车改装原型的公路车都
非常有吸引力。

我指的是像迷你Cooper S、奥迪quattro和
蓝旗亚Delta这样的车……

这些都是以家庭用车为目的，讲究实用性的车型。

它们就仿佛是栖息在城市中的动物。

当然了，真正的拉力赛车都是禁止在街道上驾驶的。

因此在设计方面，重点在于如何在公路车的框架内表达扩展的远景。

Evo V采用了人们期待已久的大车轮，
为了搭配车轮，挡泥板的尺寸也相应拓展，

这台三厢轿车的底盘也由此换成了赛车底盘。

拉力赛车标志性的巨大雾灯和尾翼自然更不用提。

你可以认为，它就代表了第二代Lancer Evo的完整形态。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.

In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.

Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."

Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...

...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。

有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。

在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。

而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，

因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback
was this Supra.

In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried
to build a design identity for itself.

As if to keep denying its past, the company
continued to be the innovator.

And that in itself commands respect,
but the Celica is no more.

And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without
looking to the past, making a dazzling first appearance.

It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different
design direction successfully differentiated them.

The only thing that is a little disappointing...

...is that to effectively show the design of its body sides,
you want a little more width.

You just can't help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.
zh:
这辆Supra是丰田17年后卷土重来的真正跑车杰作。

从赛利卡变到Supra后，丰田并未尝试为它建立一个真正
的设计标识。

他们一直在追逐创新，仿佛是为了不断否定自己的过去。

赛利卡的确值得尊敬，但在Supra身上，你感受不到它的
一丝影子。

Supra无疑是在一块空白的画布上绘制的，在众人眼前
闪亮登场的它与过去的成就毫无牵连。

虽然和宝马Z4共享了相当多的部件，但两者的设计截
然不同，成功地将彼此区分开来。

唯一的小遗憾就是……

如果能加宽车体，就能更好地展示出车身两侧的设计。

我必须承认，它会让你不由自主地联想到那台永远停留
在概念里的丰田FT-1。<next id=2000706 type=9ۜ

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.

In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco,
named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.

These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.

Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.

This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly what you tell it to do.

But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!

Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.

It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.

You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.

Perhaps this reflects Řhe belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...

...just yet.*
zh:
看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。

在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。

这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。

这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。

这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。

当然了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！

拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。

这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。

你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。

也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_��自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平

……但是只是暂时没有而已。,

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.

In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.

And it shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.

It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.

The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.

This is how an American Sports car should be!
zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。

但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。

不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强大的牵引力。

这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。

Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂，

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from
the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.

A few of these elements have become something that is
unique to Porsche.

A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated
with the bumper's air intake opening.

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they
increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
zh:
997这款车带回了Porsche从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。

其中的一些升级最终成为了Porsche的标准元素。

这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。

这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.

It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner
to wish their car a goodnight.

I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore...
zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款Roadster成为永不褪
色的设计。

我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……

而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。

我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
There was this one time I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

And I thought to myself, 'Maybe its an owner of a Roadster?'
So I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas...

And found out that the happy couple had met at the club,
and that one had a red car while the other a white one.

Unfortunately I wasn't able to attend the wedding,

But a year later I received word that they had given birth
to a baby!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in Pink
and sent it to them.

Being able to connect with owners like this
is really gratifying for me as a designer.

It's the resut it wouldn’t be possible witho share the passion
of everybody who wo��ed on t�e �a��քext id=2100208 type=9>R
zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车

很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个宝
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。

可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。

如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The design is modified with larger grilles and sporty bumpers,
side skirts and 17-inch alloy wheels.

It also reflects the original vintage livery with red stripes and
other colored elements like the mirrors and brake calipers.

And the two large, enameled badges on the front and rear
show the original colors of the famous Scorpio logo.

But the most exciting thing...

...is the fantastic “sound design” coming from the
rear dual exhausts!
zh:
在升级方面，Abarth 500的设计采用了更大的格栅、运动型保
险杠、侧裙和17英寸铝合金轮毂。

而且还引入了象征原版复古涂装的红色条纹以及应用于
后视镜和刹车卡钳的其他色彩元素。

车前和车后两个精美无比的大型珐琅徽章展示了品牌原
版配色的著名天蝎座标志。

但最激动人心的……

当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.

But it is a great opportunity
for you to express your own creativity.

It would make a great custom project car,
with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point.

Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or...
...just use your own creative magic!
zh:
Nissan Silvia Spec-R是一款车身比例非常好的小型双门跑车，

也是你表达自己的创造力的绝好机会。

它非常适合改装。如果是我的话，会先从大车轮和拓宽
挡泥板入手。

然后把它涂成黑色底色，再添加更多色彩……

不过，可能还是你自己发挥创造力比较好！

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations,
both on its inside and outside.

It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedge-shaped.

This is evident in the clamshell bonnet
and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

The ZR-1 made use of much wider rear tyres and fenders.

The interior was very much inspired by aircraft design.

Some people say that the C4 Corvette lacks
the ‘soul’ of a Corvette.

But I happen to like it plenty.
zh:
C4 Corvette在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。

它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3 Corvette的
波浪状线条相去甚远。

其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。

ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……

以便驯服动力强劲的DOHC 4气门引擎。

其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。

很多人评论说C4 Corvette缺少了一点Corvette的魂。

但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is an icon of British sports cars in the 1960s.

It was an evolution model where they took the highly
regarded DB4 and raised its performance.

And Touring was the Carrozzeria who did the body for this car.
zh:
这是二十世纪六十年代标志性的英国跑车。

在备受推崇的DB4跑车基础上强化了性能。

这辆车的车身是由Carrozzeria Touring公司打造的。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The tuned inline-6 was much more powerful
than its rivals in its day.

And the car was quite simply sensual to drive.

This is the quintessential icon of Aston Martin, and of course,
the price is going nowhere but up!
>
zh:
经过调校后的直列6缸发动机比当时的所有对手都要更强。

这辆车开起来也很爽。

这辆车是Aston Martin的典型代表作，当然价格也是一
路水涨船高！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.

It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.

In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.

The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...

...producing over 100ps more than the standard model.

All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
zh:
这辆C4 Corvette ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。

它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。

事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。

这款车上装载了与Lotus公司一同研制的V8发动机动力强
劲、令人惊艳，

比标准版的动力提高了不止100ps。

我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The first-generation Viper was initially offered as
an open-top model.

That was the RT/10.

This GTS was introduced later as the coupe version.

The coupe’s structure improved rigidity,
which in turn enhanced handling.

Lamborghini was also involved in the development
of the V10 engine.

Viewed in that context, it was a remarkably cost-effective
performance car.
zh:
上市的第一代Viper首先推出的是敞篷车。

型号是“RT/10”吧。

这个GTS版本是改良后的双座跑车版本。

车身更加坚固，操纵感也更强。

Lamborghini也参与了它的V10发动机的研发。

如果从这个角度去想，这可是一辆性价比非常高的车。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Now this is a true icon—it can truly be said to
have changed the history of the racing car.

In addition to its really familiar styling, it's got a top
that can be folded down easily and a snug cockpit.

What's more, at the time of release, it was very
reasonably priced.

The market for convertible lightweight sports cars— those
ones that make you feel at one with your vehicle—

Well, it was virtually at the point of extinction.

This was the saviour which revived an entire genre of cars.
zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。

还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，

还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。

能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This car is based on the RX-VISION that was introduced at the
2015 Tokyo Motor Show.

It's powered by a 4-rotor engine, and you can immediately tell
from its shape that it's a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car.

This was the future vision of the rotary sports car.

And now, this RX-VISION was made into a race car.

The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4-rotor
rotary called the SKYACTIV-R.

The weight of the car is 1250kg, and it
produces 570ps.

It truly feels like the return of the legendary 787B
as a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive model!
$
zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。

它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。

在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。

而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。

引擎是被命名为SKYACTIV-R的四转子自然进气引擎。

整车重量为1250kg，引擎功率为570ps。

看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
With the arrival of the Evo V generation, the Lancer Evo
series' turning performance improved dramatically.

The body was made wider to accommodate the increased
tread width.

The tyres have 17 inch rims and Brembo
brake calipers come fitted as standard.

All in all, it's one of the greatest cars
to drive in the world.
zh:
Lancer Evo系列是从Evo V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。

车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，

而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了Brembo刹车卡钳。

我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。
-

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
'The Romance of Minus 21 Seconds'.

That was the advertising slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.

In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...

It shaved a full 21 seconds off the lap time of its
predecessor, the R32 GT-R.

It was a slogan that reflected all the effort that
had gone into the development of the R33 GT-R.

I think stories like that really add to this car's value.
zh:
缩短了21秒的浪漫”。

这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。

在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，

R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。

这条口号也反映出了Nissan为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。

我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.

Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.

In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。

埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。

这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，

并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。

这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
With a body as compact as the S13 two generations before it,

This car has a design that combines superb styling
with impeccable balance.

And being turbocharged, it produces a respectable 250ps.

It actually competed in Japan's GT Championships too.

It's also a great base car for drifting customisations,
meaning you get a lot of fun for your dollar.
zh:
随着Silvia重新回归两代之前，S13时期的紧凑车身设计，

整体造型变得集造型优美和完美匀称于一身。

涡轮增压则使这款车能够输出令人惊叹的250ps。

这辆车不仅作为赛车参加了全日本房车锦标赛，

同时也是漂移改装车的绝佳基础车型。可以这么说，
你付出的每一分价格都能带来无上的乐趣。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is a definitive Porsche—a sportscar that makes
absolutely no compromises.

After 2008, the 997 GT3 produced double the downforce
it previously did.

In addition, the engine and brakes were made
even more powerful.

Not only that, but it utilises an engine crankcase that
has been honed for racing since the air cooled days.

No question about it, this one's a real gem.
zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的Porsche跑车。

2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，

引擎功率和刹车也更加强大。

不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。

毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the 40mm lower ride height.

You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.

But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.

It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.

As a result, it's 120kg lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.

I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.
?
zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了40mm。

如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。

但是，令964型911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于

它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。

其结果便是高达120kg的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。

这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
It's fast, affordable, and manageable in size...

Truly this is one of the great commercial sportscars.

The 2nd generation MR2 that debuted in 1989 was
continually improved over the years.

This represents its pinnacle, with its power
ramped up to an impressive 245ps.

In spite of this, its handling remains remarkably
straightforward.

Truly this is a car where the price tag
doesn't reflect its true value.
zh:
价格在可承受的范围之内，尺寸可控且速度很快，

它确确实实是最好的量产跑车之一。

第二代MR2于1989年首次亮相，之后多年来一直在不断
改进。

这一台是系列的巅峰之作，功率提高到了令人心驰神往
的245ps，

操控方面也是相当直截了当。

就这辆车而言，其价值远大于售价，太划算了。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.

It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.

In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.

However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.

One reason was weight.

The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
5kg lighter than the Trueno.

In a car this light, an extra 5kg over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.
zh:
AE86最吸引人的要素朴实无华，就在于它的驾驶感。

这是一款操纵感极强的后驱双门轿车，给驾驶者带来非
常多的乐趣。

著名的日本漫画《头文字D》就将Levin的姐妹车Trueno
作为了主角车。

但在现实里，大部分人会更青睐Levin。

原因在于车重的差异。

配有固定头灯的Levin要比Trueno轻5kg。

在这么轻的车头上多出的5kg，会带来天差地别的影响。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.

It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.

The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.

With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。

它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。

这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。

兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。

car: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR Yaris是Toyota 100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。

碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，

引擎和四驱系统也是如此。

这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。

驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。

我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This car is the same. It has a powerful engine and is
extremely lightweight. It's also quick and agile.

It can go toe-to-toe with sports cars with twice
the price tag.

It's a true heir to the Abarth tradition.
zh:
这款车轻盈而敏捷，引擎动力充沛，

甚至能够和价格是自己两倍的跑车比拼速度。

它是Abarth传统的真正继承者。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
A Viper is a type of poisonous snake right?
It’s kind of fitting for the car's image.

Though I kinda think the face of the car
looks kinda cute in a way.

Wow, but when you sit in the driver's seat its hard to tell
where the front end of the car is...

But I guess that's because the engine is huge!
zh:
知道吗，Viper这个词其实是一种毒蛇的名字？用来
形容这款车倒是很贴切。

尽管我觉得这款车的前脸看上去还挺可爱的。

可是当你坐进驾驶室里的时候绝对会大吃一惊，因为你
很难看到这辆车的车头究竟在哪里……

我猜这是因为它的引擎实在太大了！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This is a famous car—I know this one!

I always think it’s so cute when I see one.

And I love how it looks when the headlights pop open!

There are lots of Mazda Roadster fans all around the world, right?

That’s another great thing about this car.
-
zh:
这是一款很有名的汽车，我认识的！
我一直觉得这辆车非常的可爱

……而且我还喜欢它的大灯翻起来的样子！

Mazda Roadster在全世界有很多粉丝对不对？

这是这款车另一个很酷的地方。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This car looks so beautiful no matter which angle
you look at it from.

I see, so it’s a special concept car of Mazda.

I mean, you can tell right away it’s a sportscar,
but its so elegant and attractive.

But the engine sound is a big surprise!

I didn't know engines could sound so crisp and clear!
zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。

我知道了！所以这是一辆Mazda的特别概念赛车！

我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。

可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！

我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.

And this is the fifth-generation version?

I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.

It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!

This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……

而且这是第五代车款了？

一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。

哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。

这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.

Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?

Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge
for the turbo.

With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。

嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？

哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。

像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
A GT3 is basically like a race car, right?

Or at least just as fast? That's what I heard.

It looks like any other Porsche at first glance, but people
who know can tell the difference, right?

It’s not flashy, but it drives like a true race car.

That’s seriously cool.
zh:
GT3其实是一辆赛车，是不是？还是说和赛车一样快？
我好像听说过它的。

在我看来这就像别的Porsche一样……
懂车的人才能分辨出来，是不是？

没有那么拉风，但开起来像真的赛车一样，非常酷！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Even I know this one—the Porsche 911 is famous.

I thought this would be a really expensive model.

But this RS doesn’t have much in the way of equipment.

I don’t even see a door handle.

Oh, you pull this red strap?

So it’s all to make the car lighter?

That’s pretty wild. They really went that far
to save weight.
zh:
就连我都知道这款车，Porsche 911太有名了。

我还以为这款车会非常非常贵，可是……这款RS上面
缺了好多的设备呀。

我甚至连门把手都没见着。
哦，你要拉这根红绳……
所以这都是为了让车更轻？
这也太疯狂了，他们居然会为了减重做这么极端的事。
?

car: Subaru Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Subaru Impreza?
It was really famous in motorsports too right?
And so this is the final version of the special models?
'The most refined and rare…'
You really like this car huh.
zh:
Subaru Impreza在赛车圈里相当有名对不对？
而且这台是这款特殊车型的最终版？
“最精致且最罕见的……”
那你真的很喜欢这辆车哈。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
I've seen this car in the movie 'The Fast and the Furious'!
It's the Toyota Supra right?
The 'Supra' letters look like it was written
with a Japanese brush.

I am right? I thought so!
So they really wrote it like in Japanese calligraphy.
zh:
我在《速度与激情》里见过这款车！
这是Toyota Supra，对不对？
字母Supra就像是用日本的毛笔写的。

我说对了？我就说嘛。他们写的真的是日本书法。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
It looks like a really compact supercar.
It's smooth and looks really cool.

So the engine is in the back? It’s a two seater
and pretty tight inside.

Wow but its got a pretty decent sized boot,
not bad!
zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。

所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。

哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！

car: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.

Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.

I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.

It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。

噢，原来是这样。这辆GR Yaris是专为赛车运动而生的。

它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。

而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
I thought this was a FIAT 500 at first,
but this car's called an Abarth?

It's still just as cute,
and the engine sounds amazing!

The Scorpion emblem adds a touch of class as well.

It traces back to the company's founder who was born
under the Scorpio zodiac sign. That's really cool!
zh:
所以我一开始还以为这就是辆FIAT 500，可它的名字叫Abarth？

我觉得这辆车也挺可爱的，
不过引擎的声音太了不得了！
蝎子车标也很有品味，好经典。

所以说，用这个标志是因为创始人是天蝎座的啊！
这真的是太酷了。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...

...this car competed in the eighth round of the
Nürburgring Endurance Series.

It qualified 2nd and finished 5th overall in the race—
an impressive result right out of the box.

As it had not yet been commercially released,
it entered the SPX class for test cars.

The R8 LMS Evo demonstrated its potential from
the very beginning.

It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series
around the world.
'
zh:
在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！

它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？

因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。

总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。

之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?

It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers,
one amateur and one pro.

For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a
Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.

The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.

This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.

Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
machine is quite something.
zh:
你听说过德国ADAC GT大师赛？

这是一场需要两位车手：一位新人车手、一位资深车手
交替参赛的比赛。

在2016年的ADAC大师赛中，Chevrolet派出了Corvette C7 FIA-GT3。

在之后一年，他们同时拿下了车手和车队总冠军。

这台车不仅操控平易近人，适合新手，又能经受住专业
选手的“折磨”。

可以肯定，Corvette C7 Gr.3在性能方面很有一套。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the years
But when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...
...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!
It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.
And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.
The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.
But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
zh:
你知道么？Lamborghini作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。

但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款FIA-GT3，

终于把它们的车送上了赛道！

它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，

就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺得了冠军。

实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。

但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.

At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.

So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."

It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.

And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.

It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...

...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。

为此，Nissan特别打造了一辆双门版的Nissan NISMO GT-R LM，

在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，

这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。

由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三

让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.

It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.

Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...

...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.

Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.

Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?

That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).

It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！

这是参加过1999年全日本GT锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！

驾驶23号Pennzoil的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，

艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。

对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？

有很多Nissan的超级跑车都是23号对不对？
但第一辆使用23作为号码的……

没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Ah, so this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring
24 Hour race just a month after it went on sale...

Did you know the driver for the first stint of the final was none
other than Toyota President, Akio 'Morizo' Toyoda?

Basically, the man who brought the GR Supra to life!

The car was basically the retail model, with the bare
minimum safety equipment needed to race.

Still, it managed to claim 41st place overall,
and was third in its class.

It totally showed how good a performer
the GR Supra really is.
+
zh:
所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……

你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是Toyota的总裁丰田章男吗？

事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！

这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，
只配备了比赛所需的最低限度安全设备，

但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。

这样的成绩完全显示出了GR Supra的卓越性能。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.

The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.

Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had won the series.

That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the season...

In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out
on top in the historic 1997 season.
zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。

这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！

甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。

因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！

而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！

car: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated
the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.

Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.

In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！

他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。

不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is
very close to my heart.

My intent was to be
"absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.

My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with
Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...

...into the belt-line with the fender arches repeating
the motion.

The upper spear-line served to shave
the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that also communicates
"quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!

The low, round "chopped" roof sits on top of the lower fuselage
as a separate visual element similar to the 550 LeMans Coupe.

The interior designed in collaboration with Romulus Rost
is just as absolute and pure!

I still can't believe Audi produced the TT!^
zh:
我对初代奥迪TT轿跑的设计
仍记忆犹新！

我当时的整体设计理念是
“绝对”和“纯粹”。

TT的灵感来自于

艾尔文·柯曼达的356 Speedster和550勒芒轿跑，

以及艾可拉·斯帕达的
吉里耶塔 SZ “圆尾”轿跑。短小的圆拱形车头和车尾

，其形状一直延续至车腰，连挡泥板也沿用这一几何形状。

车体上部的线条起到了
削修表面、避免反光、

连接头灯/尾灯形状的作用。

这种将前后轮连接起来的视觉效果，
还传达出了“四驱”的能量！

低矮的圆拱形车顶直接坐落在下车身上，
创造出了一个独立的，类似550勒芒轿跑的视觉元素。

与罗穆卢斯·罗斯特合作设计的内饰
也同�绝对和纯粹！

我仍然不敢相信奥迪真的把TT生产了出来！~

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.

The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer
Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy
of FIAT for many, many years.

At under 3m in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly
fit four people thanks to a space-saving rear-engine.

It is celebrated to this day for its undeniable charm.

You can see where the modern FIAT 500
got its good looks from!
zh:
这款稀世珍品诠释了意大利汽车制造业的外在之美。

FIAT 500于1957年问世。

被认为是极富传奇色彩的FIAT汽车设计大师但特·吉奥科萨的
代表作之一，这款车型久盛不衰，是永恒的经典。

吉奥科萨为FIAT设计多年，留下许多非凡的作品。

这款车总长不到3m，是紧凑型汽车，但由于
配置了省空间的后置引擎，因此可以容纳4人。

这款车的魅力毋庸置疑，因而久负盛名……

我们一眼就能看出具备现代感的
FIAT 500外观有多吸睛！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.

Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…

...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."

Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.

Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。
这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……

由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。

Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……

从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is a first-generation Honda Civic Type R.

What's really special about this car is its specially-tuned
1.6L naturally-aspirated straight-four engine.

Just wait till you hear its thrilling roar and exhaust note—
you'll think you're driving a genuine racing car!

The effect is really amazing, especially when you go
from the 6000rpm to over 8000rpm.

Since it was based on a front-wheel drive car, the Type R
was originally marketed at an affordable price.

But nowadays its value has been reassessed
owing to its exceptional performance.
zh:
这是第一代Honda Civic Type R。

这款车的独到之处在于配备专门调校过的
1.6L自然吸气直列四缸引擎。

当你听到这辆车亢奋的引擎声和排气声时，你会以为
自己在开一辆真正的赛车！

具备惊人的性能，特别是从6000rpm
加速到8000rpm以上时，效果更为震撼。

Type R是前轮驱动的车款，因此起初的定价相当实惠。

但如今，由于其优异的性能，所以已经重新定价了。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used in the base model...

...producing 20ps more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than 40kg in weight reduction.

It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive
engineering.
zh:
不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。
完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。

第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说
并非不可接受……

因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型，
用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。

其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型
更加强劲有力。

因此在功率上提升了20ps。

形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了40kg以上的整体车重上。

这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。

1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。

直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。

Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
When it comes to speedy little road rockets,
the first thing that comes to mind is this Mini.

Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the
masses, it possessed a high level of performance.

The first to notice the Mini’s potential was the car
constructor Cooper, of Formula 1 fame.

That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.

The car shined in in races and rallies of the day,
leaving behind a lasting legacy.

This model, with an improved engine displacement of 970cc,
is especially prized within the series.
zh:
说到小而快的车型，首先想到的就是这款Mini。

尽管最初的英国Mini可能是定位于紧凑型民用车，
但其性能仍然不可小觑。

首先注意到Mini潜力的是天才汽车工程师Cooper，
对，就是以F1闻名的传奇人物。

他的团队是这款运动型Mini Cooper S的
幕后推手。

这款车在竞赛和拉力赛中取得的光辉战绩，
成就了一代传奇。

这款车型引擎排量提升高达970cc，
是该系列中弥足珍惜的一款。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel drive chassis...

And a peppy 1.8L straight-four engine—this S13 Silvia
is one well-balanced FR sports car.

Not only does it strike an elegant pose when parked, but it
looks great tearing around a corner, too!

Nowadays, these cars are really something special.
In fact, the S13's best qualities are priceless!
zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……

加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。

不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。

现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.

This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.

Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.

On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.

In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.
zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……

这款Peugeot Sport精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。

精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……

即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。

老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American
sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.

One look at this exceptional seventh-generation model
just might entice you to shout "Mustangs rule!"

Incorporating the essence of its predecessors...

...it boasts a proud lineage without relying too heavily
on retro design cues.

The star of the show is undoubtedly the
the V-8 engine found in this GT.

For a car with so much power, it came with an
astonishingly reasonable price tag.
zh:
自1964年上市以来，Ford Mustang一直被誉为是
美国跑车的一代传奇。

只要你看到这款卓尔不群的第七代车型，
你一定会欢呼“Mustang！”

凝聚了之前历代车型中的精髓……

从骨子里就流淌着厚重的历史底蕴，
不需要刻意攀附浮夸的复古风。

毋庸置疑，这款GT车继续搭载最优良的
V8引擎。

对于一款充满肌肉感的跑车而言，
其价格确实相当公道。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The sixth-generation Camaros were well-built machines,
especially this SS-grade make.

It is equipped with the same 6.2L LT1 engine that was first
introduced in the Corvette.

The handling is nothing short of exceptional, and should
make winding roads a truly thrilling experience.

Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
zh:
第六代Camaros工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。

这款车搭载了6.2L LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于Corvette车型上。

其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。

坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted for generations.
zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。

第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。

不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。

这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.

Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06, the ZL1 is capable of
an output of over 650ps.

What’s more, this '1LE Package' has been outfitted
for track performance needs.

Incredibly, it completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!

That's a super-car-level time, mind you!

And yet it's about 1/3 the price of your average super car,
meaning it offers more bang for your buck!
zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的Camaro车型了。

ZL1搭载的引擎来自Corvette Z06，能产生超过650ps的功率。

配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。

令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！

要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！

然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.

The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.

It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.

At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but
those in the know will tell you otherwise.

Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.

Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can
expect their prices will increase with time.
zh:
哦，一辆BMW M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。

这款“Sport Evolution”是最终型号，备受欢迎。

这款车的特点是升级过的2.5L引擎以及尾部扰流板。

乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。

呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……

这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.

Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into
its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！

从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。

1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。

辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged
4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.

It's affectionately known as the "Evo."

The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to
their stellar performance at world rally championships.

Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a
world rally competition since 2005...

...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.

Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was
the last production car to be produced of the series.

It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting
an astounding 313ps.

You can bet that its value on the international market
will only continue to appreciate with time.
zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。

车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……

由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。

虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……

但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。

回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。

这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的313ps。

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.

Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.

At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.

What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。

这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。

在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。

更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car
can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!

This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was
simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.

The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选BMW M3系列肯定没错！

这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……

产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。

这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。

E46也展现出了BMW跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。

可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.

First and foremost, it's impressively light,
weighing a mere 895kg!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design
trends of the 2010s.

Its innovative carbon-fiber body really
paid off in this respect.

Although powered by a small turbocharged 1.8-liter engine, the
car's lightweight nature made it accelerate like a super car.

Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions
made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic
Tipo 33 Stradale.
zh:
4C这款车极具魅力……

首先，它轻巧之极，整车仅重895kg
，令人印象深刻！

考虑到2010年那时的设计趋势，
这是相当让人惊愕的。

创新的碳纤维车身，
对轻量化有极大帮助。

虽然只搭载了1.8L涡轮引擎，但轻盈的车身
让这辆车能飙出超跑的速度。

此外，中置引擎的跑车设计
确实令人耳目一新。

这样的设计，是在向Alfa Romeo史上具有
非凡意义的Tipo 33 Stradale致敬。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.

Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.

What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.

From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.

Although it employs an FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.

The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.

While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the wheel and drive it!
zh:
这款车是Alfa Romeo史上最富传奇色彩的作品之一。

Alfa Romeo曾专注于制造赛车和高级GT车型。

这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。

这款车从称谓到款式，无一不唤起人们对
Alfa Romemo在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。

虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……

采用跨轴布局，目的是改善重量分布。

不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Now, this is a true icon! A modern take
on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.

In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful
race cars that played a big role at Le Mans in the 1960s.

Under the sheet metal, however, it was completely revamped,
with an innovative aluminum space frame.

Also, in a brilliant move, it combined a supercharged
mid-mounted V8 engine...

...with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

Honestly, I can't imagine the value of this beauty
ever going down.
zh:
现在这款车可以说是真的经典！
因勒芒耐力赛而闻名的现代版Ford GT40……

为庆祝Ford成立100周年而制造。

从设计上来看，令人回忆起那些在20世纪60年代
大放异彩的赛车。

至于内装，则完全改头换面，
采用全新研发的铝制空间车架。

这款车另一项高明的设计是搭载
中置V8机械增压引擎……

并配备六速手动变速箱。

坦白说，我觉得这款尤物的价值
不可能下降。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.

The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than 400ps.

Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
zh:
Ford的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。

Raptor是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。

它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。

Raptor不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出400ps以上的6.2升V8引擎。

只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.

If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.

And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…

...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.

Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.

You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.

If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
zh:
这是一台第七代Corvette——
简称“C7”。

如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。

1953年是初代Corvette诞生的年份……

这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。

C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。

用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。

要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of 300ps.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires, giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。

Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了300ps。

由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！

这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.

It's known as a "homologation model," meaning
it was developed primarily as a race car.

Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed
various mechanical upgrades.

These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts for naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.

As a result, the Turbo A produced 30ps more
than the base model.

With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.

Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.

However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.
zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……

这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。

丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。

为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。

这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。

这些升级使这辆车的马力比基础车型提高了30ps。

由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。

除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。

然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.

This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.

And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!

Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame.

Under the hood is a naturally-aspirated V-8 that
produces 571ps.

It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.

This allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced through corners.

As the successor to the 300 SL, one can only imagine that
its value will continue to rise.
zh:
300 SL在上世纪五十年代亮相时
被认为是梅赛德斯-奔驰的工程杰作。

这辆SLS AMG将那辆口碑载道的传奇带回到了21世纪。

它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！

这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。

它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，
能够输出571ps的强大动力。

尽管这辆车采用了前置后驱布局，但其变速箱
位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。

这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，
从而改善了这辆车在直线和弯道上性能！

作为300 SL的后继者，这辆车的价值
肯定会水涨船高吧。

car: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R is the quintessential
Japanese sports car.

Among its many iterations, this R34
is particularly popular.

Not only does it sport the famed RB26DETT engine,
but it was also the final version of the model.

This limited-edition final production model...

...called the V-Spec II Nür features an extremely
balanced engine.

It remains one of the crown jewel of all Skyline GT-Rs.
zh:
Nissan Skyline GT-R是日本跑车的代表作。

在这个车系众多的车型中，R34型尤其受欢迎。

这辆车不仅搭载了一台备受赞誉的RB26DETT引擎，
它还是这款车的终极形态……

一辆限量版最终生产型……

这辆V·Spec II Nür不仅引擎更加平衡……

它更是被视作Skyline GT-R皇冠上的明珠。

car: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.

The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.

The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.

A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.

When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!

This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
zh:
这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。

这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。

他毕业于东大汽车工程系。

R34是R33的后继车型。

渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已……

他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。

由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了
当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。

当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时……

他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。

您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上
跑出了7:59的单圈时间！

比R32的记录快了21秒。

当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。

car: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.

It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.

The course measures 20km, climbing 1440m to the finish
at 4302m—higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!

This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.

Based on a WRC machine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.

But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"

Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!
zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。

这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。

这条赛道长达20km，海拔始于1440m，终于4302m——比日本的富士山还要高！

这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。

基于一辆世界拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。

那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？

这个人正是世界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.

Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!

But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.

People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of podium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.

This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.
zh:
Audi在1999年首次亮相勒芒。

一直到2016年，Audi在LMP1级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。

事实上，Audi已经连续18年登上领奖台了！

但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。

大家都觉得Audi今年登台无望了。

然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的丰田出现了机械故障！

这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。

最终，由于Audi宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录也就此终结。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.

So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.

This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.

The 4-rotor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.

It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.

Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...

...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable
to make the podium.

As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!
zh:
转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！

他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。

这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年，它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。

不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。

赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑500km！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Porsche has contributed greatly to motorsport over the
years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.

Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is
the sports prototype class...

It entered races as a factory team while also
selling its race cars to privateers.

Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race
culture is an integral part of its legacy.

This is evidenced by the history of the 956 and 962,
two Group C models from the early 1980s.

Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition
in 1988...

...the cars continued racing for private teams.

It's said that Porsche manufactured 150 examples
of the 956 and 962 for competition.
*
zh:
多年来，Porsche作为制造商和私人销售商，
对汽车运动做出了巨大贡献。

即使在参与世界上最快的赛事，运动原型赛事的同时……

他们在把赛车卖给私人的同时，还在运营着一支工厂队伍。

事实上，保时捷对赛车文化的广泛支持已经成了其遗产的一部。

这一点可以从956和962这两款
80年代初的C组别车型的历史中看出来。

虽然962的工厂队伍在1988年退出了竞技舞台……

私人车队却仍然在使用那些车竞赛。

据说，在Porsche的赛车生涯期间，
他们一共生产了150辆956和962。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?

It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.

There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...

...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.

However, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.

In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.

Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.

This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。

听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？

毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。

实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。

这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……

那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。

然而，继承GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！

2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。

因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。

作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This Lexus RC F competes in Japan's top racing category,
Super GT.

It made it debut in...2014, I think.

This one is the 2016 spec. I have fond memories of seeing
it in action!

It lost the first four races to the Nissan GT-R, but then
made a stunning comeback after changing the engine!

By the end of the season, it had managed to claw its way up
to fifth place in the rankings.

As it happens, that season's championship was won by another
RC F, number 39!
zh:
这辆Lexus RC F参加了日本的顶级赛事Super GT。

这款车应该是在……2014年首次亮相的。

这辆车是2016年的型号。它在赛场上驰骋的样子仍能令我心潮澎湃！

这辆车在前四场比赛中输给了Nissan GT-R，
但在更换引擎之后，它上演了一场惊人的反击战！

在赛季结束时，它已经成功地爬到了第五的位置。

碰巧的是，该赛季的冠军是由另一辆车号为39的RC F赢得的！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!

It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.

It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.

It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.

These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win ithird series champion in a row.

The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...

However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.

This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.

The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.

The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie �uintarelli.

They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!
zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。

从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。

它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……

在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！

在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了。

在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……

但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。

这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。

他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！

不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！

他们俩现在�8�已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！
,

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
I don't care what anyone else says, I think this is the
world's most beautiful race car!

I just can't get enough of that bodywork, especially the
wheelhouses and fenders.

It's not just a nice looking car, though.

It won the 24 Hours of Daytona on its first try in 1967.

In fact, the 330 P4 occupied
all the podium positions.

Seeing three 330 P4s cross the finish line together...
well, that was enough to bring a tear to my eye.

The 330 P4 won the 1000 Kilometers
of Monza that same year as well!

Formula 1 drivers Lorenzo Bandini and Mike Parkes
piloted the Ferrari in that race.

The car was then entered in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

But defending champion Ford still proved dominant,
and the 330 P4 came in 2nd place.

The Ford GT40 that won at Le Mans �hat year is also
a beautiful car.

But for me, nothing comes close to the 330 P4.
Viva Ferrari!
*
zh:
我不管其他人怎么看，反正我就觉得
这辆车就是世界上最好看的赛车！

这些曲线我不管看多少遍都看不腻。
瞧瞧这轮拱罩和挡泥板！

而且这辆车不仅是好看！

它在1967年亮相时就赢得了戴通纳24小时耐力赛！

实际上，为了展现硬实力，这款车直接霸占了整座领奖台！

想象一下三辆330 P4一同跨过终点线的景象……
简直要让我感动到哭了！

就在同一年，330 P4还赢得了蒙扎1000km的冠军！

一级方程式车手洛伦佐·班迪尼和迈克·帕克斯
都曾代表法拉利参赛。

330 P4还参加过勒芒耐力赛……

但是福特的数量优势实在太大，所以330 P4只得了第二名。

那辆在勒芒夺冠的福特GT40�$是一辆优美的车子……

但对我而言，330 P4才是我心中永远的神。
法拉利万岁！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with the same result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.

It was an overwhelming show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Mans title for Ford,
finally putting an end to Ferrari's run.
zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。

1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……

1966年，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。

那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地在那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.

This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.

It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of British fans.

But they first had to endure a stressful race.

It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends a chill down my spine.
zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。

那年，大批来自英国的Jaguar车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！

而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……

他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。

萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！

那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。

那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”
i

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.

This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!

Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.

It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
zh:
一辆久经战阵的McLaren F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……

这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……

并于1995年首次在勒芒参赛，然后赢得了比赛！

顺便一说，那辆获胜的McLaren F1 GTR是由前F1车手JJ尼赫托和……

日本车手关谷正德驾驶的。

那是日本车手首次在勒芒夺冠！

而且，在那个萨森赛车场的雨夜里，他是车队里最快的车手！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...

Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.

It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.

It won its class there, and finished in a very impressive
2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!

This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.

AMG would go on to play a key role in Mercedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。

AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。

它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，

它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总成绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。

这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。

在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.

It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.

One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.

He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.

It's amusing to hear seasoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
zh:
Renault是一家热爱竞技的公司。

他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。

他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的Alpine。

而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。

作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。

他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。

这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。

听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，

设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。

不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。

雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.

It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.

And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...

...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!

The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Haruhito Yanagida.

The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.

And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.

The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。

当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。

面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……

一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！

这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人。

在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……

最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！

这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Tour de Corse?

Well, it's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.

The 1964 Tour de Corse was a particular classic.

Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!

What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed first, third,
fourth and fifth place!

It was quite the remarkable achievement.

Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally, established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.

The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。

1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！

而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。

Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。
;

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Are you familiar with the WRC?

It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally
races that take place on a variety of road surfaces.

It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in
various countries were unified.

The new international race series was christened the
World Rally Championship, and the rest is history.

This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first
WRC series.

Its compact body came with an 1800cc engine mounted
at the rear, ensuring excellent traction.

The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in
Monte Carlo.

In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places,
defeating entries form Porsche and Lancia.

The car now occupies a page in the history books as the car
that won the first WRC race and series.
]
zh:
你对世界拉力锦标赛熟悉吗？

在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。

它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。

这就是世界拉力锦标赛的开端，并延续至今。

这一辆阿尔派A110正是第一届世界拉力锦标赛的冠军。

它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力。

它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。

事实上，阿尔派A110一路上击败了保时捷和蓝旗亚，
包揽了领奖台！

A110就此踏上了赢得世界拉力锦标赛首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成巨大的轰动效应！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
For drift fans, this car is instantly recognizeable as Dai's car.

Daijiro Yoshihara is a Japanese race driver who
specializes in drifting.

He was the series champion of the 2011 Formula DRIFT
Championship Series.
