For the 2018 season, his car was this one,
based on the Subaru BRZ.

It packed a turbocharged 7.8-liter V-8 under the hood.

The engine produced a massive 1000ps of power!

Unfortunately, it didn't carry him to the
championship that year.

Still, the BRZ was impressive nontheless.
zh:
提到这辆车，人们就会联想起吉原大！

吉原大二郎是一位日本赛车手，专业从事漂移运动。

他是2011年漂移方程式锦标赛系列赛的冠军。

后来，他驾驶一辆基于Subaru BRZ的赛车继
续参加了2018年的系列赛。

在车辆的引擎盖下安装的是一台7.8L V8涡轮增压引擎。

能够产生1000ps的巨大动力！

虽然这台引擎并不足以让他赢得冠军，

但是，BRZ+V8仍然是一个令人振奋不已的组合！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.

The first time the development drivers encountered the 86,
it was nothing special.

As such, one of them noted that 'we realised we had to
rebuild the car from scratch'.

The retail and race spec versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time...

And the racing car was entered into races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The experiences from those races were used to improve the
retail car—and that's the 86 you see before you.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as
the 'ultimate 86'!
zh:
Toyota86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。

开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。

其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新
打造这辆车”。

86的零售和比赛规格版本的开发是同期进行的……

赛车版被用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。

通过比赛积累的经验又被用来改进零售版——也就是你
面前的这台86。

事实上，开发人员最终将这款车称为“终极86”！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.

While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.

There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche team couldn't believe its luck.

In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。

在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。

不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.

I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.

If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...

...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.

The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.

Ukiya broke his fender in a collision early in the race,
dropping him to 16th place.

After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!

There was something almost divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！

如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。

在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩

他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.

Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.

It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.

And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.
zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！

一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达1600km的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。

这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。

Toyota公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。

此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？

2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Do you know when Aston Martin started participating in
international races?

It was way back in the 1920s!

They also competed at Le Mans until the 1950s, but the marque
then took a long break from motorsports after that.

In fact, they were absent from the racing scene for 30 years,
until it returned in 2005.

It was a triumphant return as well, with Aston Martin
claiming victory at Sebring.

The winning car that day was a DBR9 GT1. Beautiful, isn't it?

It would prove to be the start of a nice run for
the DBR9.

In 2007, it was the first Aston Martin to finish in the top five
at Le Mans in 48 years. It also won the GT1 class.

Six Aston Martins entered Le Mans that year.

All six cars finished the race, showing that they had
reliability as well as speed.

It was defini�ely good to have Aston Martin's cars back in
racing and to see them perform so well!

At the 2008 Le Mans race, a DBR9 was entered wearing
the legendary Gulf Oil livery.

It beat the Chevrolet Corvette to claim the GT1 class
for the second straight year.
zh:
你知道阿斯顿马丁是从什么时候开始参加国际比赛的吗？

那要追溯到20世纪20年代！

而在勒芒，他们的比赛历史一直持续到了20世纪50年代。
在那之后，他们做出了长期诀别赛车运动的决定。

当他们在2005年重返赛车运动时，已经是阔别赛场的
30年后了。

阿斯顿马丁在他们回归的第一场比赛中就在赛百灵赛
道获得了胜利，为这次回归奏响了凯旋之歌！

当天获胜的赛车是一辆DBR9 GT1。它很美吧？

这场比赛是DBR9写下壮丽篇章的开端。

2007年，它成为48年来第一辆在勒芒比赛中跻身前五的
阿斯顿马丁！它还赢得了GT1级别的冠军。

那年共有六辆阿斯顿马丁参加了勒芒比赛。

所有车辆都完成了比赛，为其可靠性和�;�度做出证明。

也因此，阿斯顿马丁迅速找回他们对赛车的热情就不奇怪了！

在2008年的勒芒比赛中，一辆DBR9以传奇的海湾石油
涂装参赛。

它击败了强劲对手雪佛兰科尔维特，连续第二年赢得
了GT1级别的冠军！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Toyota Prius is arguably the most popular Japanese
hybrid car.

And when it comes to subcompacts, the most popular
could well be the Toyota Aqua.

Outside of Japan, the Aqua is marketed as the "Prius C."

But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself.
Are you familiar with the term "hybrid car?"
zh:
Toyota Prius是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。

而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，
那最著名的要属Toyota Aqua了。

在日本以外，Aqua被称为“Prius C”。

但是等等——也许我忽略了一点。
你熟悉“混合动力汽车”这个概念吗？

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Oh great! It's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.

By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
zh:
太棒了！这是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。

通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Well, it's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.

By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
zh:
好吧，它是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。

通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Honda Fit is one of Japan's most popular compact cars.

By the time this third-generation model made its debut in 2013,
2,000,000 units had been sold in Japan alone!

It is a perennial bestseller.

From this model on, the Fit Hybrid began featuring
a more powerful engine.

Which reminds me, have you heard of the Civic?
It's another Honda compact car.

Like the Fit, the Civic is a front-wheel-drive
compact.

And it drives just like a sports car!
zh:
Honda Fit是日本最著名的紧凑型汽车之一。

到2013年第三代车型首次亮相时，仅在日本就
卖出了200万台！

它是一款常青畅销的车型！

从这个车型开始，Fit Hybrid开始配备更强大的引擎。

这让我想起了另一台车——你知道 “Civic”吗？
也是Honda的紧凑型车。

与Fit一样，老款Civic是一款前轮驱动的紧凑型车......

但它开起来就像一辆跑车！
\

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.

It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.

So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.

Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...

...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.

I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
zh:
这款Demio是Mazda对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。

实际上它在日本以外被称为“Mazda2”......

以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！

Mazda旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......

也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。

我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
zh:
当Mini于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。

此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

Mini的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911
have some common linkages?

The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche,
the founder of Porsche Automobiles.

It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the
car that drives the rear wheels...

Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!

Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to
the first Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...

...and later the Porsche 911.

What started out as a small people's car
ended up as a genuine sports car.

While there may be a world of difference
between the two...

...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine,
RR-layout and the same creator is truly fascinating!
zh:
你知道大众甲壳虫和保时捷911之间有一些
共同的联系吗？

甲壳虫是由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的，他同时也是
保时捷汽车的创始人。

甲壳虫的车身后部配置了一台水平对置引擎，用于驱动后轮……

这使它成为了名副其实的后置引擎、后轮驱动车型！

保时捷博士后来将甲壳虫的设计元素应用到了第一辆保时捷跑车，
保时捷356……

以及后来的保时捷911上。

可以这么说，最初的小型民用汽车设计最终却变成了真正的跑车。

虽然现在两者之间可能有天壤之别……

但它们都采用水平对置引擎、后置后驱布局，并且
发明者都是同一个人的事实确实耐人寻味！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini,
this Italian FIAT 500…

...is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.

It may be the smallest of its rivals...

...but it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little engine
is capable of thrilling speeds.

Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed
FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa.

He also penned the underlying design.

Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure
you'll come across them in time!
zh:
与德国的Beetle和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的FIAT 500……

是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。

和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……

但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。

它华丽的外观由著名的FIAT工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，

他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。

吉奥科萨为FIAT创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Among Alfa Romeo’s more recent contributions to motorsports
was this car, which turned many heads in its day.

The street-legal 155 was styled by the Italian design house
I.DE.A Institute in 1992.

And a year later, in 1993, the race-ready 155 2.5 V6 TI
was born.

The improvements made to the car
were nothing short of amazing.

Consider this: The car took 12 wins in the DTM series.

This was an incredible feat indeed.

Behind its wheel were former F1 drivers Nicola Larini
and Alessandro Nannini.

In the series, Larini took 10 checkered flags,
while Nannini claimed two.

Nannini was involved in a terrible helicopter accident in
1990, where his arm was severed and needed to be reattached.

To facilitate his return to racing, the 155
was specially modified.

And, he was still able to win two races!

It really said something about the skill and
competitiveness of a former F1 driver.
zh:
在阿尔法罗密欧近来对赛车运动的贡献中，
这辆车无疑让所有人眼前一亮。

1992年，意大利设计事务所I.DE.A Institute
设计了街道版155跑车。

一年后，即1993年，比赛规格的155 2.5 V6 TI
诞生了。

基于街道版的改装将车型打磨得至臻完美！

事实上，这款赛车总计获得了12场德国房车大师赛冠军，

真是了不起的成就！

实现这一壮举的功勋车手是前F1车手尼古拉·拉里尼和
亚历山德罗·纳尼尼。

尼古拉取得了10场胜利，而亚历山德罗则贡献了另两个
冠军领奖台。

在1990年，亚历山德罗不幸遭遇一场可怕的直升机事故，
他的手臂被切断，不得不重新接上。

为了方便他重返赛场，155赛车专门为其进行了特殊改装。

由此看�，1993年的那两场胜利确实意义非凡！

不仅证明了155的强大，更展现了这位前F1车手的傲人实力。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Trust me, you’re not likely to forget a car like this.

This is the Chaparral 2J, which was built for
the 1970 Can-Am Series.

What makes it original is found at the rear of the car.

There, you'll find two fans powered by a 274cc engine.

These fans suck the car to the ground
to generate downforce.

They expel the air between the underbody and the road,
creating a suction effect.

For this reason, the 2J is sometimes referred to as
the "fan car.".

Thanks to this ingenious piece of engineering, the car can
take corners at speeds that defy all logic.

The Chaparral 2J set incredible lap times
in all four of the races it entered.

In fact, it even took pole position.

Its Achilles Heel was reliability.

But before it could run a full race, the FIA
changed the rules on aerodynamics...

...deeming the fan system illegal.

One can only imagine what this car could have achieved,
had it been given time to develop.
zh:
这是一台让人过目难忘的车！

这辆Chaparral 2J是专为1970年加拿大-美国挑战杯系列赛制造的。

在它的身后，你会发现……

两台通过274cc单缸发动机驱动的风扇。

这些风扇将空气从车身下方排出，以产生下压力……

这使它看起来好像直接吸在地面上一样。

也因此，它常被人称为“风扇车”。

它甚至能够以违反物理常识的高速过弯……

在它参加的所有四场比赛中，
Chaparral 2J都创下了令人难以置信的单圈记录！

确切地说，它包揽了所有四场比赛的杆位。

当然了，它的稳定性另当别论……

在创下纪录后，它未能获准参加后续的比赛。
因为国际汽联针对性地更改了关于空气动力学的规则……

直接将“风扇车”排除在比赛之外。
这样的遗憾也引来了人们的不断遐想。
如果在当时有机会继续改进这辆车，它可以取得什么样的成就！
`

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 and 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynamic principles to increase performance.
zh:
这是1954年出厂的捷豹D-Type。
作为C-Type的继任者，它得到了全面进化。

与它的前辈一样，D-Type是专门为在勒芒比赛中获胜而制造的。

尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。

在1955年，迈克·霍索恩驾驶D-Type在躲过一次可怕的碰撞事
故后，取得了最终胜利。

在56年和57年，D-Type连番卫冕，实现了惊人的勒芒三连冠。

值得一提的是，你知道D-Type的弧线车身设计考虑了流体力
学原理吗？

在当时，这标志着对抗空气阻力的军备竞赛正式开始！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Want to know why Porsche is so popular
among gearheads?

One reason is that the company makes its cars available to
the masses.

This is true not only of their production cars,
but also their top prototypes.

Take the once-retired 908 and 917 models,
for example.

Porsche later sold them to private teams.

And when these teams took to the track with these cars...

...Porsche offered them the same level of
support of its own factory teams.

After all, when a Porsche wins, whether
for the factory or a private team…

...it’s still a win for Porsche.

Beginning with John Wyer Automotive...

...the Porsche 917 was raced by several
Austrian and American teams.

And who can forget 917K’s appearance in the 1971 film
"Le Mans," starring the legendary Steve McQueen!
zh:
为什么车迷们都这么喜欢保时捷？

其中一个原因是，保时捷没有敝帚自珍，将赛车都留为己用。

这不仅仅指的是量产赛车，也包括他们的顶级原型车。

以退役的908和917赛车为例，

保时捷后来把它们出售给了私人车队。

而当买家将这些车重新带入比赛时……

保时捷为他们提供了与原厂车队同等的技术支持。

毕竟，当一辆退役的保时捷在私人车队中再次获胜时……

这仍然是属于保时捷的胜利，不是吗？

从约翰·怀尔汽车公司开始……

有多支奥地利和美国车队曾驾驶保时捷917参赛。

在1971年上映的电影《勒芒》中见识过史蒂夫·麦奎因的
精彩表现后，还有谁能忘记917K的风采呢？

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the
World Endurance Championship.

Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.

The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.

As you can imagine, the 911 is a force to be reckoned with
because of its speed and reliability.

While contesting for overall victories in the LMP1 class,
it also looked to grab the top spot in the GT class.

This particular 911 RSR competed in the WEC and IMSA
in 2017.

It received a bit of backlash from Porsche
enthusiasts, however.

That’s because its engine is mounted amidships,
and not at the rear.

Therefore, many hardcore enthusiasts cried foul,
saying that it wasn't a real 911.

Still, the new engine location did improve
the car’s stability at high speed.

And the resulting change in weight distribution is said to
have dramatically reduced tire friction.

Seen in this light, the alterations make sense.
Porsche is there to win, after all.
]
zh:
一贯以来，保时捷都是世界耐力锦标赛，即“世界耐力锦标赛”的冠军有
力争夺者之一。

其发布的911 RSR同时参加了

勒芒原型车1级和LM-GTE两个级别的比赛。

如您预想得到的，作为保时捷毋庸置疑的旗舰，

911在追求勒芒原型车1级级别的全面胜利的同时，也向GT级别的头名
发起了挑战。

这辆911 RSR在2017年参加了世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会的一系列比赛，

但也受到了保时捷车迷群体的一些质疑。

这是因为它的引擎被安装在车体中部，而不是后部。

很多硬核车迷们会说，“真正的”911必须是后置引擎。

但不得不说，中置布局确实改善了赛车的高速稳定性……

而且，据说这样的重量分配调整极大地减少了轮胎摩损。

从这个角度来看，这些改变是可以理解的。毕竟，
保时捷就是为了赢得比赛而生的。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012, at the British GT Championships.

Now, how do you think it performed
on its home turf?

Well, over 67 races, across seven seasons,
it had a podium finish nearly every time!

And what’s more, in over 30% of its races,
it came in first place!

Needless to say, it will be remembered as a legendary
production racing car in the annals of GT3 history.

Indeed, up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V8-mounted successor...

This incredible car enjoyed a long career at the forefront
of GT racing.
zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。

你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？

在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。

更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！

毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。

事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……

这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This Audi R8-based GT3 was unveiled at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2015.

If you consider yourself an Audi fan, you should know
about this car's illustrious history.

Only two months after it was introduced, the R8 LMS competed
at the Nürburgring 24-hour race.

This was its first competition, and as you
probably guessed by now, it won the race.

It wasn't easy though because the BMW Z4 charged hard
from the start.

However, after 24 hours of racing, the R8 LMS won by the
amazingly slim margin of 40 seconds!

It just goes to show that races are not just won by pure
speed, but also by reliability.
zh:
这台基于R8打造的GT3赛车在2015年3月的
日内瓦车展上首次亮相。

说实话，还有谁没听说过它的辉煌事迹吗？

在亮相后仅两个月，它就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

我提醒一句，这可是它的第一场比赛！它的首秀就直奔
冠军而去！

不用猜，奥迪R8 LMS最终成功地取得了令人印象深刻的首
场胜利……

而第二名的BMW Z4落后它足足40秒之多！
这样的胜利简直令人瞠目结舌！

这也证明了一点——想要赢下比赛不仅仅要依靠性能，
也要靠稳定性和可靠性。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
5cm longer than that of the production model.

The wheelbase has also been extended.

Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.

That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.

They praised it for its precise balance and
smooth turning feel.

And their findings were soon backed up by results.

The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.

At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.

It was a truly incredible race to behold.
*
zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。

但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出5cm！

它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！

这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。

然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……

他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。

你还是不相信？

那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它

于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……

这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
One thing that racing enthusiasts love about BMW...

Is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer racing cars like this one here.

When a new production car is released, a race-ready
model can be expected to follow soon after.

This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...

At endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours...

Where it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.

Part of what makes BMW so cool is that they can be
assertive without coming off as conceited.

They exude that sort of confidence that just lets
the facts speak for themselves.
zh:
赛车迷对BMW最津津乐道的就是……

他们长期以来致力于开发客制赛车，就比如我们眼前的
这台。

每当BMW有新款量产车发布时，你可以期待赛事规格的
车型很快会接踵而至。

这辆Z4 GT3在纽博格林24小时耐力赛等多项耐力赛事中……

给人留下了深刻的印象……

在纽博格林，BMW派出的是冠军车手布鲁诺·斯宾格勒和
蒂姆·格洛克。

在比赛方面，BMW从来只用事实说话，

那自然流露的自信而不自负的气质显得尤为卓尔不群。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Wow, Ferrari builds really amazing race cars.

In fact, the company even has its own one-make series
called the "Ferrari Challenge."

It’s an upscale event that brings together gentlemen
drivers from all over the world.

But don’t get me wrong, these are genuine race machines.

A sibling of the 458 GT3 called the Ferrari 458 GTC
has competed in the GTE class at the WEC...

...and claimed an incredible victory in the GTE-Pro class
at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 2012.

An FIA-GT3-compliant model of the 458 GT3
even competed in the Blancpain GT Series.
zh:
我跟你说，Ferrari造的赛车都很厉害。

他们甚至还有自家的单一车种系列赛，
名叫“Ferrari挑战赛”。

这项奢华的赛事吸引到了全世界的绅士车手齐聚一堂。

不过千万不要误会了，他们在比赛中驾驶的全都是纯正
赛车。

这辆Ferrari 458 GTC是458 GT3的姐妹车型，
曾经参加过世界耐力锦标赛GTE组别的赛事……

还在2012年的勒芒24小时耐力赛的
GTE-Pro组别中拿下了异常精彩的一胜。

另外还有一款符合FIA-GT3规格的458 GT3车型
甚至参加了Blancpain GT系列赛。
<

car: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT
claimed four consecutive wins at Le Mans.

Thirty-six years later, in 2005, a reproduction model
was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.

About 1,500 units of this reproduction model
were sold as road cars.

But what if this car were to race at Le Mans today?

Developed for Gran Turismo, this Ford GT LM Race Car
Spec II tries to answer that question.

Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!
?
zh:
从1966年开始，第一代Ford GT在勒芒连续拿下了四冠。

在36年后的2005年，为了纪念公司的一百周年，
Ford又推出了一款复刻车。

这台复刻车款是一台公路车，总共生产了约1500辆。

如果让这款车去参加当今的勒芒比赛，会有什么样的亮
眼表现呢？

为了回答这个问题，专为跑车浪漫旅开发的
Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II应运而生。

你就等着见识一下它在直道上的速度吧！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT
beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.

This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win
the 24-hour race.

Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.

The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari
once again at Le Mans.

It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making.
It’s what makes racing so much fun!

Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled
with such iconic battles.
zh:
在1966年的勒芒，第一代Ford GT击败了它的宿敌Ferrari……

成为了第一辆赢得这项24小时耐力赛的美国车。

我们将时针快拨50年，来到2016年……

Ford GT又回到了勒芒的赛场上，再次将Ferrari斩落马下！

这是一场跨越半个世纪的伟大胜利！也再次展现了赛车
运动的精彩与乐趣！

在赛车运动漫长的历史中，永远不缺乏这样的经典之战。
,

car: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate race car....

...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...

...and its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。

首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。

我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！

3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。

如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一路畅通！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japanese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in Round 8 race.
zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。

这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。

Epson涂装的NSX真车参加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。

当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。

这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
What, you don’t think that I know this car?
It’s the SLS AMG GT3!

The first customer race car in Mercedes-Benz’s
long and storied history.

It was produced in an era when Mercedes race cars were out
of reach for most privateers.

But the SLS AMG GT3 changed all that.

And its speed and reliability made it a formidable
weapon for privateers the world over.

The SLS AMG GT 3 has really competed in
many, many GT races over the years.
zh:
什么？你以为我不认识这辆车？
开什么玩笑，这可是SLS AMG GT3啊！

这是Mercedes-Benz那漫长而传奇的历史当中的首款客制赛车！

在那之前，大部分的私人车队都没机会入手
这样一辆Mercedes赛车。

不过，SLS AMG GT3的出现改变了历史。

凭借可靠且强劲的速度，它成为了全球各地私人车手手
中最强力的武器。

这款SLS AMG GT 3参加过的GT比赛数不胜数！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
1kg too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.

It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.

Since then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.

But if you’re interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race colors of other countries.
zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重1kg，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。

最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！

自那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。

不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars
has seen many sporty versions of the genre.

And the Honda Beat stood out because
it was mid-engine and a convertible!

While the NSX may be Honda’s original
mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.

No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。

这款Honda Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！

Beat采用了与Honda旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX

近似的配重平衡，

并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……

这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！
<

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!

Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors,
the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.

Combing their initials, the three may be referred to
as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
zh:
如果要讨论最正宗的轻型跑车……

这款Suzuki Cappuccino就是真正的传奇。

它采用前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，也就是所谓的“前置
后驱”车。

抬起它的引擎盖，你会发现它的引擎位置更贴近车身的
正中。

这就是它作为真正跑车的明证！

这款Cappuccino在1991年上市……

常被拿来和它的竞争者Mazda AZ-1和Honda Beat相提并论。

如果把这三款车的型号名称首字母连在一起，就形成了
轻型跑车的“A-B-C”，代表了最基础的车型。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Oh, I’ve seen this car before in a "Fast & Furious" film.
It’s the Toyota Supra.

As the ancestor of the GR Supra, it has a special
place in Toyota’s sports-car history.

And there’s something really neat about
its emblem, too.

It was actually inspired by the art of
Japanese calligraphy.
|
zh:
啊，我以前见过这款车，是在《速度与激情》电影里。
这是一辆Toyota Supra啊。

它是GR Supra的始祖，在Toyota的跑车历史上
拥有非常特殊的地位。

而且它的车标设计也非常简洁。

这个设计的灵感好像是来源于日本的书法！
-

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This is an Abarth car—you can tell straightaway
from the ‘scorpion’ emblem.

Abarth is one of the most storied brands
in motorsport history.

It was established by Carlo Abarth...

Who began his career as a racer and engineer of
two- and four-wheel vehicles in the 1920s...

And later had success as a tuner for FIAT.

Today, an Abarth 595 that is based on the old FIAT 500
will fetch a pretty penny!

By the way, about that scorpion emblem...

It comes from the fact that Carlo Abarth was born
in November, making him a Scorpio!
zh:
从这个“蝎子”的标志你就能一眼看出，这是一辆Abarth的车。

Abarth是汽车历史上最富传奇色彩的品牌之一。

这个品牌由卡洛·阿巴斯创立。

他在上世纪20年代以赛车手和两轮及四轮车辆工程师的
身份开始了自己的职业生涯……

随后，他因为对FIAT车辆的优异调校而闻名于世。

时至今日，一辆基于老款FIAT 500改装的Abarth 595
依然能卖出高价！

哦，顺带一说，它之所以用蝎子作为车标……

是因为卡洛·阿巴斯出生于十一月，所以是天蝎座！
~

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.<next�id=1800306 type=9ԙ
zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。

作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。

因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。

它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。

这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.

The wheelbase has been shortened by 100mm...

...giving it long-nose proportions.

The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...

...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.

In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...

...aims to ithis car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.

There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.

If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...

...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.
zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。

首先，轴距缩短了100mm……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。

相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。

当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
I love this car, and it's easily one of my top three all time.

Based on sketches by Ford designers...

...you get the feeling that its appearance was brought together
by British designers...

...who knew how racecars should look and perform.

When compared to the Ferrari 330P4 of the same year...

...the overall shape of the GT40 is emotionally modest,
while characterized by a more modern silhouette.

They're both nice, but I think I prefer the GT40.

The face created by the square headlamps and air intakes,
which are rare in racecars...

...is aggressive and stylish.

But there's a rather elegant, feminine quality within the car's
overall muscular nature...

...expressed by the line that runs from the cabin to
the rear end.

Although it hasn't been mentioned much before, but there's
a quality not unlike that of the Lamborghini Miura her�.

The Mark II added air intakes, which gave the car
even more racecar intensity.

It's this part of the car that I find very alluring.
zh:
我喜欢这辆车。
如果要排名的话，它能轻松跻身我个人喜好排行榜的前三。

此车是由一支来自英国的团队

基于福特设计师的草图打造的……

看得出来，他们对赛车的外观和性能胸有成竹。

与同年的法拉利330 P4相比……

GT40可能欠缺一些激情，但有着更具现代感的轮廓。

当然了，这两部车都很棒，只是我个人更偏爱GT40。

请注意方形大灯和进气口所构成的前脸，
这在赛车上是很少见的。

我会觉得它既有侵略性，又有时尚感。

尽管总体上“孔武有力”，但还是可以让人感受到
一丝优雅气质，

主要体现在从车厢延伸到尾部的线条中。

虽然之前很少被提及，但其实
兰博基尼Miura与此车师出同门。

在Mark II版�'�中增加的多个进气口使它看起来更有张力。

事实上，我觉得最有魅力的就是这部分。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one person.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？

我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。

事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模型师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。

我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.

This front design was actually...

...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed
at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.

We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit
too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...

This design was born from us saying, "Let's try one
more time to express the design in a different way."

The 2017 car has a very complete look to it, and
I do like it myself.

Also, regarding the interior,
it has a modern design with depth and good textures.
zh:
哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。

前部车身的设计其实取自……

我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R Proto概念车。

当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，
设计有些过于激进……

于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。

2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。

我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.

The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.

The ridge that runs down the hood...

...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.

It's so very French.

But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...

...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.

These details that suggest it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.

In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.

In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.

This type of visual allure,
you can't achieve in today's cars.

This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collection.
zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。

从正前方看时尤其如此，

因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。

我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。

不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……

以及精心布置的进气口。

这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精致的特征。

从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，

甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。

它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。

这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.

There's plenty of cabin space.

Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.

Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.

Take the proportion, line, and surface...

...in many ways, the design of this car says
"it can only be done this way."

But what is most impressive is...

...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.

The look of the nose is modern.

It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.

The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.

From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.

In that day, there were man� motivated
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.

They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.

I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.
zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！

严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。

如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……

而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。

不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。

此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……

无不彰显着“纯正”二字。

但最为出众的……

还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。

以其现代化的车头设计为例。

与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。

S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。

从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。

当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。

他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。

这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Whoa, now this is most impressive!　

The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning,
has separated this automobile from the base model.

Because of that, the design of the original automobile...

...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the
added-on parts...

...greatly changing its essence.

The S2000 was originally designed to make the front
overhangs appear short...

...but the contrasting proportion of the nose,
with its wedged shape design on this car...

...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout
of the S2000.

There's a lot of room for the intervention of design,
especially in the details.

And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived
absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\
zh:
这辆车令人非常印象深刻！

在接受了大量强化调校后，这辆GT1 Turbo spec已经变得
与基础车型截然不同。

你可以明显看出，几乎称得上是“暴力”的改装件
彻底颠覆了原车的模样，

可以说已经是台完全不同的车了！

虽说S2000的设计初衷是缩短前悬距……

但Amuse的最终成果却有悖常理地造就了GT1的长车头比例！

不得不说，它在细节和其他设计元素方面都有
长足的改进空间……

但这些“简陋”的呈现反而成了萌点，
使它成为了一头可爱的怪兽。<next id=2001006 type

car: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.

When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has
become compact and solid.

Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of
a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."

The side glass graphics at the C-pillar
are also reminiscent of the C10.

You can say that the different front and rear overfenders
are take from the Hakosuka, too.

And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."

...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design
that's simple and powerful.

It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express
the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.*
zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。

与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。

修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……

C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，

甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。

那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……

其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。

毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。

我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
About Pagani's design...

...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.

Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...

...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...

...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.

When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined 30 years before in Turin had concluded...

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.

It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...

...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……

和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。

以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，

他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……

这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。

当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计时代已经告一段落……

所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。

倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，

但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。

这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Oh boy, this is just crazy!
That "5" I loved so much, what happened?

Just because it wanted to go fast in rallies,
it didn't have to sell its soul to the devil!

It has become 20cm wider, and if you look at it from the
rear, it looks like a laughing Cheshire Cat.

And because the engine is mounted at the rear,
it only seats two now.

But wait...

...upon closer examination, aside from the bulging fenders and
bumpers, oh my, much of the original 5 is still there, as is.

Aside from the cheeks, the car has a gentle face,
which means, it's more Clark Kent than the Hulk.

I mean, what kind of magic is this?

The interior of the Turbo 1
features a super modern Mario Bellini design.

This thing would be stylish, even in Paris!

Oh my! I think I've fallen in love with this crazy 5
Somebody, anybody, gimme some of this magic on my own 5.
zh:
这真是太疯狂了！
他们对我熟悉的那台可爱的小“5”做了什么？

为了让它在拉力赛中有所建树，就非得
把它的灵魂出卖给魔鬼吗？

你看，它的车身整整变宽了20cm。
从背后看过去，就像一只咧嘴笑的柴郡猫。

由于搭载了一台后置引擎，它现在只剩下两个座位了。

等一下……

细看下来，除了隆起的挡泥板和保险杠以外——
哦，原版小“5”的大部分特征基本还是保留了！

不看侧面的话，它的前脸还是和原来一样，
所以还是更像肌肉分明的超人，而不是大块头绿巨人。

他们这是施展了什么样的巫术啊？

Turbo 1的内饰采用了马里奥·贝里尼设计的超现代风格。

就算走上巴黎的T台都不会显得格格不入！

哦，天呐！我想我已经爱上了这辆疯狂的小“5”。
事实上，我愿意接受它的一切！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Usually, when using the elements of
an existing car to create a variant...

...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.

This is done to avoid cannibalism.

That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.

It's like you're not doing your job.

But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.

Nope. These days, just about anything goes!

In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.

Things like customization and the diversification
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...

...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.
zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……

你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。

换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。

所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，

会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。

但是对于追求玩趣、想象力丰富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。

事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！

在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。

这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……

它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.

Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.

The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.

And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.
zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。

尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现出了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。

注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。

另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛的红色鸟居。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.

That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be
a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".

Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.

At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.

And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers
made the car look like it was in motion even when standing still.

This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance
than the base GT model.

Also...

...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.

All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir
to this R32 GTR.
zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。

运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。

我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。

首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。

然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃跃欲试的感觉。

从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。

此外……

从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。

这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.

I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:

 If it was to be mechanically similar,
then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.

If the car was to be mechanically new...

...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.

 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.

When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...

“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”

 They actually didn't want to show me the car...

...even on the night before
the world premiere event.

Enough was enough, so I made my stand.

 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”

"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."

"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”

They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.

They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I th�ught?

The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。

他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。

我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。

所以我是这样告诉他的。

我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……

但对于第四代而言……

我暂时没有什么具体的想法。

不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……

相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。

此外……

如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……

那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。

在此之后，我��直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。

每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。

“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。

“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”

事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。

我后来忍不住了。

我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露�7�失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”

他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？

第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.

Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.

This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.

It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.

It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。

现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。

它是目的性最明确的BMW……

其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。

细节上的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……

以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。

仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.

But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.

I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.

That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.
zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，

只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

就像原版的FIAT 500一样！

我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。

是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。?

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.

If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...

...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.

Then, when the FD replacement project started.

 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...

...with a completely new one.

Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。

当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……

而且，如果要开发下一代的话……

应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。

再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。

一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……

替换成一个全新的设计。

幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.

Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.

Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.?
zh:
没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像
被整齐地切掉一块。

卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。

这一设计是由斯图加特大学的Wunibald Kamm博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。

role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The plexiglass headlights on the early models and...

...design elements such as the orange indicator lights that
extend on the side...

...are defining symbols of this car.

Also, the grooves that flow in a straight line on the side
of the car are...

...implemented on most Ferraris that followed this car.

The star-shaped 5-spoke aluminum wheels are also important
symbols of Ferrari's design.

Yes, yes. This wheel originated from a sports prototype car
from the 1960s...

...and was first used on the Daytona.
zh:
早期车型上的有机玻璃大灯和……

侧面的橙色指示灯
之类的设计元素……

都是这款车的主要特征之一。

此外，请注意那些直线形的凹槽……

在此之后被应用到了大多数Ferrari上。

星形的五辐铝制车轮也是Ferrari设计的重要标志。

事实上，这种轮毂样式源于20世纪60年代设计……

并在戴通纳比赛中投入使用的一台原型跑车。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was
with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window
and dynamic rear pillar.

Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it
appear even more aggressive.

But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front
grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.
zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在Renault Design工作时经手设计的！

当我和我的团队一起设计Mégane III系列时……

从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。

这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，

以及显著改造过的后保险杠……

还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。

但最成功的细节……

无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.

In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...

...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。

它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……

标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……

还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。

当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...

And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.

Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……

并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。

黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
This is my car!
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.

The 1969 Camaro is a true classic
American muscle car.

The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...

... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.

The most dated area of the design are the wheels.

On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels
and installed 17-inch wheels.

It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。

这么说吧，1969 Camaro是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。

其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……

艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。

如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。

比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。

这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。

相信我，我知道自己在说什么。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.

The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.

It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar
of the legendary CanAm series.

Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body
and twin fans on the rear...

...instantly made you want to know
what mysteries lay below its skin.

Its design looks more like a scientific test bed
than an agile racecar.

But the Chaparral 2J could
outperform everything.

That's why it was eventually banned from racing
because of its incredible technical advantage.

I would have created a body shape which was more in
keeping with the front-end design...

...or at least painted the center section white.
zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。

Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。

毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。

看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……

让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。

从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，

但Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。

这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。

就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后端设计更加一致的车身。

至少，我会将车体中段也涂成白色。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.

The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.

Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.

Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
zh:
C7 Corvette的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，

并且在运动感方面取得了突破。

整台车的造型好像一条黄貂鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……

以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。

在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，

而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral
2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration,
the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts
throughout.

All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention
to detail are truly stunning.
zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。

毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……

但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。

以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……

并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。

所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。

即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。

另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of
the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!

It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!;
zh:
2001款996 GT3是Porsche最大的秘密武器之一！

无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝Porsche所推出的所有GT3！

它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
zh:
没错！这款引擎由Porsche的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，以及
F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
Hans Mezger was Porsche's legendary engineer.

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
zh:
汉斯·梅茨格是Porsche的传奇工程师！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The BAC Mono is one gorgeous piece of engineering.

 It's a great example of exceptional industrial design.

 Every detail is beautifully executed
with functional forms and fresh graphics.

 Its inspiration comes from single-seat formula cars.

It's a serious road and track machine that is
designed to extract the maximum out of the driver and car.

The serious aerodynamics are played out visually.

 Take a look at the fuselage.

It tapers to the rear with the large side intakes
and routes the air through and over the back spoiler/wing.

I also love how the engineering is approached.

It comes equipped with push-rod front suspension shocks,
and the rear suspension arms on full display.

This car is indeed an impressive example of
how form can follow function.

 It is truly a highly technical,
clever design language that is beautifully done!
zh:
BAC Mono是一辆工程学的奇迹、

一件出类拔萃的工业设计样本……

它的设计灵感来自于单座方程式赛车。

每一处细节都精雕细琢……
采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，

这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。

严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈现在眼前。

以车身为例，

车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。

它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。

它配备了推杆式前悬挂减震……

而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!

Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.

It became the future DNA for Porsche...

...especially for the Boxster and Cayman,
and I would say, influenced the 918.

It has a lot of innovative details,
such as the double hump mesh rear screen...

...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.

I also love the rear diffuser
with the integrated exhausts.

Also inspiring was the interior
with the center console bridge.

 If I were to make one criticism...

...then it would have be
the visually long bodyside.

The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...

...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.

The clever details continue
with the center-lock wheels.

...and the aero supported mirrors.

 I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT
is truly timeless...

...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!
zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。

我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！

你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！

从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……

它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……

比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。

它蕴含了大量的创新细节……

比如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。

集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。

同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。

不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……

我觉得长度有些太长了。

尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……

因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……

例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
I love the 2008 FIAT 500! It's so
whimsical and fun.

Really, it does a masterful job of improving upon
its forebear.

Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.

But here's an example that truly inspires!

The face is friendly, with its round eyes.

You could have a parking lot full of them, all in the same
colour, and they would each look unique!

Colour plays a huge emotional role in the 500.

Given its retro design, the retro colouring suits it
very well.
zh:
我可爱2008款FIAT 500了！这辆有趣的小车太脑洞大开了。

真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。

在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。

但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！

睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。

就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！

不同的颜色为FIAT 500注入了个性与情绪。

考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!

 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.

The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.

This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！

将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。

而实际上，GT40要小上一号。

在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。

“大号”的新Ford GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。

这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有Ford的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。

无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。

这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 type=9׾

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and
proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!

Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides.
Low beltline and great all-round visibility.

 All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel
to each other.

This is when it seemed the MINI designers
had a bigger voice with great vision!

They looked amazing in a variety of colors,
liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the
big round central screen.

The MINI screamed fun!
zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！

你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！

无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...

...to instantly convey information and the underlying message
in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.

It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its
philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.

It's also supposed to draw the customer in
by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal.

Therefore, the look of products at times tries to appeal to
many people at once, making many of them looking similar.

Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.

But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.

Whether it's a mountain road or the race track,
all it needs to do is to go fast.

The headlight, for example, is simply required
to shine a light forward.

Although seemingly unapproachable, this car knows its role.
It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.

These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?
zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……

……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。

要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。

还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。

因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观的趋同性。

说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。

不过Radical却是个例外。

不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。

比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。

尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。

那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_��老朋友。

这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...

...was surely at its peak.

Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.

This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.

The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.

But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.

And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。

这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。

这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。

多边形车身非常抽象、简约。

虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。

粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The Mini, Beetle and Cinquecento of today...

Are more than just products of their manufacturers.
They have become unique brands unto themselves.

Well, the Ford GT that appeared in 2005 is
a sports car example of this phenomenon.

Nine years later, a slew of hypercars
would appear, stirring fierce rivalry.

This 2017 Ford GT returned to its origins while,
at the same time, adopting innovation.

Viewed from a low angle, it bears traces of
the 1960s car that raced at Le Mans.

And from a higher angle, one can clearly make out
its innovative three-dimensional design.
zh:
极具标志性特色的Mini、Beetle和Cinquecento……

……不仅只是一款产品……

……更成为了各自品牌独一无二的名片。

这款2005年亮相的Ford GT
则是Ford的超跑“门面”。

但在那之后的九年间，随着大量超级跑车相继问世，
市场竞争日趋激烈。

这款2017 Ford GT采用了传承经典的设计理念，
同时引入了多项革新。

俯下身来观察，你会发现它甚至保留了
1960年代勒芒赛车时的部分特征。

而通过俯瞰视角，则可以清晰地见证革新性的3D建模设计车壳。<

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.

The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down.

Only the bare minimum parts have been added,
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.

The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...

...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization.

Look at the original fender mirrors, they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White color.

It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...

...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past.

And now...

...the raw pureness of the spirit of the
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!
zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。

内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。

这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。

原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……

……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。

你瞧瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。

就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……

……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。

而现在……

……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。

姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!

The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout,
from the interior to its exterior appearance.

The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.

It's as if this vehicle is saying,
"I have no desire to be a star to the public."

And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love
that we feel for sports cars.

On the sexy body, which sits extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.

The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine,
and the corresponding trunk lid...

...express a powerful driving force.

In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what
many would accept, for love sees no fault.

This design generates indifferent feelings,
captivating only those who understand it.
zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！

从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。

摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。

实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。

与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。

对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……

……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。

这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.

It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.

In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.

After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。

尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。

从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。

在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.

Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...

...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.

Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。

其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。

现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.

It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.

But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.

At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.
zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。

久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。

首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。

从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计里
多少带着一些美国车的影子。

唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。

我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。

事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。

粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……

�;�…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
When Mr. Yamauchi approached me about
the Vision Gran Turismo project...

...it was when we were exploring the design strategy
of next-gen Infiniti models.

This design came from Infiniti's Beijing studio,
which had just been established.

One of our young designers took the initiative
and completed this in a short time.

There's some simplicity in the details of the design,
but that, in turn, is what makes it so alluring.

For example, where the A-pillar seems to float from the cabin,
the resulting form here conveys lots of emotion.

Because its improvisational in nature,
it has a strong design feel to it.

Of course, this car was designed strategically
employing Infiniti's form language.

Therefore, it effectively links to
the production Infiniti cars that came afterwards.
zh:
当山内一典先生找我聊跑车浪漫旅愿景项目时……

……我们正在思考下一代车型应当采用什么样的设计策略。

这款设计来自于刚成立不久的英菲尼迪北京工作室。

团队的一名年轻设计师自告奋勇，
在很短时间内就完成了设计。

它的设计大繁至简，反而为这台车平添了一份魅力。

比如，A柱看上去像是游离在车厢之上，
整车造型更是传递出了强烈的冲动与激情。

因为本质上是即兴创作，所以给人以强烈的设计感，

但它在造型设计语言方面与品牌的血统一脉相承，

更为后续推出的英菲尼迪量产车型留下了许多启发。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
The styling of this car is a continuation
of the BMW 2002 and represents

the last 3 Series with BMW's traditional design language.

It looks as if the designers employed obvious themes and
executed them in an obvious manner, but the car still looks good.

For example, one thing that makes this design effective is...

...the front overhang when viewed from the rear-quarter angle.

It's almost non-existent.
You can hardly see it.

Both the engineers and designers understood
the importance of proportions.

This design can only happen when planned from the early stages.

It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished
on a mass-produced vehicle..
zh:
这款车延续了2002款的风格，
在BMW的传统设计语言下竭力展现最新一代3系的风貌。

我感觉，设计师们最初就定下了张扬肆意的调子，
在呈现时更是不遗余力，最终的效果也非常出彩。

比如说，它有个非常精妙的设计……

……如果你从斜后方角度观察车头前悬部分，

你会发现几乎看不到，
仿佛它不存在一样。

这代表BMW的工程师和设计师们对车身比例研究得很透彻。

要实现这一点，必须在开发前期就将之纳入规划。

这是一件知易行难的事，在打造一款量产车时，
能实现这样的成果确实难能可贵。.

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the
2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?

This car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly original idea,
one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks.

This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben
Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.

And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.

The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed,
espeically the rear-quarter.

This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but
after talking things over with Ben...

...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights,
details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.

Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans,
and it was discontinued after a year.
zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。

我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得很喜欢。

它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通力合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部，
我们也安装了四盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。

遗憾的是，这辆车在勒芒未能有所斩�，在一年后便停产了。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.

And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?

The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.

While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.
zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……

……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车的风格定调是由我们的伦敦工作室在很短的时间内
完成的。你是不是也能感觉到其中充满了流动的能量？

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们
给了年轻设计师们绝对的自由，可以随心所欲地打造这辆车。

而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。

如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？

还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，

而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。

尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……

……但前保险杠^��后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...

...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races.

The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...

...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in
the grille and the shape of the lights.

When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.

For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.

Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.

In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!
zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……

……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。

每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……

……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。

我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。

要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。

为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定

驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。

我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……

……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”

所以，我才会在S��计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable
and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.

In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier
and larger siblings.

 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。

它的设计充分地彰显了“Aston Martin”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。

相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……

……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。

后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。

有了这项升级，这款Aston Martin也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。;

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.

While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.

Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。

多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。

它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.

The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.

They knew precisely where to work their magic.

In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。

作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。

这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。

或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。

参与这项开发计划的工程师们……

……很好地掌握了比例的概念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。

他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。

例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。

光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.

And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."

The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.

Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.

It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
zh:
Ferrari和Pininfarina都秉承了同一设计理念：

每一辆Ferrari都必须“美观而独特”。

这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。

和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，

摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，

在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
An iconic creamy white body with the Shelby Blue stripes
represented a genuine GT Mustang...

...one that stood out from the super popular base model.

The original Mustang came
with great proportions.

Its design was simple and clean.

Due to regulations, no parts
were added to the exterior of the Shelby G.T.350.

However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wider tires and the iconic graphics.

 If I were to own a Mustang,
this would be at the top of my list.
zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。

原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，

只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。

car: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
