This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。

“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。

这辆车从头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。

每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。]

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Toyota 2000GT is a wonderful sports car,
and a true modern-day classic.

The proportions are great.
I wouldn’t change a thing.

It looks best from a rear three-quarter angle.
Seen from that perspective...

The roofline settles far back on the body,
making the bonnet look long and sleek.

The ‘60s-era details are creative and add to
the charm of the design.
zh:
这辆Toyota 2000GT是非常优秀的跑车，
也是现代汽车历史中的一款经典杰作。

它的比例十分出色，我甚至找不到任何改进的余地。

我个人最喜欢的欣赏角度是侧后方。
从这个角度看上去……

……车身线条从车顶向尾部缓缓滑落，显得顺滑流畅，
还有它的引擎盖，是那么的修长而利落。

在1960年代，就连细节的设计都创意无穷，
为整体设计增色不少。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
One really cool thing about the design of this car...

Is how it does not rely on gimmicks, but is rather
a pure expression of functional beauty.

The surfaces are well-sculpted into tasteful shapes.
And the body is muscular, with great proportions.

Though the wheels are the largest of their kind,
the car seems to almost hug the ground.

Indeed, the Mercedes A45 AMG has been carefully designed
To express a tough and cool attitude.

I want one in my garage!
zh:
这辆Mercedes A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。

其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。

车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。

设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆Mercedes牢牢扒住地面。

这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。

这样的车，连我也想买一辆！/

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.

Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.

The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
zh:
Corvette Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台Corvette
都带来了重大影响。

自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。

大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的Corvette大相径庭。

车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。

另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has
 an absolutely wonderful stance.

 The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape,
with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.

The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.

 It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.

 I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance
model much better than the base Model S.
zh:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance的外形绝对令人惊艳。

车轮恰到好处地超出车身外廓，
宽大的轮眉向外延展，盖住车轮。

车身线条顺滑流畅，
无需任何附加的铬合金或空气动力学部件，

就已经显得未来感十足，帅气非凡。

我很喜欢Signature Performance的前脸造型，
比基础款Model S的平面耐看多了。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.

One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.

And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到Lamborghini Countach
的情景。

LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。

它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。

即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。

它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。

一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。

这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!

There's a lot I like about it.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!

It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!

And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！

我喜欢它的地方有很多。

首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。

它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……

反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。

它有着极强的表现力！

这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！

倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!

It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.

The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.

Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.

This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.=
zh:
Raptor的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！

它不仅拥有Ford血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。

它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。

极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。

另外，这辆初代Raptor搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was built with racing as its sole purpose.

It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.

The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.

The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.

A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Style Porsche...

...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.

Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.

I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!

A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。

尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。

轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。

从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的

保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。

内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。

在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。

我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……

……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。

不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's
an extremely well-proportioned racecar...

...when compared to the production-based street version.

I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT,
but these are bolder and wider.

The graphics are pure Audi Sport
with the red, gray and silver.

I also like the black wheels brought out
to the maximum track width.

It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!
zh:
2016 TT Cup是一辆让人心生悸动的赛车，
因为和量产的街车版本相比……

……它更加的“匀称”。

我喜欢这辆车的挡泥板设计，
有点原版TT的味道，不过做得更大也更宽。

红灰银涂装是Audi Sport的官方风格。

漆黑的轮毂我也觉得不错，
而且他们将轮距加宽到了极致，

让整车造型看上去更加坚定和动态。
这台车的设计语言非常大胆，也非常引人注目！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"

 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!

 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.

This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
zh:
每当我看到Daihatsu Copen，都会忍不住笑！

这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”

前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！

尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。

设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
If there is a car that perfectly
represents Ferrari’s spirit...

...it is the F40.

The progenitor of all Hypercars,
an absolute myth for enthusiasts.

It follows typical Pininfarina design continuity.

It incorporates the cabin volume of the usual 308
with a body inspired by competition.

Low, profiled, with retractable headlights...

... and indicators that sit behind
smoked Plexiglas.

With the two NACAs
on the hood...

...as well as the four lateral "gills" in GTO-style
behind the rear wheel...

..it integrates many functional air intakes.

Other characterstic elements are...

...the horizontal black groove...

...as well as the three round central exhausts and...

...the huge rear wing with the initials F40
in bas-relief on the right side.
zh:
如果说有哪辆车能完美代表法拉利的精神……

……那么非F40莫属。

它是所有终极跑车的始祖，是车迷心目中的绝对神话。

它在设计方面延续了宾尼法利纳的经典风格，

并继承了普通版本308的驾驶舱，
但车身造型设计明显是为竞速而生的：

无论是低矮的轮廓，翻转式大灯……

……及雾面有机玻璃后的转向指示灯；

还是引擎盖上的两个NACA进气口……

……或是后轮之后的四道GTO风格竖向“鳃”状风口……

……功能性进气口的数量多得让人瞠目结舌。

当然，它的个性还不止于此：

……纯黑色水平蜂窝格栅、
三联装的中置圆形排气管以及……

……大到夸张的尾翼。
在尾翼的右侧面还有一个大大的“F40”]��雕标志。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX
at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.

It was the expression of absolute sportiness
combined with Japanese perfection.

In fact, its clean and streamlined style...

...comes from studies previously
made with Pininfarina.

These were further developed later by
in-house Japanese designers

This design is so pure and balanced that...

...it lasted 15 years without noticeable changes.

While the front and
side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...

...the tail is particularly original and successful.

Of note are its integrated wing and
the transversal strip of lights

The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...

...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics*
zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。

它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。

这种简洁的流线造型……

……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。

之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。

这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……

……以至于沿用了整整15年都未见任何显著改动。

虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……

……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。

一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。

后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……

……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.

It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...

Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...

It would influence the design language and proportions
of all subsequent models.

Its style is characterized by...

...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines,
with no visible air inlets on the sides.

The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...

...embedded in the bodywork...

...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.

 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...

...then the 458 it comes really close.&
zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。

它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……

……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……

……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。

其风格特点可以用几点归纳：

极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。

犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……

……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……

……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。

如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……

……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.

This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion
that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces
are expressed as utter purity and elegance.

The car fits a low, gritty front, a set-back cabin,
generous hips and a compact tail...

All into one concentrated ensemble.

It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture
by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptional level
of perfection and timeless beauty.

It is beauty in its purest and most striking essence!
zh:
法拉利250 GT SWB！我愿意将它称为跑车中的“蒙娜丽莎”！

它是运动性、优雅和动力的精髓
在汽车外形上的完美总和。

这个设计方案……

……始于1947年的西斯塔尼亚202双座，
宾尼法利纳将自那以来对体积和比例的探索，都汇萃于此。

紧凑而动感的造型、力量喷涌的曲面……

……带来极致的纯粹和绝对的优雅。

从低矮却坚毅的前脸，到后移的座舱……

从厚实外扩的后轮到收窄的紧凑尾箱……

……同样是那么的纯粹，那么的优雅。

简直能与……

……达芬奇的绘画或米开朗基罗的雕塑相媲美。

它将各种元素浓缩而又均衡地组合在一起，
实现了无可比拟的圆满和永恒之美。

它是美以最纯粹的形式展现……

……是最动人心魄的美之精华！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
Here, we have the cute Honda Beat...

...a symbol of the Japanese two-seat
convertible kei-car category, born in the 1990s.

The car was a result from a historic collaboration
between Honda and Pininfarina.

Its clean and simple design perfectly envelops
the super compact mid-engine package.

It features side air inlets, but also a "clamshell" front hood
and aerodynamically side mirrors.

The perforated steel rims and
the motorcycle-like instrument cluster...

...they both contribute to reinforce
the basic and sporty spirit of the car.

A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.
zh:
看，这就是我们可爱的本田Beat……

……日本双座敞篷轻型车类别诞生于20世纪90年代，
而它就相当于这一类别的象征符号之一。

这台车是本田和宾尼法利纳历史性合作的成果。

它的设计简洁而精巧，将一台超紧凑的中置引擎套件
安装在后轴上。

除了侧面进气口，它还配备了“蚌壳形”的前引擎盖
和集成空气动力学效应的侧后视镜。

孔洞式的钢轮毂和类似摩托车的仪表组……

……无不在强调这辆车走的是朴实、运动的路线。

特别值得一提的是座椅套上的斑马纹路，
这可是走在20世纪90年代日本的时尚潮流前列。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
This car represents the baby of
the Alfa Romeo range.

Its design recalls the stylistic features of
the extreme 8C Competizione.

This includes with his curved sensual surfaces..

....not to mention its drop-shaped headlights and
round rear lights.

There are also the “five-circles” theme of the alloy wheels...

These elements are all
typical of the Alfa brand.

The cked with an air of
condensed energy that seems “ready to explode."

Even the window areas are extremely reduced,
and the rear window is very slanted.

And the hatch here is small and, I must say,
quite inconvenient.

But you know...

...when it comes to practicality...

Well, let's just say it certainly isn't
the main objective of an Alfa Romeo's design.
zh:
MiTo是阿尔法罗密欧旗下车型中的“大宝贝”。

它的设计特征让人想起剑走偏锋的8C Competizione：

包括那性感的弧度……

……“五环”造型的铝合金轮毂，

更不必提那为人熟知的水滴形头灯和圆形尾灯……

……全都是典型的阿尔法元素。

这辆车看上去仿佛被注入了一股浓缩压实过的能量，
像是“随时会爆炸”一样。

甚至连窗户的面积也遭到极限压缩，后窗陡然倾斜，

继而导致行李箱门开口变小，非常不便。

但是吧……

……每每谈到实用性的时候……

大家都会心领神会地说，
这方面肯定不是阿尔法罗密欧的主要设计目标。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.

The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
zh:
这辆车是Toyota近些年来最好的设计之一。

其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……

但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。

Toyota通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。

无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……

还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing,
not to mention functional.
zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。

菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。

在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。

它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.
zh:
有一段时间，乔治亚罗的设计产量大增，推出了多款量产车作品，
但他把自己标志性的造型技术……

……充分展现在这辆蓝旗亚Delta中。

它不仅反映出蓝旗亚高贵庄重的品牌形象，
更给人以积极进取的感觉。

在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

Delta的研发基础车型是一台两厢掀背轿车。

蓝旗亚用16英寸的205宽胎和外扩的特大号挡泥板
赋予了Delta如同野生动物一般无畏的野性。

也让你亲眼目睹一辆温驯的掀背车
是如何被转化为一辆狂暴的拉力赛车的。

顺带一提，我本人非常欣赏这种设计方法。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.

This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."

This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.

However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...

...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.

Power is provided by a HEMI engine.

On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."

When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.

If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。

这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。

这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。

不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……

无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。

此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。

引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”

这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。

如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Challenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.

The debate surrounding this car is about the
identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.

The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.

However, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.

Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-ever mid-engine Lamborghini
was a car that looked this amazing.
zh:
Miura在我们这些设计师当中是个颇具争议的话题。

不过，大家的争论焦点是它的真正设计者究竟是谁。

有的人说是博通的乔盖托·乔治亚罗……

……而另一些人则认为它是博通的后辈马塞罗·甘迪尼的作品。

这辆车的整体外观在当时相当超前，
甚至可以与福特GT40的横空出世相提并论。

然而，最令我印象深刻的是那副朝上的头灯。

在乔治亚罗的另一款作品菲亚特850敞篷上，
也能找到类似的细节。

这是否说明Miura的真正设计师是乔治亚罗？我是这么认为的。

无论如何……

……有史以来的第一辆中置引擎兰博基尼的外观是如此超凡脱俗，
总算没有令人失望。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a
product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray
came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens.
The result is the F1 you see here.

The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to
be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation
Honda NSX served as the benchmark.

The center-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low 1140mm.

But the design is well-executed,
without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
zh:
近几十年来，我们鲜少能看到将设计师的意图
贯彻到每一处细节的作品。

天才设计师戈登·穆雷曾提出过一辆新车的概念构想，

然后将接力棒交到了彼得·史蒂文斯手中。
两人的合作成果就是你眼前的这台F1。

F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆
“可以日常驾驶的超级跑车”。

还有人说它的设计对标参照物是第一代本田NSX。

这辆车有许多独到之处。例如在三座布局中，
将驾驶员座椅放在前排居中位置，以使重量分配达到最优，

……亦或是将车身高度降到只有1140mm。

迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不协调感。
我很欣赏这一点。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...

....the high degree of precision displayed here.

One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...

...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.

The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.

You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.
zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。

当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。

宛若薄绸般轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。

你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.

At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...

...while in the adjacent room,
another car was being tested. That was the 917.

A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a
turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.

The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.

It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder
engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.

Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.

On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,

and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.
zh:
提到917，我正好想起了一个故事。
请容我讲讲1968年发生的一件轶事。

当时我们在十九世纪就设立的巴黎埃菲尔风洞实验室里
，我们的新项目正进行到一半……

这时正好有另一辆车在隔壁接受测试，就是这款917。

一辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造
的比赛机器停放在一座修建于前一个世纪的实验室里！

有一种恍若隔世的反差感。

后来，这款917在1969年的日内瓦车展上首次亮相。

虽然这台动力猛兽是908的继任者，但却没有采用水平对置
八缸引擎，而是换上了一台水平对置十二缸风冷引擎。

此外，这台917还可以根据不同类型的赛事调校为不同形式……

例如在高速赛道上采用长车尾，
在塔格·佛罗热耐力赛这样的蜿蜒赛道上则换上短车尾。ne�t id=1700806 type=9

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.

It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.

A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.

It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.

Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.

This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由Carrozzeria Ghia后来的首席设计师，

当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。

它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。

在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。

它采用了与其原型Vallelunga相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载Ford V8引擎。

掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。

这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
And the high-performance version of that Golf I is the GTI.

Considered wide at the time, its 175/70R13 tires were covered
 by a special black plastic lip.

Red molding inside the front grille, the GTI had subtle hints
identifying its true nature...

...which made it all the more stylish.

When it comes to hot hatches,
this is a car that I still would like to own.
zh:
而Golf I的高性能版本就是这款GTI，

Golf I GTi采用的175/70 R13轮胎在当时被视作宽胎。
设计师特意在轮胎上方增加了一道别致的黑色塑料轮眉，

配合环绕前格栅一周的红色条纹设计，
隐约透露着GTI的本质……

令其更显风采卓然。

在高性能掀背车中，
这是我一直想要收藏的一辆车。>

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.

Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.

It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.

The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.

That term also serves as the nickname for this car.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame./
zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。

它就是W194，也被称为300SL。

它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，

还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。

此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，

由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。

其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Classical yet elegantly refined, this car is truly
a stunning work of art.

The body is designed by Carrozzeria Touring...

Which had already experimented with a modern
‘pontoon’ shape and integrated fenders.

What made the 8C2900 different...

Was its classic design, which accentuated
its large, sweeping fenders.

Not only did it make a statement among
the Alfa Romeos of its day...

It continues to grab the attention of modern
Italian car enthusiasts.
zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。

然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。

当然，这一设计元素也被其他Alfa Romeo车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多Ferrari还要吸睛。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
For a car that came two generations
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness."

Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,

and the design theme is simple yet bold.

The flush surface of the side glass and body around
the door section was an American design trend at the time.

You coud say that the Z32
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,

The super wide-and-low body proportion
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.

If you look at the design flow it does deviate
from the "Z story",

but the level of refinement of its design
is truly outstanding.

That's why the car is still so popular.

And here's an interesting fact:
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,

 was carried over to the Z33.
zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。

车身的起伏曲线十分克制，

用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。

侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……

体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。

与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……

但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。

如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，

但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。

这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。

另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.

Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.

The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.

In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……

250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。

在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。

宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。

从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。

无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口，
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，

都让人记忆犹新。

可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……

实现了难能可贵的平衡。

也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...

...to showcase Porsche's
latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.

The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.

The dual rear exhausts exiting through...

...the rear upper cooling grille

looks like a jet pack...

...and is really exciting!

You can also see the production version of
the four element LED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.

Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see
these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches

Another favorite area of mine was...

...the interior design with the high bridge center console.

This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.

The design language and style
has worn well over the years.

A bit restrained to the eyes
compared to other competitors.

But still well received and
a popular edition to a super car collection!
zh:
918是作为保时捷的旗舰型号来设计的……

是为了充分展现
这家公司最新的设计基因和未来将采用的先进科技。

其设计风格预示了保时捷之后几代车型的设计路线。

穿过车尾上部冷却格栅的……

两根排气管，

整体看起来就像背着一个喷气背包……

令人感觉很酷！

此车还采用了量产版的四点式LED大灯和LED框架式尾灯。

这些元素和形状设计语汇，都在下一代保时捷车型中得到了沿袭。

918还有一点是我非常钟爱的……

就是内饰设计中如引桥般高高矗立的中控台。

这项设计早在2003年的Carrera GT上就出现过，
但这次经过了重新构思。

这些设计语言和风格随着时间的打磨已经变得圆熟，p�
尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。

但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。.

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.

Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.

The shape tapers in every view.

 The stance is set up
 with just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.

The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。

仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。

让它在各个角度都显得凌厉利落……

前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。

此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.

Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...

A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.

Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!

Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.

Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.

So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.

But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
zh:
看着这辆Audi，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……

只领先了第二名的Peugeot13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。

在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！

虽然Audi在速度上胜过了Peugeot一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。

Peugeot充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。

所以，单圈时间极其优秀的Audi始终没能将Peugeot甩开。

但最终，还是Audi的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430
wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upon a coupe body!
zh:
这辆雷克萨斯SC430是丰田为……

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。

在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。

顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其实是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。

换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500其实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition
at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!

After taking down reigning champ Audi
at the 2009 race...

Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win,
and set to improving their 908.

And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed
in the top qualifying positions!

What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat
the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.

But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour
endurance race.

All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track,
and were forced to retire.

Which goes to show that endurance races are really not
just about speed but also the strength to carry on.
'
zh:
在2010年度的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，
标致908 HDi FAP宛如一支离弦之箭，速度快到惊人！

在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……

标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。

后来，参赛的四辆908直接包揽了排位赛的前四！

而且就连第四名的标致都领先第五名的奥迪整整两秒以上。

然而，要赢得24小时耐力赛并不是那么轻而易举的事。

事与愿违，标致的所有参赛车都在赛道上
遭遇了困难，最终被迫退赛。

这也表明了一点——在耐力赛中，重要的不仅仅是速度，
坚持到底的耐久力也非常重要。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.

It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.

In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...

It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.

Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...

This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.

For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
zh:
AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的
可靠性而在业界闻名。

在GT3组别的参赛车辆当中，它无疑是一位明星选手。

2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……

在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。

AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……

但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。

SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
In touring car races and rallies...

Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.

Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!

But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...

They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!

Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...

It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!

It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……

一直以来代表Renault出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。

像是WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！
都是数一数二的好车！

再往上一个级别，就轮到Mégane了？

好吧……Renault为了推动自家举办的Mégane杯，
确实是使出了浑身解数！

虽然外表与其公路版本极其相似……

但实际上这是一辆单一车种专用赛车，
搭载与Nissan联合开发的中置3.8升V6引擎！

另外，这台车原本打算参加的是在欧洲举办的高人气比赛
——Renaul Sport系列赛。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Carroll Shelby made it his life’s mission to trounce
Ferrari at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

The first attempt he made was, of course,
in the famed Shelby Cobra.

However, as the open-bodied Cobra was lacking in terms
of high-speed aerodynamics...

Shelby turned to designer Pete Brock
for a body overhaul.

In return, Brock handed him back
the Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.

However, by then, Shelby had given his attention to
the development of the Ford GT40.

So this Cobra Daytona Coupe really only raced
for a fleeting two years...

In 1964 and ’65.

Only a few Shelby Cobras were ever produced--I'm
jealous of anyone who gets their hands on one!
]
zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比毕生的宿愿
就是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中完胜法拉利。

他的第一次尝试当然就是这辆声名斐然的Shelby Cobra。

显然，Cobra的敞篷车身缺乏高速时所需的空气动力学性能……

于是，谢尔比向设计师皮特·布洛克求助，
对车身进行了大幅修改。

布洛克交付给他的便是这台Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe了。

只不过，此时谢尔比的注意力已经转向了福特GT40的开发。

因此这辆Cobra Daytona Coupe的赛车经历
只有短短的两年……

即1964和65年。

Shelby Cobra的制造数量极为有限——
真是嫉妒那些能搞到一辆的幸运儿！
'

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.

The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…

And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.

In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.

By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?

It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increases
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!

It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!

This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.

Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。

放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……

也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。

在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。

顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？

它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎的燃料量，以提升车速！

同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！

这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。

在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.

This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!

Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.

Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine
made its debut in 2019.
zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！

突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？

答案就是……丰田和本田！

这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。

没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！

虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。

得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。

在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!

Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.

In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!

Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...

The great potential of this machine.

Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.

Speaking of Tajima-san...

His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.

Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
zh:
这是第二代的Swift Sport啊！

因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。

事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！

Suzuki用两个冠军头衔证明了……

这辆车的巨大潜能。

这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田嶋伸博创办的日本公司。

说起田嶋先生……

他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。

在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于Suzuki Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.

When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
"The Supra is back at the track!"

Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!

Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...

They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.

Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.

And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。

当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”

Toyota真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！

在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和FIA GT-4级别规格的Supra。

此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。

六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！

speaker: Kim Jones
role_zh: 时装设计师 · Dior 男装艺术总监
en:
Well it seems like you really enjoy collecting cars?

I tend to collect things I love myself,
so I know exactly how you feel.

I'm the Artistic Director of Dior Men's collections.

And, I'm always thinking about new, novel things.

Recently, I came up with an idea about a new collaboration.

The initial thought came from advertisements
involving cars and Dior from the 1960s to the 1980s.

At the time, Dior had a line of perfume that sponsored races
like the Dakar Rally and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

And I thought to myself, what if we could combine
the elegant essence of Dior with a legendary sports car?

I was sure it would result in a phenomenal sports car
that would surprise everyone!

And, I had a particular car in mind
that would be perfect for this collaboration.

It was the iconic De Tomaso Mangusta from the 1960s.

The De Tomaso Mangusta
was designed by Giugia�o during his years at Carrozzeria Ghia.

He's a genius who entered the world of car design at 17 years
of age, before becoming the chief developer at Ghia at just 27.

I've heard that Giugiaro's father was an artist.

So, I guess the styling ability of Giugiaro
also comes from the artist's lineage in him.

Now, I realized that there's a similarity between the timeless,
classic atmosphere of the Mangusta and the tone of Dior.

Therefore, I selected a slightly conservative, cream color for the
Mangusta, accented with a modest but chic stripe...

...with the “Dior” lettering on the side.

The car number 47 was derived from the year of the
first Dior collection, in 1947...

...and all these ideas came to life in the project with
Gran Turismo, resulting in this very special car.

There's also a some special magic to this Mangusta as well.

I designed a sp2cial racing outfit for the driver of this car.

The suit is yellow, a very iconic color for sports cars.
It stands out, but it's not too flamboyant.
The logo representing Dior uses the classic "CD Diamond"
taken from the same era as the car, from the 1960s and 1970s.

The shoes are from our well known "Diorizon" series.

But the upper side is changed and newly redesigned for driving.

It would make me very happy if this becomes
one of the surprises in yo6r collection!
zh:
嗯，看来你们很喜欢收藏汽车？

我也会收藏一些自己喜欢的东西，
所以很能明白你们的感受。

我现在担任迪奥男装系列的艺术总监，

所以我一直在思考新鲜、新奇的事物。

最近，我突然想到了关于一个新合作项目的好点子。

最初的灵感是来源于迪奥在上世纪六十到八十年代间的
汽车合作广告。

当时，迪奥有条香水产品线为达喀尔拉力赛
和勒芒24小时拉力赛等比赛提供了赞助。

于是我就在心里盘算，如果把迪奥的优雅神韵
和一辆传奇跑车相结合会是怎么样的结果？

一定可以打造出一辆划时代的跑车，让所有人惊叹！

我脑海中就浮现出一辆非常适合这个合作项目的汽车。

二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。

德托马索Mangusta Ghia工作时
设计的。

他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。

我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。

所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。

我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。

因此我为它选择了一个稍有�+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，

然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。

车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。

我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。

伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。

我为它的驾驶者也设���了一套特别的赛车装备。

赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。

赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，

但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。

如果这辆车能��成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
In many respects this ND Roadster is a product
that I put alot of effort into.

The car I started competing in races with when I was into
motorsports as a student, was the NB Roadster.

Later I would buy an NR-A version of the ND Roadster
and compete in one-make races,

but what I focused on most as the designer of the ND roadster,
was how it looks on the move.

It had to look good racing on a track, and in order
to create the base structure that would achieves this,

I kept imagining its form exiting a corner with
the load on its rear tires,while working on its design.

Today I'm competing in Japan’s Super Endurance series
as both the team manager and driver of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING.

I actually race in a Roadster with this very livery, and we're
lucky to have many other roadsters participating in this class.
Whether it be real or virtual, I hope we can all enjoy
racing on the track, as challengers with the same goals!

And I hope you'll keep up with the latest activities
of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING, too.
zh:
我曾经为设计这辆ND Roadster
付出了极大的精力和时间。

我从学生时代起就是狂热的赛车迷，
还驾驶着NB Roadster参加过正式比赛。

再后来，我买过一辆NR-A版本的ND Roadster
去参加马自达举办的单一车种比赛。

在设计这款ND Roadster时，我最重视的一点
就是它在运动中所表现出来的模样。

也就是说，要让它在赛道上显得特别炫酷。
为了实现这个目的……

我在设计它的外观时，始终在脑海中想象
一辆重心后置的赛车出弯的模样。

目前我正在以马自达SPIRIT RACING车手以及车队经理
的身份参加日本的超级耐久系列赛。

我驾驶的其实是一辆采用同样涂装的敞篷跑车，
能与这么多同组别的其他敞篷跑车汽车竞技真是太幸运了。
不论赛道是真实还是虚拟的，
我希望大家都可以作为志同道合的挑战者，共同享受比赛的乐趣！

我也希望你可以多多关注马自达SPIRIT RACING的最新动态。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.

At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.

This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear.

These extraordinary creators...their visions have
profoundly shaped the automotive world.

They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in.

They fly in the skies where technology and design are free,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.

And the creator becomes a hero.

The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian,
 Flaminio Bertoni.

Unfortunately, his existence became
widely known only after his passing.]
zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。

在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。

然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。

这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。

他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。

他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安全落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。

而创作者则成为了英雄。

1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。

令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.

It dominated the Touring Car championships
in Italy and Europe.

This limited, "mean" version of the new Giulia sedan fully
captures its original spirit and exuberant performance.

The design also shows its sportiness with a big front grille,
wide fenders and carbon-fiber aerodynamic elements.

Even the Alfa shield is made of carbon-fiber!

And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut,
like on real race cars.
zh:
GTA是“Gran Turismo Alleggerita”的缩写，
它是传奇的1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint的公路赛车版本。

后者曾主宰了意大利乃至全欧洲的房车锦标赛。

这款“用料节省”的全新限量版Giulia轿车完全把握住了
原车型的精髓和卓越的性能。

在外观设计上，更是以巨大的前格栅、宽挡泥板和一大堆
美观的碳纤维空气动力学组件忠实再现了Sprint的运动感

——甚至连Alfa车标的盾徽也是由碳纤维制成的！

硕大的20英寸合金轮毂中央还参照真正的赛车
单独增加了中心螺栓。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but it was very fresh.
zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。

他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。

在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。

它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。*

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.

Until then, carrozzerie such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.

In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.

This is a product from that time period.

It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted well back...

allowing for a long bonnet and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
zh:
经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。

在此之前，Ferrari的车身大多交由Vignale、Ghia
和Zagato等车身制造商打造。

从1950年代中期起，Ferrari与Pininfarina深化了合作，
二者联合打造的作品也越来越多。

这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。

它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……

因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，座舱则恰到好处地
位于后轮的前方。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.

Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?

Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving
around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.

This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。

其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。

这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。

两辆车是不是都非常诱人？

尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……

即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。

它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。

这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。

正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they
strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.

Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the 800cc 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."

Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.

Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha,
a Toyota subsidiary company...

...played a central role in this design.
zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……

不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。

基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量800cc的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。

尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。

为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
In the Japanese automobile world, performing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.

But it is carried out quite well here.

The way the windscreen blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.

This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.

What has noticeably changed is...

A more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.

However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective.
zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。

不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。

它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。

新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。

最明显的改变在于……

更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。

这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This is a design that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.

The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...

Were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.

This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.

However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.

This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.
zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱BMW之前的设计语言，带来革新。

它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班格尔在BMW工作时所设计的……

在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。

此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。

其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。

可以说，这是一台反映了BMW设计思路演变的车。\

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular.

The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but
it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.

It was an affordable super car...

So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many
owners enjoyed tuning their car to their own tastes.
zh:
De Tomaso Pantera在美国依然非常受欢迎。

Pantera车型最初由Ford开发，却拥有多处
强烈的意大利超级跑车特质。

而且是一辆价格相对较为实惠的超跑……

所以许多车主并没有将他们的爱车束之高阁，
而是按照自己的喜好进行改装。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.

From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.

I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。

从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。

我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。]

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This Daytona Cobra is no doubt Pete's signature creation.

It looks like a complicated design...

But the surface areas are clean, making it simpler and more
sophisticated than you might think.

That's why the more time passes, the better it looks.
zh:
这辆Daytona Cobra毫无疑问是皮特最具代表性的作品。

它的设计看上去有些复杂……

车身表面却异常简洁。要同时保证这样的简约与繁复，
需要花费超乎你想象的设计流程。

正因如此，它的外观才能够随着岁月的推移而常看常新，
令人回味。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.

Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...

Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.

However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.

Even the Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.

The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...

While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.

The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.

The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression�
It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.
zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。

特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……

负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。

与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。

这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自意大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。

它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……

从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。

从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。

这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
This is originally a machine meant for the track,
so it's not street legal.

But the design has not been compromised one bit.

It conveys an expression of violent performance combined
with the classic beauty that defines Aston Martin.

Having these attributes simultaneously gives
this car a Jekyll-and-Hyde design quality.

From a nose that looks like it's about to eat the car ahead
to the low skirts and the underside of the rear diffuser...

A strange power resonates from the tissues and internal
organs that make up this carbon-fiber machine.

They speak plainly about the origins and intent
of this car.

The British-style understatement of the DB series is
something that transcends eccentricity.

It is the glorious madness that defines today's
Aston Martin.
zh:
这辆车原本是专为赛道设计的比赛机器，
所以并不能合法在城市道路上行驶。

尽管如此，它的设计并未作出丝毫的妥协。

这辆车结合了暴力的性能和经典的美感，
也是阿斯顿马丁赖以成名的品牌特点。

两者的结合让这辆车呈现出
如同化身博士般的古怪质感。

从它那看上去就像是要把前车吞掉的车头
到两侧的侧裙，再到夸张的后扩散器……

组成这辆碳纤维怪兽的“肌肉组织”和“内部器官”
迸发出一股奇异的能量，

也开门见山地阐述了这辆车的血统和其设计意图。

DB系列那英式的低调和不动声色已经无法用另类形容。

也正是这种孤芳自赏的疯狂个性，
让今日的阿斯顿马丁依然能够屹立在汽车之林。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.

However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.

In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.

They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at 400km...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?

It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.*
zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。

不过我总感觉这种风格和“coda tronca”（断尾）
的设计有些不搭。

在Veyron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。

这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的Delage D6。

美观到有些浮夸的法系设计，
外加能够达到400km极速的超跑定位……

让现代版本的Bugatti充满了魅力，对吧？

在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.

The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.

It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.

This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.

It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。

我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。

其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。

它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。

全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。

在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。

它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。`

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.

They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.

They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。

这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。

宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。

赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。

而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。

在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details.

It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.
zh:
真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。

没有任何花哨的表面或细节。

它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.

Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...

...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。

与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。

和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和FIAT 500不同……

这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代FIAT 500的现代化演绎。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.

But in a very fresh, contemporary way.

This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.

Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
zh:
这辆2016款Camaro设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代Camaro……

但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。

这个版本的Camaro设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。

车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于Corvette。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
Everything about The Camaro ZL1 says speed and power.
It’s practically a weapon on wheels.

From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!

And the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.

Its dark bonnet, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.

In two-tone colouring, it's all business. Period!
zh:
这辆Camaro ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！

从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！

这辆Camaro ZL1拥有比其他的Camaro型号更宽的轮距。

涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。

它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars,
and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.

My favourite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was the
beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.

It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get the
same colour treatment as that of the front bumper.

Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.

They would make the design look more balanced
and athletic.\
zh:
Pontiac GTO就是美国肌肉车之王，
而这辆GTO 'The Judge'则是终极的GTO。

我对这辆1969款GTO 'The Judge'最喜爱的一点就是
它那雕塑般硬朗的车身侧线条与柔和的挡泥板上部的交融。

这里有个小小的遗憾，它的后保险杠并没有采用
与前保险杠相同的喷漆颜色。

除此之外，这辆车唯一欠缺之处就是需要更大的轮毂。

大尺寸的轮毂可以让它整体看上去更平衡、更具运动感。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a
front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.

The ZR1 is sometimes known as ‘The Widebody’.

It’s significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray
in order to accommodate its massive tyres.

The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.

These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers
in the nose and tail of the car.

Most people love the rear wing.

But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also
available..
zh:
这辆C7 ZR1 Corvette是前置引擎Corvette那强大性能
和粗犷设计的终极例证。

这辆ZR1有时也被爱称为“The Widebody”（宽车身）。

为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款Corvette Stingray要宽出许多。

ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……

用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。

许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。

不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。[

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。

这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。

在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……

于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.

The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya,
which specialises in tuning rotary-powered machines.

Although it's not exactly a 'hashiriya', or ‘street racer,’
it's nevertheless captivating.

It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
zh:
这辆FD3S Mazda RX-7虽然推出于1991年，但即便
到了今天，它依然在美国年轻人当中拥有不少粉丝。

它拥有简单而无懈可击的设计。

这辆公路车的外观设计诞生在Mazda的加利福尼亚州
设计工作室，由俣野努主导完成。

眼前的这一台则是由专攻转子引擎调校的公司
RE Amemiya改装后的版本。

尽管严格来讲它并不是一辆“街头赛车”，
但依然非常迷人。

至少，你在《跑车浪漫旅》中应该试驾一下它。$

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=
zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。

马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。

在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。

时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

Was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

So you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and
that year this car took the title, winning 5 of 9 races.

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

The following year, in 2008, the NSX's highlight was a 2nd-
place finish in the 8th race of the season at Autopolis.
zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……

……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。

NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，

所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。

GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，

在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜利。

因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。

在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.

After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.

It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.

That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
was something special!

It was a V-12 with 1495cc of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
125cc, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.

What’s more, weighing in at 215kg, this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!

Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?

But if you give it some thou�ht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.

By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.

Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.

The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is 2300m above sea level.

The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.

In designing the RA272’s powerplant, former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...

...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.

The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!
zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。

在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……

它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。

1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。

事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！

这台排量为1495cc的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！

更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有125cc，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。

除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为215kg，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！

你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？

但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。

通过将引擎横向放置T��可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。

本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。

由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，2300m

低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。

在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……

就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞�9对手前抢占了先机。

而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！

所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
In 1983, after a 15-year break, Honda returned to Formula 1 racing.

For the next 10 years, until it retired again in 1992,
it dominated the competition like no other.

In 1984, a year after its comeback, a Honda-Williams machine
claimed a victory at the American Grand Prix.

The driver of that car was none other than Keke Rosberg,
winner of the 1982 F1 Drivers’ Championship.

Man, did he look super cool when it came time for him
to ascend the podium.

In any event, the successor of Honda-Williams’ impressive machine
was this McLaren MP4/4.

McLaren began powering its machines with Honda engines
in 1988.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, it claimed
the championship that year.

The man responsible for designing the MP4/4 was genius
race-car designer Gordon Murray.

In addition to having a low center of gravity, the McLaren
MP4/4 was equipped with Honda's 1.5-li�er RA168E engine.

This turbocharged engine normally produced at 685 horsepower,
but it could be boosted to a maximum 1500 horsepower!

Apparently, the car had trouble with fuel economy,
but Honda’s brilliant engineers found a way to deal with that.

Indeed, they managed to produce the best F1 engine
of the day.

McLaren’s F1 results for the 1988 season were nothing short
of astounding.

To start, they won 15 of 16 races that year!

They al�o claimed 15 pole positions, ten 1-2 finishes,
and ten fastest laps.

And with 199 Constructors’ points, they finished
139 points ahead of the second-place team.

When it came to Drivers’ points, Prost had 87 and Senna
had 90, handing him his first Drivers’ title.

This historic win for Senna took place at the Suzuka Circuit
in the Japanese Grand Prix.

It was such a glorious win Soichiro Honda supposedly
said, “If only every day could be this greatv”
3
zh:
1983年，阔别赛场15年之后，本田回到了F1的赛场。

在接下来的十年里，本田彻底主宰了赛道，
直到1992年再次退出。

1984年，在本田归来一年后，本田-威廉姆斯车队的赛车
在美国大奖赛上取得了胜利。

夺冠车手正是1982年F1世界锦标赛总冠军得主——科克·罗斯伯格。

天啊，那位老兄登上领奖台的样子酷得不行。

紧随其后，延续本田-威廉姆斯优雅胜利
的是这辆迈凯伦MP4/4。

迈凯伦在1988年开始选用本田引擎作为他们赛车
的动力单元……

并与两位车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特一起，
一鼓作气夺得了制造商冠军。

负责设计这台MP4/4的人是F1天才工程师戈登·穆雷。

除了低重心设计外，迈凯伦MP4/4
还搭载了1.5升本田RA168E引擎。

这台涡轮增压引擎的标准功率就]��685马力，
但还可以通过增压提升到最大1500马力！

显然，这辆车的油耗会是个难题——
但本田出色的工程师们迎难而上，成功克服了这项艰巨的任务。

事实上，他们制造出了当时最出色的F1引擎。

迈凯伦在1988年赛季取得的成绩惊天动地。

这么说吧，他们赢下了那年16场比赛中的15场！

他们还拿下了15个杆位，在10场比赛中完成一二带回，�
以及创造了十次最快圈速。

最终，他们获得了199分的制造商积分，
足足领先第二名139分！

在车手积分方面，普罗斯特拿下87分，而塞纳拿下90分，
获得了他的第一个世界冠军。

塞纳的这次历史性胜利就发生在日本大奖赛的铃鹿赛道上。

这场胜利是如此的辉煌，以至于我仿佛还能听到
本田宗一郎说：“如果每天都能如此精彩就好了！”
P

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Ah, the 1973 Porsche 911 Carrera RS...
What a legend! What a treasure!

This precious gem was designed to compete
in touring car races.

Touring car races are specifically for modified
production cars.

The extent to which a car can be modified
is heavily restricted by FIA guidelines.

But transforming high-performance road cars into
pure race cars...

...is serious business for many automakers, and it has
led to the some really special machines.

These cars are known as homologation models, which
means they meet FIA requirements for competition.

When the FIA revised its world championship regulations
in 1973...

...Porsche was approved to compete in Group 4 (Gr.4)
of the Grand Touring competition.

The 911 Carrera RS was the homologation model designed
to conquer this Gr.4 class.

The road-going car was made lighter and more powerful
than the standard 911...

...and served as the base for the competition-tuned
911 Carrera RSR!

When the 911 Carrera RSR made its debut in March 1973
at the 12 Hours of Sebring in Florida...

...it turned heads with a dazzling 1-2 finish!

After that, it continued to perform well at
the world championship series!

It even came out on top against more powerful rivals at
major races like the Daytona 24 Hours and Targa Florio.

That season was simply mag�ificent, as it scored a well-deserved
world championship title!
zh:
啊，1973款保时捷911 Carrera RS……
好一个传奇！好一颗瑰宝！

这款保时捷的掌上明珠是专为参加房车赛而设计的，

后者是专为公路车改装赛车设立的比赛。

尽管其改装程度受到了国际汽联准则的严格限制……

但打造一台可以轻易改装为符合
赛事规格赛车的高性能公路车……

依然有许多汽车制造商将其视为工作的重点。
也因此，许多出类拔萃的高性能车应运而生。

这类汽车被称为“赛事认证车型”，
代表它们符合国际汽联的比赛规格要求。

当国际汽联在1973年修订其世界锦标赛规则时……

保时捷被批准参加房车赛组别4（Gr.4）级别的比赛。

这台911 Carrera RS正是为征服组别4级别赛事而设计的赛事认证车型。
这款改装后的公路跑车比标准版911更轻、动力也更强劲��

并成为了竞赛规格的911 Carrera RSR的原型！

911 Carrera RSR于1973年3月在佛罗里达州的
赛百灵12小时耐力赛上首次亮相……

就以包揽前两名的惊人战绩让所有人眼前一亮！

此后，它继续在世界锦标赛的各项系列赛中发挥出色！

它甚至在戴通纳24小时耐力赛和塔格·佛罗热等重大比赛中
力压性能更强大的对手并脱颖而出。
对于保时捷来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季，
也是属于当之无愧的世界冠军的胜利！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold
way it tore up the race track!

It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer
that was active before its official release.

In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in
a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.

A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a
stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.

In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races,
such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.

Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and
had established itself as a major player in motorsports.

The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a 791cc-engine.

This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing
well into the 1970s.

At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports
support department for S seri�s competition racers.

This initiative would later result in the creation of the
Racing Service Center (RSC).

Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a
division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.

Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda
and Japan’s racing history!
zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！

它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。

1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。

一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖赛的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。

同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林500km赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！

在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。

1966年，这款由791cc引擎驱动的S800发布。

并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。

当时�7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。

这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。

可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first
true super car.

It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.

Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element.

Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares
and that big rear wing was...

...the humbleness of Clark Kent.

It was a success story from the time it made its debut
at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.

The 911 truly presented the 1970s for Porsche.

But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?

That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life
into the model.

Of course, we know this now in hindsight.

The original 930 had a long and strong production run
from 1975 to 1989...

...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.

Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic
unto itself.

In fact, this script is still being used by�Porsche today
on all subsequent Turbos.
zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！

它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。

毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！

这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——

它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。

自从在1973法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。

911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。

不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。

这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。

当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。

初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……

然后�3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。

另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。

事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.

Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.

The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.

As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……

保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！

这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……

算是保时捷相当激进的一步！

早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……

一款基于933的中置引擎911 GT1。

这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……

它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。

尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！

就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……

“周日一胜，周一大卖！”

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The ’55 Porsche Spyder Type 550/1500RS is the icon
of all Porsche Spyders.

It was a minimalist car stripped of all but what is needed.

Its organic, functional form was designed
by Erwin Komenda.

He was the body designer for all the Auto-Union "Rennwagens,"
as well as the VW Beetle and Porsche 356.

He really was the chief architect of the early Porsche
and VW design DNA.

Stylistically, the Spyder Type 550 is similar to
a 365 Speedster.

That said, it is much more capable, with its mid-engine
chassis and aluminum body.

The rag-top roof actually serves no real purpose,
except to meet the letter of the rule book.

It’s as if Porsche was saying to the regulators,
"Look, it has a roof!"

In addition to a diminutive body
and short wheelbase...

...it has an extremely low cowl/beltline
with just an aero screen.

Incidentally, the Porsche Spyder Type 550
was given the nickname "Giant Killer."

This is because, in the right hands, it was capable of
beating much more powerful and faster machines.

Indeed, it was a popular car for sportsmen or works drivers
looking to win a class victory or compete in a road rally.
zh:
这辆1955年出品的保时捷敞篷type 550/1500RS是
所有保时捷敞篷车型中最具标志性的一款！

这辆车采用极简设计，剥离了一切非必需的元素！

它那浑然天成、功能实用的外形是由
艾尔文·柯曼达设计……

这名车身设计师也是汽车联盟所有“赛车”车型
以及大众甲壳虫和保时捷356的创造者。

可以说，他就是早期保时捷和大众设计DNA
的主要构建者！

从外观上看，敞篷type 550和365 Speedster非常相似。

不过前者采用了中置引擎布局和铝制车身，性能也更出色。

它的帆布车顶其实并不具备实际功能，
只是为了符合规则的要求而已！

就好像保时捷在对规则监管方说：“你们看，我有车顶哦！”

除了截短的车身和短轴距之外……

它还拥有极低的风罩�u腰线，
并且只采用了埃尔罗斯林风挡。

保时捷敞篷type 550获得“巨人杀手”的昵称
则是个意外之喜！

这是因为在技术高超的车手驾驭下，它可以击败
性能更强、速度更快的车型！

毋庸置疑，这是一辆人气极高的赛车，可以帮助竞技车手或
厂队车手赢得赛事胜利或加入公路拉力竞赛的争夺。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.

Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.

This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...

...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。

它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。

后轮的“管装”风道线条……

和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.

That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...

Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。

低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……

一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favourite Japanese cars of the early ‘90s.

One thing that has always impressed me about it
is the quality of its shape.

Specifically, the slight 'S' curve in the side profile,
above the wheel of the front fender.

This gives a very delicate and sensitive finish
to the surface modelling and reflections.
zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

它最让我印象深刻的一点就是外观风格。

具体来说就是它车身侧面轮廓中，前挡泥板轮圈上方
略微呈现出的“S”弧线。

这一细节为车身的立体造型和光线反射添加了
精妙而感性的一笔，起到了画龙点睛的作用。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.

Its design was inspired by...

...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this...

...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.

But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...

...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...

...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……

他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。

这辆车的设计灵感来源于……

1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。

这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。

另外，你还可以从中看到

1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：

例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。

不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。

不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……

车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……

以及哑光黑色的下部车身。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the Audi RS5 Turbo DTM, the legendary double-title
winner of the 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM)!

First held in 1984, the DTM is a race series
predominantly featuring German automakers.

While DTM regulations have varied from time to time,
the 1990s were known for race cars with crazy top speeds.

Heavily modified cars and the latest technology made the series
“the fastest touring car race in the world.”

In 2019, Class 1 regulations were introduced, which were
near-identical to those of Japan’s Super GT GT500 class.

This Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was one machine built to
meet the new Class 1 regulations.

The plan at the time was to unify the DTM and Super GT
