technical regulations...

...and in 2019, joint-series races between the two organizations were actually held!

Afterwards, the DTM switched to a GT3-formula, bringing
an en� to a truly unified series with Super GT.

In any event, this Class-1 Audi RS5 Turbo DTM from 2019,
which competed in those joint-series races...

...is, without a doubt, one of the most notable cars
in DTM’s history.
zh:
这是一辆传奇般的奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM，2019年
德国房车大师赛的双料冠军！

德国房车大师赛首办于1984年，主要由德国汽车制造商参赛。

尽管德国房车大师赛的规则在其漫长的历史上经历了无数次变更，但到了
九十年代，这项赛事主要以其疯狂的高速获得世人关注。

高度改装的汽车配合顶尖科技，使这项赛事
成为了“全世界最快的房车赛”。

在2019年，这项赛事引入了“组别1”规格，
与日本Super GT的GT500组别规格相仿。

这辆奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM就是专门为
符合“组别1”组别所打造的比赛机器。

当时的目标就是统一德国房车大师赛和Super GT的技术规格……

而且在2019年，这两项赛事甚至真的举办了联合赛事！

在那之后，德国房车大师赛转变为GT3形式，放弃了
与Super GT合并的计划。

尽管如此，这辆在举办联合赛事的2019年推出的
组别1奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM……

毫无疑问是德国房车大师赛历史上最重要的冠军车之一。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Porsche Carrera GTS is hailed as one of the most
beautiful cars of the 1960s.

It is also known as the Porsche 904.

A mass-produced sports car, its design and mid-engine chassis
were clearly built to win races.

As soon as it rolled off the production line in 1964, it set
out to dominate in every race it entered.

Its performance at the famous Targa Florio in Italy
is well known.

The Targa Florio was a road endurance race in Sicily
consisting of a 72km track that was lapped ten times.

Competing in the Targa Florio’s GT2 class in April 1964,
the Carrera GTS...

...bested its rivals Ferrari, Alfa Romeo and Ford, claiming
an impressive overall victory.

The drivers who piloted the Carrera GTS were Antonio Pucci
from Italy, and Colin Davis from England.

In the same year, the Carrera GTS also won class victories�
at Sebring and Le Mans.

A year later, in 1965, it won again at the
Targa Florio and elsewhere.
*
zh:
保时捷Carrera GTS被誉为二十世纪六十年代
最美的汽车之一。

它还有另一个名字——保时捷904。

作为一款量产跑车，它的设计和中置引擎底盘
很明显是为了赢得比赛而设计的。

当这款车在1964年开下生产线后，它立刻
就向全世界证明了自己的实力。

这辆车在意大利的塔格·佛罗热大赛上的杰出表现举世闻名。

塔格·佛罗热大赛是一项在意大利西西里举行的公路耐力赛，
需要跑完十圈共计72公里。

这辆Carrera GTS于1964年4月参加了
塔格·佛罗热大赛的GT2组别……

击败了法拉利、阿尔法罗密欧和福特等对手，光荣地赢得了总冠军！

完成这一伟大成就的车手是来自意大利的安东尼奥·普基
和来自英格兰的科林·戴维斯。

在�+�一年，Carrera GTS还赢得了赛百灵12小时耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

一年之后的1965年，它又气势汹汹地杀回塔格·佛罗热大赛
和多项其他比赛，并再度夺魁！
_

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Porsche 959 is perhaps best remembered for its
performance at the Paris-Dakar Rallies of the 1980s.

The Paris-Dakar Rally...

...was a race that stretched for more than 10,000km,
from Paris, France, to Dakar, Senegal.

A course spanning vast deserts and mountainous terrain,
it was considered the toughest rally in the world.

Porsche’s first success at the event was in 1984,
a year before the 959’s official debut.

Driver René Metge pulled off a marvelous overall victory
in a 911 fitted with a developmental 4WD system.

A year later, in 1985, Porsche entered the race with a 959, which
combined 4WD and a twin-turbo engine.

However, it wasn’t until ’86 that the 959 had an overall
victory at the rally, once again thanks to René Metge!
zh:
保时捷959最值得铭记的大概就是它在二十世纪八十年代的
巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛上的杰出表现。

巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛……

是一项从法国巴黎前往塞内加尔的达喀尔，
行程超过10000公里的拉力远征。

其赛道横跨广阔的沙漠和山脉地形，
被誉为世界上最艰苦的拉力赛。

保时捷在这项赛事中拿到的首冠是在1984年，
959正式亮相的前一年……

当时雷内·梅杰驾驶着一辆安装有实验性四驱系统的911，
英勇地夺下了总冠军。

一年之后的1985年，保时捷终于派出了959参赛，
同样采用四轮驱动系统和双涡轮增压引擎的搭配。

不过959要等到1986年才拿到了总冠军，
而这一次夺魁的车手还是雷内·梅杰！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.

One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.

Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that
premium identity to new heights.

This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆Toyota Alphard。

这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。

自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，Alphard
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……

而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。

这辆Executive Lounge版本是第三代Alphard的顶配，

配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。

以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。

另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,
Japan's top-level formula race competition.

All teams participating in Super Formula must use
a race car with the same chassis.

Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine
built by either Toyota or Honda.

That effectively makes Super Formula
a one-make race series.

In such a contest, victory is largely decided by a combination
of individual skill and team strategy.

This is one of the major draws of Japanese
Super Formula races.

Super Formula machines are distinguished by their
aerodynamic design...

...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear
and sides of the body.

Because these machines are so similar in capability,
the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.

The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,�
promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!
zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。

所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。

并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。

因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。

在这样的比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。

这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。

超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……

致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。

由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。

到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^��拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！
"

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.

The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.

At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!

This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.

It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downforce than before.

Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.

While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...

...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。

初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。

在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！

我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。

经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确保可以提供超强的下压力！

而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。

除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……

这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……

以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.

The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.

The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.

Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.

Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.

For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...

...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.

After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。

据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。

在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式赛车领域。

为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。

学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Jaguar XJ220 is celebrated the world over as one of
the most unique super cars of the 1990s.

It began as a pet project for several Jaguar engineers
and designers...

...who, together, worked off the clock.

It is for this reason that the team that made the XJ220
came to be known as "The Saturday Club."

You might say that this car represented the free expression
of lofty ideals held by Jaguar employees.

Once the prototype was unveiled, it attracted attention everywhere,
leading to official development and production.

Combining the beauty of Jaguar’s legendary 1960s race cars...

...with the performance of its 1990s race machines...

...built by the experts at England’s most storied luxury car builder,
the XJ220 was a car like no other.
zh:
捷豹XJ220被全世界车迷誉为
二十世纪九十年代最独具魅力的超级跑车。

这款车最初只是几名捷豹工程师和设计师的私人项目……

在工作之余进行研发。

正因如此，打造XJ220的团队也后人被称为“星期六俱乐部”。

可以说，这辆车充分地代表了捷豹员工
对于自己理念的自由表达。

这台原型车甫一亮相，便立刻在全世界范围内造成了轰动，
也让公司下定决心，开启正式研发并投产。

这台车结合了品牌六十年代传奇赛车的优雅造型……

以及九十年代赛车的超强性能……

还有英格兰那历史悠久的豪华车制造专业知识，
可以称得上是绝无仅有的珍宝。

car: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that
Alfa Romeo ever produced.

Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars
to compete in grand prix races.

So, they’ve long had the technical know-how
to build high-performance engines.

This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered
by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.

Combined with a rear-wheel-drive layout, it’s an absolute
thrill to ride.

And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight
GTA model, too.
zh:
朱丽叶竞速是阿尔法罗密欧旗下的最受欢迎的汽车之一。

由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以
它也被称为“朱丽叶轿跑”。

这是一辆世界闻名的跑车，由天才汽车设计师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀设计。

阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。

因此长期积累了制造高性能引擎所需的技术知识。

这辆朱丽叶竞速虽然个头不大，但它由一台强大的
直列四缸双凸轮轴引擎驱动。

加上后轮驱动的加持，绝对能够带来刺激的驾驶体验。

而且这辆车也是超轻量级GTA车型的开发基础车型之一。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
From the moment of its birth, this Aston Martin Valkyrie
was already the stuff of legend.

It is the child of a British sports car brand with over
a century of history and Red Bull Racing.

The aerodynamic elements were penned by one of the greatest
designers in F1 history—Adrian Newey.

But wait till you hear about its 6.5L naturally-aspirated
V12 engine...

Which is capable of outputting 1000ps at 10500rpm!
It’s an otherworldly engine deserving of an F1 machine.

And yet, believe it or not, this car is street-legal!

It is the greatest sports car currently conceivable by
an F1 partnership made in heaven.
]
zh:
打从降生的那一刻起，这台阿斯顿马丁Valkyrie已经具备了
成为传奇的素质。

它是英国百年老牌跑车制造商和红牛车队携手合作的产物。

它的空气动力学元素由F1历史上最伟大的设计师之一
——阿德里安·纽维操刀设计。

但是别以为这就完了，听听它那6.5升自然进气V12引擎的轰鸣……

它能在10500rpm下产生高达1000ps的动力！
你可以说这是一台跨界引擎，就算安装在F1赛车上也毫不逊色。

而且，信不信由你，这车居然还能合法上路！

它是目前与F1专业知识结合得最完美、最棒的跑车。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.

NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.

Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。

NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。

事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。

只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo."
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.

This is the Evo III, the third-generation model.
It's a car with a storied history.

It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win
his first WRC drivers title in 1996.

Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive
drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."

He was truly a legendary rally driver.

And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally
car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.
@
zh:
每一个拉力赛的车迷都对“Evo”了如指掌！
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution就是有这么出名。

这台是Evo III，第三代车型，有着一段传奇的历史……

当Mitsubishi的王牌车手，托米·马基宁在96 WRC上
赢得首个车手冠军时，驾驶的便是这辆车。

此后，马基宁驾驶着不同迭代版本的“Evo”
拿下了车手冠军四连胜！

他是拉力赛史上的传奇车手！

而助他走上荣耀之路的正是基于这台
Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III开发的拉力赛车。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.

The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more
evident than in this 2004 model.

Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.

This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!
zh:
这是一台二代Subaru Impreza STi。

在日本，Impreza STi和Mitsubishi Lancer Evo是
一对有名的宿敌。

第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。

注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。

此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。

毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的Impreza！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~
zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆Jaguar D-Type……

与过去的Jaguar截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。

从XK120到XK150，Jaguar一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。

在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但在55年和56年却大获全胜，
在Jaguar的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。

这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...

...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.

That was this E-Type.

Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.

It’s truly a thing of beauty!
zh:
为了推出一辆能与D-Type赛车争辉的新赛车，
汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……

为Jaguar带来了极其富有空气动力学、现代感
和动态感的设计理念。

促成了E-type的诞生。

虽然搭载了一台十多年前的XK150的引擎，这台单体车壳赛车
仍然是一台彻头彻尾的现代赛车。

它真是一件无与伦比美丽的造物！`

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.

The over-fenders and long nose which were added
to the ZG variant...

They actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it
a more ‘aggressive’ charm, so to speak.

Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
zh:
毫无疑问，Nissan S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。

我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。

它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……

在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，

同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure
from the Ford GTs that came before it.

Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization
of pure aerodynamic performance.

From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to
breaking the GT mold...

...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
zh:
在设计上，Mark IV与过去的Ford GT截然不同。

光从车身和侧面剖视图来看，就能充分体现其纯粹为空气动力学性能
而作出的优化。

从此刻开始，Ford展现了突破GT风格桎梏的决心……

目标是创造出完全不同的纯粹赛车。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.

Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.

Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...

Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。

2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。

该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……

扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。

其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。

该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。

作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.

This machine is a 1951 Ford.

Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact,
and the body itself has been made thinner.

The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.

The car creators pulled off in real life what designers
today would only attempt on a computer screen.

Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the potential
for customization unlike those of today.

Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your
own sense of beauty and experience into it...

...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.

Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the
tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.

Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the
showrooms, which one do you think stands ou� more?
zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。

这是一辆1951年的福特。

它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。

它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。

这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。

与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车辆易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。

找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……

就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。

这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。

与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...

...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.

But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.

And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.

It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.

With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.

If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...

...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。

有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”

相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具进攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……

那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备三角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.

With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...

A tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.

This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!
zh:
Lexus LC500的车身比例十分惊人。

它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距

和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……

外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。

它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对Lexus经典款式的重新演绎。

整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！\

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Ah, 1953—an unforgettable year! That was the year that gave
us the "C1," or first-gen Chevrolet Corvette.

And so began the age of mass-production sports cars
in the United States of America.

While sports cars were already stateside, they were mostly
European—and if not, they were rare and costly.

In other words, a truly "American" sports car had yet to be born.

Then General Motors released the Chevrolet Corvette.

From 1953 on, this roofless 2-seater pretty much underwent
yearly upgrades, each time promising more and more power.

This C1 Corvette is from 1958, and is well-known
for its major design overhaul.

Two headlights became four, and the hood was given
a number of fake louvres.

By the time 1960 rolled around, GM was selling many C1s,
a sign of its enduring popularity.

To this day, the Corvette remains�synonymous with
American sports car culture...

...making it one of the most important sports cars
in automotive history.
zh:
啊，1953——令人难忘的一年！
在这一年，“C1”，也就是第一代的雪佛兰科尔维特诞生了。

这也标志着美国量产跑车时代的开端。

虽然当时跑车在美国已不少见，但这些跑车大多数来自欧洲。
而非欧洲跑车车型就更加凤毛麟角，而且价格高昂了。

换句话说，真正“美国”产的跑车还没有诞生。

就在此时，通用汽车发布了雪佛兰科尔维特。

从1953年开始，这辆无顶双座跑车几乎每年都要进行更新，
而且每次的动力都变得愈发强大。

这辆C1科尔维特来自1958年，因其设计上的重大更改而闻名。

两枚大灯增加到四枚，引擎盖上增加了几处伪百叶格栅。

到了1960年，通用汽车的C1产量仍然可观，可见该车型
经久不衰的人气。
直至今日，科尔维特仍然是美国跑车文化的代名词……

这令它成为了汽车历史上最重要的跑车之一。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.

The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse,"
meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend
built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.

Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has
been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the 250F to sports cars like the
A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.

Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much
these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return
to the track!
zh:
Maserati MC20是一台2020年的中置跑车。

它的名字将“Maserati”和意为“竞速”的“Corse”
与发布年份相结合。

此前，Maserati曾为2004 FIA GT锦标赛打造了传奇车型MC12，
此车可以视作其继任者。

自从二十世纪早期成立以来，Maserati一直以赛车享誉世界。

从250F这样的F1赛车到A6GCS这样的跑车，
可以说是取得了数不胜数的成就。

近年来，虽然Maserati较少涉足赛车竞速领域……

但这台基于MC20开发的赛车无疑标志着它荣归赛场！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 represented the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.

Yet the addition of 4-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the "Lunchbox," it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.

The year 1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that differentiates it from the pack.
zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。

1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.

The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.

If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。

这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。

如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the ‘B.A.T. 1’.

But when I consider its round body section
and dual front air intakes...

Its many design links to B.A.T. 5, 7 and 9 become
clear as day.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that runs down
the centre of the car are another case in point.

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,
joined Bertone as its chief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.

The first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.
zh:
我之前不知道Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。

柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼
也体现了这一点。

设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

这款车就是他奇思妙想的产物。

作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。

car: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56
speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...

...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."

The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.

With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...

...and longer rear deck...

...the Speedster has attitude.

Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.

Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.

The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.

You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.

The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.

And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.

As with all Por�ches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.
zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……

又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！

Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……

低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……

还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！

詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的座驾。

这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。

前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。

你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。

GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……

甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。

保]��捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.

This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.

It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...

...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.

The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual difference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.

When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were gorgeous too!=
zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。

名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。

在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……

后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。

由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所所以外观上并无差异……

只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。

内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，

那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。

只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！

你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成��打造得异常精美！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a fixed-roof coupe
body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

This, to me, was when design, engineering, and motorsports
came to the perfect intersection for Audi.

Seeing these "Star Wars" coupes in the rain at night,
with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...

Man, that was exciting to watch!

I see them as advanced concepts for the road
that I can relate to.

They were truly a tour de force of technology!
zh:
2011款Audi R18 TDI LMP1标志着自1999年推出的R8C以来，
Audi再次引入封闭式双门跑车车身。

对我来说，这款车是Audi的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！

在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！

我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...

...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.

It was truly a tough undertaking!

The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...

...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.

The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...

...because the previous Mustangs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.

The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.

The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!

The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.

It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.

And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……

是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。

这确实是一个艰巨的任务！

他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……

但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。

新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……

前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个进气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。

相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。

前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！

经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……

并采用了受到'67/'68 Shel�y启发的顺序闪灯效果。

在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a 343ps 3.8-liter V-6.

The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.

The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.

This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.

In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出343ps的3.8升V6引擎。

外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。

其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。

在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。

在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
I’ve always liked the design of the McLaren MP4.

It’s bold, aggressive, but not over-the-top.

Much like the McLaren 650S, all of the design elements
work in harmony, making for a very consistent design.

I love the side intakes and the graphics on the rear,
including the cool exhaust shape and location.
zh:
我一直非常中意McLaren MP4的设计。

它大胆不羁、具有侵略性，但又不过分张扬。

就像McLaren 650S一样，所有的设计元素协调统一，
形成了和谐的风格。

我喜欢它侧进气口和车尾的效果，包括酷炫的排气管造型和布局。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The McLaren 650S has classic mid-engine proportions,
executed in a very fresh way.

It has a very bold and distinct face,
as well as a strong rear.

All of the shapes, curves, plan views, and overall profile
work together...

Highlighted by the side scoop and side glass shape.
zh:
McLaren 650S拥有经典的中置引擎比例，
但以一种非常新颖的方式呈现。

它的前脸大胆而独特，车尾设计也风格鲜明。

从车身造型、曲线、表面效果到整体轮廓，无不协调融洽……

侧进气口和侧窗玻璃形状更是将这一特点重点凸显出来。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Peugeot RCZ GT is a very creative design,
with styling much like a show car.

It’s sporty, youthful, and elegant in its execution.

The silver arched roofline-rails and double bubble-roof
panel look very much like a concept vehicle.

Also, the design of the front and rear gives you
a feeling of security.
zh:
Peugeot RCZ GT采用了创意十足的设计方案，
造型形似展示车。

它既富有运动性、年轻气息，又展现了优雅的格调。

银色的车顶立柱弧线和双泡形车顶玻璃面板
更像是概念车的专属。

此外，车头和车尾两处的设计也给人一种安全感。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
This car probably has the most dramatic profile
of a modern front-engine sports car.

The bonnet is long and low, and the cabin is placed well back
on the chassis, right over the rear wheels.

One of my favourite design features is how the front fender
vents are linked to the shape of the door opening.

Overall, the SLR McLaren has the look of speed,
grace, and elegance.
zh:
在现代前置引擎跑车中，这款车可能是车身比例
最吸睛的车型之一。

它的引擎盖修长而低矮，车厢后移置于底盘后部，
正好位于后轮上方。

前挡泥板通风口与车门门缝衔接的神来之笔
绝对是我最喜欢的特色设计之一。

总体而言，SLR迈凯伦展现出了速度、优雅
和风度兼具的外观。<next id=2302406 type=9

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.

The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.+
zh:
我认为这辆小巧的FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。

特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。

这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……

特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The same goes for the red stripes, scorpio badges, and the
light wheels, transforming it into a race car.

But above all, some details are striking, such as the
rubber locks for the hoods.

The rear-hood was raised to improve cooling,
and "Record Monza" chromed double exhausts were added.
zh:
再加上红色条幅、天蝎徽标和轻量化车轮，
这些改动令其摇身一变，成为了一辆赛车。

那些令人尤为印象深刻的细节也十分吸引眼球，
比如引擎盖上的橡胶锁……

还有为了改善散热而抬高的后引擎盖，以及
“Record Monza”镀铬双排气管。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.

First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.

This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflected in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!

Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.

Another memorable oddity...

...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。

它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。

首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。

其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。

这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制造商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，

成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！

特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……

这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。

另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……

是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Maserati Gran Turismo...

...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness
by Pininfarina.

The long hood, set-back cabin...

...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.

These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis
of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.

That said, there were elements that renewed the
historic identity of Maserati’s design.

Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.
zh:
Maserati Gran Turismo……

是Pininfarina对意大利风格和运动性的经典诠释。

修长的引擎盖、后移的车厢……

和紧凑的车尾都是一眼就能认出的特征。

极具辨识度的车身各部位比例是GT系列
典型的动态平衡的综合体现。

尽管如此，车上还添加了一些非常有Maserati风格的元素……

比如前轮后方的三个小小的通风口。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.

Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.

Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blocks created space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.

At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F430
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。

它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。

此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……

以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。

它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。

车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。

在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……

这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.

Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.

Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectangular daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.

The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recalling the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behind the rear wheel,
and the enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。

尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

但实际上它采用了当时最受欢迎的308 GTB的设计，
不过稍微拉长了车身，以适应更长的轴距。

它的主要特征包括大面积的前导流板和四颗矩形日间行车灯……

以及盖住硕大轮毂的宽大轮拱。

挂在保险杠下方的变速箱被左右四根圆形排气管夹在中间。

每每看到，都让人觉得惊艳。

唯一能让人回想起那款经典GTO的细节……

是后轮后方的三道标志性斜向通风口，和车尾部
超大号的“鸭尾”扰流板。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.

Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.

Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.

The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...

...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.
zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。

它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。

充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。

硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。

尽管如此，Renault还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……

因此借鉴了量产版Mégane的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。&

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This here is the 7th generation
of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough
Nürburgring track in Germany.

Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there
during its development.

Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver
came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well
"in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes
and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news,
they were shocked.

Honda later built its own test track based on
the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.

This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.
zh:
这是第七代思域Type R。

我听说它在德国以挑战难度最高而著称的纽博格林赛道上
创下了惊人的圈速记录。

说到本田的跑车和纽博格林赛道……

第一代NSX在研发期间就选择了在那里试驾。

传闻称，在首次试跑之后，试驾员给出了
一个“奇特”的负面评价，

说这辆车在“空中”的表现不佳。

这并不让人意外，因为纽博格林赛道以其起伏的路面
和许多“飞越”而闻名。

然而，当本田的工程师们听到这个消息时，还是感到十分震惊。

之后，本田在日本北海道建造了一条以纽博格林赛道为原型
的测试赛道，

该赛道被命名为“鹰栖试车场”。

这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran
Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!

Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona,
and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.

The custom parts are genuine JDM!

From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of
Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.

Built to excel at time attacks, its chassis, engine and
transmission were tuned to perfection.

You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox
and 400ps of turbocharged power.

I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...

...built it piece-by-piece with his son Jesse.
zh:
哇，这就是那台Garage RCR思域，
2017年美国汽车用品改装车展览会跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！

“Garage RCR”指的是亚利桑那州凤凰城的一家车身工厂，
“思域”则是指这辆改装车的原型车'92 EG思域。

它所有的定制部件都是纯正的JDM（为日本国内市场生产）！

从宽体套件到前引擎盖，都是从品类丰富的日本改装件中
专业甄选出来的。

为了在计时赛中获得出色的成绩，它的底盘、引擎
及变速箱都经过了精心调校。

五速序列变速箱和高达400马力的涡轮增压引擎
绝对震撼。

据说这辆车是由它的主人飞利浦·罗伯斯与
他的儿子杰西一起……

逐个零件亲手组装起来的！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
A car with more than 50 years of history and over fifty-million
units sold worldwide...

Is there any other car that can make such a claim
than the Toyota Corolla?

It’s a brand that has surely made memories
for countless of people everywhere.

The GR Corolla is a sports car built by Toyota’s
GR division.

What’s more, this model was a special variant penned by
Toyota’s master driver Morizo!

To reduce weight, the rear seats of the base 5-seat model
were removed.

It also featured a specially-tuned engine and transmission.
Without a doubt, this genuine sports car is sure to please.
zh:
超过50年生产历史和全球销量超过五千万辆的记录——

除了丰田卡罗拉，还有哪款车能够
拥有如此辉煌的战绩？

这个品牌无疑给世界各地的无数用户留下了美好的回忆。

这款GR卡罗拉是丰田旗下GR品牌出品
的一款跑车。

更重要的是，这是由丰田的大师级赛车手“Morizo”
亲自设计的特殊版本！

为了减轻重量，这款5座基础车型的后排座椅被全部移除。

此外，它还配备了经过特殊调校的引擎和变速箱。
毫无疑问，这款纯正跑车一定会带来愉悦的驾驶体验。
+

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.

This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...

...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.

The result? A refined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.

The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...

...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the now legendary E-Type.
zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。

这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。

在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……

以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……

捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。

其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥有优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——

XJ13。

XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……

尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
为E-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British racing car
designer Tony Southgate.

In 1988, it competed at the World Sports Prototype
Championship.

Among its six victories was a legendary show at the 24 Hours
of Le Mans...

Which was Jaguar’s first Le Mans victory since 1957!

The XJR-9 also won the Teams Championship...

And driver Martin Brundle won the Drivers title.

No doubt, the XJR-9’s purple paint job is now known
to one and all!
zh:
Jaguar XJR-9是由英国赛车设计师托尼·索斯盖特
所执笔设计的。

1988年，这款车参加了世界原型跑车锦标赛。

它一共取得过六项冠军，其中最传奇的表演
在勒芒24小时耐力赛上上演。

那也是自1957年后Jaguar首次在勒芒夺魁！

XJR-9赢得了车队冠军……

而车手马丁·布伦德尔赢得了车手冠军。

毫无疑问，这款XJR-9紫的涂装现如今已经举世皆知。'

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is a beast!

It's a "well-executed beast," with a bold and purposeful design
that emphasized functionality!

The SRT Demon is a very intimidating
modern day muscle car...

...with bold fender flares and hood scoops...

...as well as deep-offset wheels that say power—
lots of power!
zh:
这辆Dodge Challenger SRT Demon绝对是最凶猛的野兽！

SRT Demon是一辆开发得当的性能机器，
采用了激进但目的明确，强调功能性的设计，

是一辆令人望而生畏的现代肌肉车。

它的挡泥板和引擎盖进气口相当粗犷……

缩小偏距使得轮毂外凸，传递出令人无法抗拒的力量感，
而它也确实拥有与外观匹配的性能！

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical ‘Gallardo’.

And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.

Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.!
zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallardo”。

然而，Huracán很好地展现了Lamborghini在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。

它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款Lamborghini上看到。

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.

It’s a car for connoisseurs.

With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...

...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.
zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。

这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。

它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……

实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.

As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."

The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...

...while the back is recognized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...

Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodynamic efficiency.
zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。

如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。

它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。

前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，

而后部则能清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。

但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……

它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...

Starting with the new V8 engine.

It is also an evolution from a ‘style’ perspective.

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.

The large double-oval front air intakes...

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.

And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights
add to its aggressive look.
zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……

首先是一台全新的V8引擎。

从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。

虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。

它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……

灵感来源于1961年的Ferrari 156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。

四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。+

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The ‘DS’ brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.

However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.

Aiming instead at a French ‘chic’ imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.

And the ‘shark fin’ of the central pillar, represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
zh:
“DS”是由PSA集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的Citroën DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。

然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。

专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。

我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression
of a ‘2-seater Formula 1 Ferrari’.

The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit
of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.

The front wing/splitter, and all of the intakes
and air exits are impressive.

I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward
of the rear wheel which deflects air from the rear tyre.

As you walk around to the rear,
it’s all serious business.
zh:
Ferrari FXX K给我一种“次级别F1 Ferrari赛车”的印象。

车身塑造得非常有进攻性，几乎每一个部件
都是为速度而设计的。

从前翼/定风翼，再到所有的进气口及排气口的处理
都令人印象深刻。

特别打动我的是紧靠后轮前方的这个小翼片造型，
它的作用是偏转气流，使其远离后轮。

沿着车身漫步到车后，眼中所及都是匠心独运的设计。\

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.

It literally makes you smile.

It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.

This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...

...windows that go round to the back corners,
and "panorama" windows on top.

Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.
zh:
VW的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！

不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！

它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。

这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……

以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。

而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.

The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.

With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evolve again.

But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.

Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, and it’s still popular!<
zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！

这个车型加大了前后车窗。

第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。

在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。

而到了这个车型中……

出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状轮廓又一次发生了进化，

但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。

最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。

你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！

这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.

The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...

...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.

However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...

...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。

Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……

还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。

不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……

此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。

从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。

这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。

与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。

car: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Lancer Evo is one of the most boring Japanese family
sedans to have been transformed into a racing beast.

It’s a mild-mannered nobody turned superhero...

The kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.

So what might the ‘super powers’ of this car be
from a design perspective?

Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grilles!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armour.
zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。

它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……

不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。

那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？

还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！

所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\

car: Renault Sport Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy '16
speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Renault Clio RS is an icon of Europe’s
"Supermini" segment.

The Williams version of the original series is remembered
with particular fondness.

Like its forebears, this RS version of the fourth-series model
combined extreme sportiness with quiet urbanity.

In terms of design, this car has sportiness in its DNA.

Its muscular shapes, aggressive front, and the concealed
rear-door handles in its C-pillars...

...give one the impression of a two-door coupe.

Thanks to this, the sportier bumpers, aero details, and low
stance with 18-inch wheels and red calipers...

...are sufficient to visually transform it into a little
racing "weapon."A
zh:
雷诺Clio RS是欧洲“超迷你”类型
中的标志性车型。

第1代中的Williams版本尤其受到
广大车迷们的喜爱和铭记。

和前代车型一样，这款第4代的RS版本也完美综合了
极致的运动性能和安静的都市驾乘体验。

从设计上讲，这款车的确具备运动的基因。

它采用了充满肌肉感的外形、极富侵略性的前脸，
并将后门的把手隐藏在C柱之中……

给人以双门跑车的观感。

基于这种设计，再加上运动感十足的保险杠、空气动力学细节
以及应用了18寸轮毂和红色卡钳的超低姿态车身……

足以在视觉上将它充分改造成一款赛道小钢炮！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine
subframe with pushrod suspension.

The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche
lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineered to meet RUF’s performance standards.

The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while
the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.

Elsewhere, the six rear vents provide a clue to the 700ps
twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.
zh:
这辆如虎CTR3的灵感来源于
柯曼达保时捷550勒芒轿跑……

它的外观设计历久弥新，至今依然能够打动消费者。

这是如虎首次使用他们自己的全碳纤维
车身设计打造一辆车……

并采用了针对比赛开发的全铝合金后中置引擎
副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。

其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

并为了满足如虎的性能需求而经过重新加工。

其超低设置的驾驶舱也使车头高度降至极低，
同时由后扰流板提供高速下的操控性和下压力。

此外，其车身后部的六个排气管也让人得以一瞥它那基于梅茨格打造的
700ps双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎的恐怖动力。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
This is the car every car designer dreams of doing!
It’s gorgeous!

Its influence is, of course, the 917!

The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward
architecture, like that of the original 917.

The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping
around the sides...

...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.

A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...

...and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche
headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.

The wheels are similar to the 918.

The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender
forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.

The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...

...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.
zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！

这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！

和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。

挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……

前脸略微透露出918的血统。

其略显克制且低窄的进气口……

和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。

它的轮毂与918类似。

其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。

它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……

“保时捷·萨尔茨堡�&917K。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is one of the most
recognisable sports cars in the history of automobiles.

Overall, it has a look of ‘refined speed,’ and deserves
all of the acclaim it receives.

The 300 SL has some great shapes...

Take, for instance, its bonnet, fender eyebrows, sloping
tail, and beautifully executed roof and windows.

One of its most distinct design elements are its gullwing
doors, which I think look even better when closed.{
zh:
Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé是汽车史上
最具辨识度的跑车车型之一。

总体上看，它便是“精致速度”的代表，
完全配得上它所获得的一切赞誉。

300 SL的轮廓中融合了一些美轮美奂的形状……

比如它的引擎盖、挡泥板上缘、下倾的车尾
以及设计精巧的车顶和车窗。

它最特别的一处设计元素就是它的
鸥翼车门，而且我觉得门关上之后甚至更好看了。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its centre fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.

This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look, and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windscreen and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
zh:
这辆GT by Citroën概念车带来了令人惊诧的设计。

它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。

这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。

挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by Citroën呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?

The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。

从第二代车型开始，Prius采用了从车头到
“断尾”（coda tronca）车尾的一体成形轮廓……

这随后就成为了Prius产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.

In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.

Powered by an inline-6 mounted mid-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.

In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。

其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……

并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。

它由一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，

也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。

除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.

And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the structure.

A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.

In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".

The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.

Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.

That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."

So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.<next id=2600206 type=9݇
zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。

我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。

设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。

你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？

所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。

我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后轮驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。

然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。

这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。

当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”

就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。

RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。

只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。

对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。

跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。

它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。

当我生出这个念头时，我就W��道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。

为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。

在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……

我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。

就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to
make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.

I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.

The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater,
during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.

I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic
battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari 512S.

It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future,
and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars.

Mazda won the Le Mans,

and that event naturally connected to that scene
of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.

But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene,
not just events of the past like the 787B.

I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.

In that �espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION
was a car that I really wanted to make happen,

and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.

This is something I created with the strong conviction,
"that this will be a real car in the future."

And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.
zh:
不瞒你说，当RX-VISION还只是张图纸的时候，我就已经
在盘算着有朝一日要让它征战勒芒了。

要知道，我不光是个汽车设计师，还是个赛车迷呢。

还记得我人生第一次自掏腰包买电影票，看的就是讲
勒芒24小时耐力赛的片子。

那会儿看到保时捷917和法拉利512S在赛道上激烈
厮杀，那个兴奋劲儿，到现在我都忘不了。

就是那时候，我萌生了自己也要去勒芒的念头，也是从
那时起，我下定决心要投身汽车行业。

1991年马自达在勒芒的那次胜利……

毫无疑问又一次点燃了我年轻时的梦想。

不过，我觉得我们不能老是躺在787B的功劳簿上。

是时候该为马自达的赛车史开启一页新的篇章。

这就是为什么我铆足了劲要打造RX-VISION的GT3版本……

虽然现在这辆车只在《跑车浪漫旅》（在此感谢游戏）里
作为一辆虚拟车首次亮相。

但我坚信，总有一天，我会亲自驾驶着它……在那条

传说中的萨森赛道上驰骋！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series,
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.

Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.

In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.

The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.

Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.

Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.

When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...

...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!
zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。

所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。

当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！

所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.

In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.

And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.

It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
zh:
MAZDA3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。

我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。

而MAZDA3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。

我个人很喜欢MAZDA3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

car: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.

I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,

but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.

And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.

Givender major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me,

but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.

It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,

and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.

And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,

but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,

I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.

To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.

As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...

And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector
of development at the time. A LOT.

At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,

and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.

It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.

Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.

The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design.

And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.

I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。

2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。

事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。

我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。

说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是把这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。

当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。

我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。

老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。

但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……

我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。

也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。

结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。

这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。

与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。

有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。

说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。

虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。

你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。

尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。

所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
This was a car that was produced with the concept:

"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans,
what would be a great design."

The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans,"
and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.

I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really
went through a thorough development process for this car.

We had engineers knowledgeable about racing cars
also become involved in the development.

There is a full scale model as well, and its on display
in the Mazda Museum.

And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.

It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs
on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.

The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow
a fair amount of design freedom...

and if we make a car like this and compete,
that would be a huge opport�nity!
zh:
这辆车回答了这样一个问题：“马自达要怎样设计，
才能在勒芒顶级组别的赛事中一争高下？”

LM55这个名字中，“LM”是“勒芒”的缩写，
“55”则是“55号赛车”，是向马自达的一位传奇赛车手致敬。

设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。

而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入了解的工程师支援……

我们甚至还做了个1:1的实物模型，现在就摆在
马自达博物馆里呢。

哦对了，你可能会发现车手名单里有我的名字。为什么？

因为要是有朝一日它真的能征战勒芒，我想亲自开上它！

勒芒超级跑车组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……

所以，要是我们真能造出这样一辆车去参赛，嘿，说不
定真能捧回^��军奖杯呢！

car: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.

The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.

The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.

I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。

那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。

虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。

这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。

车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上去给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。

正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。

这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。

这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。

要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设�。

当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。

正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.

Actually my children were born in the year
that the RX-8 was announced.

They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.

The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.

One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't
open the rear
doors without opening the front doors.

So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors

To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors
and with proper space for 4 people,

is actually very difficult.

There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.

It would be great to design something again
with this package and engine one day.

There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.

There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.
zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。

实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。

我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。

RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。

虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有个特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。

这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。

说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……

不是件容易事。

能做到这一点的车真不多。

有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。

前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……

我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

speaker: Ikuo Maeda
role_zh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.

This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio
were designed simultaneously.

And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.

So when I first found out that I would be designing
the Demio I was really happy about it!
zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。

不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！

说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。

所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest
for the world’s most beautiful car?

Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful
Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.

The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over
the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.

The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer
to win this award.

Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not
only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.
zh:
你知道吗？在欧洲，每年都会举办一场评选
全球最美汽车的比赛。

2016年，Mazda RX-Vision凭借其卓越设计夺得了
“最美概念车”的殊荣。

这项赛事汇聚了来自世界各地的汽车专家，他们负责
从众多参赛车辆中评选出年度最具魅力的汽车。

RX-Vision是赢得该奖项的汽车中，首款由亚洲制造商制造的汽车。

设计师前田育男倾注心血的成果不仅在Mazda的历史上
留下了深刻印记，同时也对日本跑车设计产生了深远影响。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Who didn’t pay attention to the FIA GT Championship
when it launched in the mid-1990s?

Especially with all those incredibly cool Group GT1 machines!

This Mercedes-Benz CLK-LM from 1998 is a legend
of that GT1 category.

It was the successor to the CLK-GTR, which was built
in only 128 days...

...to compete in the 1997 championship.

Despite its short production time, the CLK-GTR really
tore up the track!

At the championship in 1997, it won six of 11 races, earning it
the coveted series title.

Appearing in the middle of the 1998 series was the CLK-GTR’s
evolution model—the CLK-LM.

With these two cars, Mercedes-Benz went on to win every race
of the GT Championship that year!
zh:
在上世纪90年代中期，国际汽联GT锦标赛的诞生引起了
无数人的关注。

特别是那些令人叹为观止的GT1级赛车，
让人简直挪不开眼！

1998年推出的这辆梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK-LM就
堪称GT1级赛车中的传奇。

CLK-LM是CLK-GTR的继任者。1997年，为了赶上当年的锦标赛……

梅赛德斯在短短的128天内就造出了CLK-GTR。

尽尽管时间紧迫，CLK-GTR在赛道上的表现却令人刮目相看！

在1997年的锦标赛中，它在11场比赛中6次告捷，
成功夺得人们梦寐以求的系列赛冠军。

而在1998年的系列赛中，CLK-GTR的演化版本
——CLK-LM也随之亮相。

凭借这两款赛车，梅赛德斯-奔驰在当年的GT锦标赛中一路称霸，
豪夺每一场比赛的胜利！

speaker: Shiro Nakamura
role_zh: 前日产首席创意官
en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.

The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.

This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。

车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以coda tronca的形式戛然而止。

我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
zh:
没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。

speaker: Sarah
role_zh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
en:
Oh, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
zh:
哦，那我解释下，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。>

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.

Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.

After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...

...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。

在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。

在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……

Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The Porsche 919 Hybrid first competed at the WEC in 2014,
if I’m not mistaken.

This is the 2016 model. The 2014 car had a white
paint job and stylish gray stripes across its body.

Viewed from above, the stripes spelled out the phrase
"PORSCHE INTELLIGENT PERFORMANCE."

Among its many design features was its multi-LED headlight
system, meant to improve night driving.

To implement it, the front wheel arches were
raised, along with the driver’s seat.

The 919’s historic 2016 battle against Toyota’s TS050 was one
that will not soon be forgotten at Le Mans.

Indeed, it marked the beginning of the car’s three-year
winning streak at the famous racing event.
zh:
如果我没记错的话，这台保时捷919 Hybrid
在2014年首次参加了世界耐力锦标赛。

这一台是2016款。因为2014年款采用了白色涂装以及
时尚感十足的灰色条纹，交叉纵横于其车身。

从上方看，这些条纹拼出了标语
“保时捷智慧性能”。

在其众多设计特色中，值得一提的是多LED车头灯系统，
该系统旨在提高夜间驾驶的性能。

为了实现这一设计，前轮拱罩被特意提高，
驾驶员座椅也跟着被抬高。

919 Hybrid与丰田的TS050之间激烈的2016年勒芒之战
是一个让人难以忘怀的经典时刻……

实际上，正是在这一战尘埃落定之后，该车
在这一著名赛事上开始了为期三年的连庄。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type
zh:
TS050 Hybrid是日本的骄傲，同时也是我
非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！

2016年，Toyota为旗下所属的GAZOO Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与Porsche 919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。

不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的Toyota赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。

不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，Toyota却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年Mazda787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

car: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.

This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.
The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.

Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded shape, while blister fenders were adopted.

Not quite the battle machine it used to be...

...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.

It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.

At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.

Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.

In this sense, they evolve like living things.

And that is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.
zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。

这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。

第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。

相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引人注目的凸起轮拱。

它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……

标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……

这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。

与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。

像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。

从这个意义上说，它们就像�生物一样在不断演变进化。

这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。

speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
role_zh: 高性能车设计师
en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.

The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。

我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得更加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！

代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我也变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，
以至于我的心脏不得不重新找地方安置。

“Mach 40”……是的，这就是我的新名字。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
The base V12 Vantage S was a more potent version
of the elegant V8 Vantage...

With a V12 engine and pronounced athleticism.

While this GT3 version may have swapped out elegance
for a full-blown 'performance' look...

It maintains those unmistakable Aston Martin proportions.
zh:
这款车型的基础版本就是一台V12 Vantage S，
相当于V8 Vantage的动力强化版……

搭载了V12引擎，和更为显著的运动特征。

而到了GT3版本，则基本舍弃了优雅，
取而代之的是全方位的“高性能”外观……

但仍保留了Aston Martin独特的车身比例。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.

A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.

This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.

I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。

作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，

从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。

我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
