Do you remember when the Toyota GT-One competed
at Le Mans in 1998 and 1999?

Well, I remember those spectacular races like it was yesterday!

And while Toyota may not have taken the overall victory
it was hoping for...

...it was doubtless the team that everybody expected to see
on the podium in 1999.

That year, Toyota entered three GT-Ones at Le Mans,
and they thoroughly impressed during qualifying!

Two of its cars took the 1st and 2nd positions, while the 3rd
started in P8.

The performance of the cars were simply awesome.

However, at the start of the race, the top two GT-Ones had
to retire—a reminder that anything can happen on the track.

This left Toyota with only the No. 3 car...

...driven by Toshio Suzuki, Ukyo Katayama,
and Keiichi Tsuchiya.

Having lost its top two cars, Toyota bet the farm
on this last hope of winning.

Initially racing on the defensive, Car No. 3
quickly changed its tactics, going on the offensive.

Picking up its pace, it miraculously set a course record
in the final part of the race.

Before long, it climbed to 2nd place, with the race-leader, BMW,
in its crosshairs.

But then—it burst a rear tire while traveling
at more than 300 km/h!

An attempt was made to continue, but an emergency pitstop
dashed Toyota’s dream of an overall victory.

After � tire change, Car No. 3 raced to a 2nd-place
finish that had all the world holding its breath.

This is why the GT-One has a special place in my heart,
even if Toyota has now become a Le Mans champion.
zh:
你还记得丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的飒爽身姿吗？

嗯，那几场精彩的比赛让我记忆犹新！

尽管丰田没能获得期待中的总冠军……

但毫无疑问，每个人都相信这支车队
是99年的夺冠热门。

在那一年，丰田将三辆GT-1赛车带到了勒芒，
并以风驰电掣的速度一路碾压排位赛阶段！

三辆车中的两辆分别夺得了第一和第二名，
而第三辆车排在第8名。

每辆车跑出的时间都不容轻视。

然而决赛甫一开始，两辆领先的GT-1赛车就被迫退赛，
也证明了赛道上一切意外皆可能发生。

于是丰田车队只剩下了一辆赛车……

由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的3号GT-1。

在损失了两辆前排赛车之后，丰田将赌注全部下
在了这台唯��的希望上。

3号赛车最初采取了守势，但很快便转守为攻……

并且不断加速，在比赛最后阶段奇迹般地
创下了赛道纪录。

很快它就攀升到了第二名，并将目标锁定在了
领先的宝马赛车上……

但接下来发生的事情让所有人惊掉了下巴
——在超过<300 km/h>的时速下，它的一个后轮发生了爆胎！

他们选择顽强坚持，但被迫紧急进站也剥夺了
他�赢得总冠军的梦想！

在更换轮胎后，3号赛车奋力追赶，让全世界
都屏住了呼吸，最终仍旧以第二名完赛。

这就是为什么即便现在丰田已经成为了勒芒冠军，
GT-1依然在我心中占据了非常特殊的地位。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.

Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.

It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.

Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.

This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.
zh:
Urus是Lamborghini设计的第一款SUV。

如今，人们通常会将Lamborghini与各种超级跑车
联系在一起，如Countach……

不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车……

是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。

它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。

自从1970年代起，Lamborghini曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车
和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。

看来Lamborghini从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！
这款Urus就是确凿的证明！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This is the second-generation Audi R8.
You can tell straight away because...

...the "side-blades" on the body are split into two
and the graphics are slightly more compact.

Then there’s the engine. This model only came with a V-10,
the most powerful being the "V10 plus."

Given how slick the car looks, you’d be surprised to know
how much oomph it has!
zh:
相信你第一眼就认出来了，这是一辆第二代Audi R8。

其车身上的“侧刃”分成了两片，整体图形
也变得更加紧凑。

另外还要提到全系列搭配的V10引擎，绝对不容小觑，
其中性能最强大的型号就是这台“V10 plus”。

这款车的外形非常利落，也会让你不禁想象
它的动力有多么生猛！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR homologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
and race cars greatly resembled each other.
*
zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。

在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。

这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……

能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。

事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。

为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……

总产量也不多。

在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。

的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Do you know the history of AMG?

It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.

When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.

They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!
zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？

它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。

当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。

他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design.

The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!

While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'
zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。

其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！

Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.

Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.

See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。

虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。

你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.

It feels expertly sculpted.

In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.

As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，Toyota的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。

它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。

为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。

最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。

speaker: Ed Welburn
role_zh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS is one of the most masculine
cars of the muscle-car era.

Everything about it says 'power', from its bulging shapes
to its muscular fenders...

To its power-dome, cowl-induction bonnet.

I liken the big-block Chevelle SS
to an animal ready to pounce.
zh:
这辆1970款Chevrolet Chevelle SS是肌肉车黄金时代
最富肌肉感的车型之一。

从它壮硕的车身轮廓到粗犷的挡泥板……

再到向上隆起、采用风帽导气设计的引擎盖，
每个细节无不散发出一种“动力澎湃”的感觉。

我会将这款大排量的Chevelle SS
比作一只蓄势待发的猛兽。

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!

It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.

Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...

...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!

Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.

And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.

Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.

And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.
zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的Beetle啊！

它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！

请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……

以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！

它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
Volkswagen专业设计团队的专属。

它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。

这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。

车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.

The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.

What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

For example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.

But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its roar is simply unforgettable!
zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。

从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。

你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。

你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗？

当然是更换改装引擎啦！

比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。

不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。

虽然动力不如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The NSX is a Japanese GT racer! This was proved at the 2000
All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.

Despite putting up a good fight...

It was unable to beat such powerful opponents as the Nissan
Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, come 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.

In this year, a team of five NSXs won four of seven races...

With Ryo Michigami, in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX,
winning the driver’s title.

This was the first time an NSX won in JGTC history.
zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。

尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。

在这个赛季，总共五辆NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……

而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。

这也是NSX在全日本GT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is one of my favourite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R no less!

Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car event of the 1980s?

It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC series.

It was this year that saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing...

of which Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!

What a way to win the series title!

And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars—
how cool is that!
zh:
这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R
还获得了A组别认证！

它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上
的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！

它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。

就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技……

其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车
赢下了六场比赛中的半数！

这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！

更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿——
真是太酷了！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.

The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European
and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’

Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...

It remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world still love to this day!
zh:
在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。

其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。

除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……

它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Yes, I can recall when this Volvo V40 debuted like it was yesterday.
It was in 2012, if I’m not mistaken.

It was a 5-door compact hatchback that exemplified
the company's dedication to practicality and safety.

What’s more, it had beautiful coupe-like styling.

I’ll have you know, this styling borrowed many design cues
from the great Volvos of the 1960s.

We're talking P1800 and 1800ES, for instance.
zh:
没错，我还依稀记得这辆Volvo V40首发时的情景。
如果我没记错的话，那是在2012年。

这是一款5门紧凑型掀背车，从头到尾贯彻了Volvo
那久经考验的实用性哲学。

此外，它还采用了雅致的双门轿跑外形风格。

我必须要告诉你，这种设计风格从来自1960年代的
伟大Volvo车型身上吸取了不少的灵感。

例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典Volvo车型！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.

Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!

Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.
zh:
Volvo V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……

尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design版本。

它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。

它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的Shooting Brake P1800 E……

而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。

真是非常了不起的灵感来源。

注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。

这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’Q
zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……

并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。

在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……

后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found
themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.

The 956 and its successor, the 962...

...dominated the global motorsport scene for years,
racking up numerous victories.

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most
successful sports-racing prototype ever created.

Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...

...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today
as when they first appeared on the track.$
zh:
任何玩过《跑车浪漫旅》的人想必都曾
至少驾驶过一次这款车型。

Porsche 956及其后继车型962……

在国际赛场上为Porsche赢得了长达数十年的胜利。

事实上，962C被广泛认为是有史以来
“最成功的运动原型赛车”。

它鲜艳的车身涂装，简洁的车身线条……

以及由两侧垂直尾翼支撑的大尺寸后扰流板，即使在
今天仍然充满魅力，一如初上赛道时那样令人印象深刻。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
To qualify the CLK-GTR, the predecessor of this CLK-LM,
for racing...

Mercedes-Benz was required to build 25 road-going cars for a few
lucky multi-millionaires.

Like its predecessor, the CLK-LM evolution had leather
upholstery and an air-conditioning system.

The dashboard, grille, headlights, and taillights
are similarly pleasing.

At the same time, it clearly maintains the design integrity
of its mass-produced CLK brethren.
zh:
为了使Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR，这款CLK-LM的
前代车型获得参赛资格……

Mercedes-Benz不得不生产了25辆公路车，
出售给少数几位幸运的超级富豪。

因此，和前代车型一样，这款称作CLK-LM的改款车型
也配备了真皮内饰和空调系统。

其仪表盘、前格栅、前大灯和尾灯的设计同样精致。

与此同时，它也明显保留了与其量产CLK系列车型
一脉相承的设计特征。[

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
The ‘Baby Lambo’ was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.

Unlike their super-car counterparts, the ‘babies’...

Are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.

The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
zh:
“Baby Lambo”系列的推出旨在拓宽Lamborghini品牌
的市场。

与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……

以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。

Gallardo就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.

The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.

Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.

Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...

...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。

中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。

事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。

升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。

凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……

它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.

Its design is simply iconic.

Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.

The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.

What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.<next id=2102306 type
zh:
Honda Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。

它的设计堪称经典。

其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。

这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。

更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.

Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.

However, the biggest difference is in the rear.

Here we have a large engine grille...

...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.

To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...

And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。

在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。

然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。

这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……

以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带包围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。

为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……

此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项。

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...

...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists
with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.

The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes
to evoke fluid and natural movement…

...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.

Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet,
and set-back cockpit.

The side profile is particularly stunning.

This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures
and light reflection.

Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer,
the flaming red livery...

...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s
beautiful sheet metal surfaces.
zh:
2015年东京车展上首次亮相的……

马自达RX-VISION概念赛车，凭借其复杂而流畅的整体
造型美学立即引起了设计专家们的热烈反响。

马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……

这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。

它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引擎舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。

车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。

这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。

其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……

进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。

car: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.

The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.

The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"

This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

A small bit of trivia!!.
zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。

翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。

这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。

主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。

你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字其实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。

在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！

这是个有趣的小知识！

speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The 2015 RUF RGT 4.2 is based on the Porsche 991,
with bespoke modifications to RUF specs.

Most noteworthy is the naturally-aspirated flat-6,
punched out to 4.2 litres...

And 525hp.

Visually, it is recognizable by its aluminium wheels
and wide wheel arches.

This gives it a great stance and a menacing look!

The rear ‘ducktail’ is of RUF’s own design…

And first appeared on the Rt 35 at the 2012 Geneva
Motor Show.
zh:
2015款RUF RGT 4.2是基于原版Porsche 991，
按照RUF规格进行定制改装的车型。

最引人注目的是其自然吸气水平对置六缸引擎，
排量增大到4.2升……

输出功率高达525马力。

在外观上，它以铝合金轮毂和加宽的轮拱为醒目特征。

这造就了车身出色的姿态和极具威慑力的外观！

后部的“鸭尾”扰流板是RUF自主设计的……

它首次亮相于2012年日内瓦车展上展出的Rt 35车型。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The W 196 R was an F1 powerhouse that took the international
racing scene by storm!

It made its debut in 1954, during the French Grand Prix,
or Race 4 of the World Championship of Drivers.

It was piloted by none other than Juan Manuel Fangio,
who had raced for Maserati up to Race 3…

...before he decided to join the newly arrived Mercedes-Benz
works team.

An Argentinian, Fangio claimed his first Grand Prix
title in 1951.

At the time, he was already one of the fastest drivers
in the sport.

Behind the wheel of the Mercedes-Benz W 196 R, Fangio proved
to be near-unstoppable.

He claimed two consecutive World Drivers’ Champion titles
in 1954 and 1955!
zh:
W 196 R是一辆席卷了国际赛车界的F1赛车！

它于1954年在法国大奖赛，也就是世界赛车锦标赛的
第4站中首次亮相。

驾驶它的是胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥，他在第3场比赛为止
还在为玛莎拉蒂车队效力……

随后决定加入新成立的梅赛德斯-奔驰车队。

方吉奥是阿根廷人，他在1951年赢得了自己的
第一个大奖赛冠军。

在当时，他已经是这项运动中最快的车手之一。

在梅赛德斯-奔驰W 196 R的加持下，
方吉奥几乎无人能挡……

在1954年和1955年连续赢得两届世界车手冠军！
]

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title
three years in a row.

It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill
of witnessing that incredible achievement.

Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC
in 1997!

The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car,"
and it was a new version...

...that allowed a wider range of modifications
permitted by Group A regulations.

Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza
was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.

But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!

In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...

...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds
in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.

This incredible performance led to the team taking home
its third consecutive WRC title.

The Impreza WRC continued to ev�lve
until the year 2000.

It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an
important part of WRC history.
zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！

我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。

同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！

世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……

相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。

翼豹原本是一款四门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。

但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！

在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队

在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。

惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。

这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984
season, at the Tour de Corse.

Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the
latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.

From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!

The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies
in its innovative engineering.

It was the first Group B rally car to feature all-wheel drive
and a mid-mounted engine.

This machine was a true gamechanger!

In the blink of an eye, it took the crown from the Audi Quattro,
the reigning front-engine 4x4 champion.

It then went on to claim consecutive WRC titles
in 1985 and 1986!
'
zh:
标致205 T16在1984赛季的第5场比赛——
科西嘉岛拉力赛中首次亮相世界拉力锦标赛，

只获得了第4名。

但在赛季的后半段，它主宰了比赛，
赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。

从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！

205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。

它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全轮驱动的拉力赛车。

是汽车革命的全方位体现！

它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……

并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总冠军！

speaker: Hideo Kodama
role_zh: 前欧宝设计师
en:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come
to mind are the rally-bred A110...

...and the long-tailed M Series
of Le Mans fame.

The Alpine A220 was built to comply
with Group 6 regulations...

...introduced by FIA in 1968.

However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory
results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.

This model is the rally version, instantly recognizable by
its truncated tail.\
zh:
说到Renault-Alpine赛车时，我脑海中浮现的两款车
分别是拉力赛出身的A110……

以及剑指勒芒耐力赛的长尾M系列。

Alpine A220是为了符合1968年
FIA引入的Group 6规则

而制造的。

然而，由于未能在勒芒取得令人满意的成绩，
它很快退出了争夺。

我们眼前的这款是拉力赛版本，从它被截短的尾部
就可以看出。

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.

It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.

But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.

How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deliver!
zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，索伯梅赛德斯C9
就已经有些过时了。

毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。

这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以汤姆·沃金肖赛车-捷豹……

日产、丰田和阿斯顿马丁为代表的车型就是例证。

而索伯C9仍然坚持全铝结构。

但这并没有阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。

它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？

这都要归功于梅赛德斯自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！

确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现的胜利！

speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The McLaren P1 is a special edition plug-in hybrid
from British automaker McLaren Automotive.

It features a carbon-fiber monocoque with a roof
structure called "MonoCage."

It’s the successor to McLaren’s legendary F1.

But the P1 carves out its own identity with a fresh,
organic design language.

And, to enhance aerodynamics
on the track...

...This GTR features a large front splitter, aggressive
side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.
zh:
McLaren P1是英国汽车制造商McLaren Automotive推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。

其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“MonoCage”的车顶结构。

尽管设计灵感来源于McLaren的传奇F1赛车……

但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。

此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……

这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。

car: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
speaker: Kunihisa Ito
role_zh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.

Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.

Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.

And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.

With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.

But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
zh:
Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。

它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。

其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。

它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。

speaker: Tom Matano
role_zh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.

This model started the tradition that continues to this day.

When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.

It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的Civic。

也开启了延续至今的传统。

与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。

它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。

car: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
The Atenza has a dynamic and elegant design.

It reinterprets the classic sensuality of Italian sportscars
from the 1960s...

With a typically Japanese sensitivity to surfaces
and details.

A 4-door sedan-coupe layout...

Combined with a style inspired by Mazda Design's
'Kodo' philosophy.

Its soft, fluid shapes and evolving surfaces...

Are enhanced by specially developed metallic colours.

It's not by chance that Mazda cars are often
shown in red.

This is done to evoke a sort of fiery temperament
defined by emotion and movement.@
zh:
Atenza兼具动感和优雅的设计。

它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……

又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。

这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，

并融入了Mazda设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。

柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车漆进一步增强。

在Mazda的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。
>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。

car: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
speaker: Freeman Thomas
role_zh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.

This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.

What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!

First you notice the big rear wing...

...then the aggressive front flares.

The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!

The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.

You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.
zh:
Type R是一款风格激进的四门掀背轿跑车。

这一细分市场最初由VW Golf GTI炒热。

这款车的特别之处在于它就像一部充满特效的动作电影！

你会首先被巨大的尾翼吸引，

然后是战斗力十足的前轮宽体。

巨大的侧裙和引擎盖上的NACA导管映衬前脸！

外突的轮胎和特殊的悬挂让其拥有出色的车身姿态。

你还会注意到闪亮黑色轮毂后的大红色
Brembo刹车卡钳。它一点也不适合那些想低调的人！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.

Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.

The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.

It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。

事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！

最初被设计为农用机械的它……

于1948年正式量产。

眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。

相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。

作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。

car: Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special '98
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb,
held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb,
a race with more than a century of history.

Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was
the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.

So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was a driver named
Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.

A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven
straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win
the overall championship at Pikes Peak.
<
zh:
你知道在美国科罗拉多州每年举办的
世界海拔最高的登山赛吗？

正是拥有百年历史的派克峰国际爬坡赛！

Suzuki V6 Escudo这台仅有900公斤重的机械猛兽，
正是为赢得派克峰爬坡赛而生。

想要驯服这头狂暴怪兽，就需要一名怪兽级车手……

他便是有着“怪兽Tajima”名号的田岛伸博。

这位砂石路面的绝对统治者，曾七度蝉联
全日本砂道锦标赛冠军。

1995年，他更是成为首位在派克峰赛事中
斩获全场总冠军的日本车手。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Toyota C-HR is a world-famous compact SUV!

It’s perhaps best remembered for its performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in 2016.

I mean, who ever expected to see a C-HR variant
from TOYOTA GAZOO Racing tearing up the Ring?

Needless to say, it had a beautiful run
at the world’s toughest 24-hour race.

A car that looks great and is fast to boot—
What more could you want?
zh:
关于Toyota C-HR这台全球知名的紧凑型SUV，

最令人难忘的印象莫过于其在2016年
纽博格林24小时耐力赛上的表现。

说真的，谁能想到Toyota GAZOO车队打造的C-HR赛车
竟在纽博格林赛道上大放异彩呢？

更别说在世界上最严苛的24小时耐力赛中留下惊艳轨迹。

一台既有型格又具速度的车——你还能奢求什么呢？

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5
from 2001.

It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.

It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...

...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours
of Daytona.

Just a few months later, it secured a class
win at Le Mans...

...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.

Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!
zh:
这是一辆第五代Corvette——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。

对于Corvette而言，这是载入史册的年份。

基于C5打造的GT赛车“C5-R”

不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，

数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，

并在2002年成功卫冕！

这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的GT赛车之一。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.

With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.

Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.

And each was beautiful
in its own way!
zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代Civic。

这台搭载强劲引擎的Civic Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。

这一时期的Civic车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的Shuttle五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。

每款车型都绽放着独特的美！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Peugeot 205 is fondly remembered as a
best-selling compact car.

A perennial favorite, it enjoyed a 15-year production run
from 1983 to 1998...

...selling more than five million units, becoming the most
successful model in Peugeot’s history.

This GTI hot hatch is powered by a spirited engine and
delivers an exhilarating driving experience.

It shares its lineage with the iconic Turbo 16—a legendary
Group B rally homologation special.
{
zh:
Peugeot 205作为一款畅销紧凑型车而被人们铭记。

从1983投产到1998年的15年间，这款车持续常青，

全球销量更是突破500万台，创下Peugeot的销售记录。

这台GTI小钢炮不仅动力澎湃，
更拥有行云流水般的操控体验。

它与为B组拉力赛而生的传奇认证车型Turbo 16
更是同宗同源。

car: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Why, this is the Group A rally version of the Lancia Delta!
A real fan favorite!

Its legend dates back to 1987, the first year in which
the WRC title was contested under Group A regulations.

That inaugural season, the Lancia Delta HF won the opening
race at Monte Carlo.

And it went on to claim the manufacturers’ and drivers’ titles
in a spectacular double victory!

What’s more, it went on winning manufacturers’ titles until
1992—a six-year streak!

That year may have marked the final appearance of a Lancia works
team in the WRC.

But it also saw the introduction of the Delta HF Integrale,
which dominated the competition in speed and durability.

Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year
and proudly clinched Lancia its sixth consecutive title.
zh:
哇，这可是蓝旗亚Delta的A组别拉力赛版本！
车迷们的心头好！

这台车的传奇始于1987年，世界拉力锦标赛在那年
首次设立A组别。

首个赛季，蓝旗亚Delta HF便在蒙特卡洛揭幕战
旗开得胜……

并一路狂飙，达成斩获车厂和车手
双料冠军的壮举！

不仅如此，它更将车厂冠军头衔一直保持到了1992年
——成就六连冠伟业！

1992年是蓝旗亚车厂车队最后一次亮相
世界拉力锦标赛……

但同年问世的Delta HF Integrale依然在速度
和力量上力压群雄。.

从蒙特卡洛开始，它在那年赢得了八场比赛，
更荣耀地为蓝旗亚捧起六连冠奖杯。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!
zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？

这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。

然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。

尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。

这台车绝对值得一看！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan
of that car.

Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.

But then, in 2004, it came back…

When Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all
of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.

That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!

Apparently, development started on this project
back in 1999.

In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height
of its racing prowess!

To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this
is really a great honour!
zh:
还记得R34天际线GT-R吗？我是它的忠实粉丝。

遗憾的是，这台车在2003年退出了全日本GT锦标赛的舞台。

不过在随后的2004年，

日产自家厂队NISMO倾注其所有赛车技术打造出了
一款可以合法上路的GT-R，让它便重回大众视野……

没错，我说的就是NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune！

不难猜出，这一项目的开发工作早在1999年就开始了。

换句话说，开发在R34天际线GT-R还在
实力巅峰的时候就开始了！

能够如此近距离地观赏这样一台特别的GT-R，
真是莫大的荣幸！
*

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

以打造出结合诸多赛车技术的量产车而闻名。

2004年，为纪念成立20周年，Nismo推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。

在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。

如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！
]

car: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.

This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.

From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.

It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.

This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.

Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...

...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!
~
zh:
意大利的Lancia在很长一段时间里都是
世界拉力锦标赛统治级的存在。

这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其荣耀传承中的闪耀瑰宝。

从1987年到1992年，Lancia豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……

这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。

这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是Lancia成功的见证。

即便只是作为为了满足Gr.B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……

也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.

The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.

Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.

As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
zh:
Peugeot的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。

例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。

这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！

如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。

这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。

与其它Peugeot车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.

Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!

From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.

Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.

All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
zh:
一听到Citroën，我首先想到的就是这款BX。

有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？

而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问只会出自
意大利设计公司Bertone之手！

从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。

1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……

全系产量约达230万台！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.

This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...

...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。

这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。

它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.

The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.

Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.

But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.

And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?

It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!

It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.
|
zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……

日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。

该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。

也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。

至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……

还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的Toyota厂队！

驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE
is a genuine racer!

It has participated in one-make series across Japan.

Honda launched these events in 2014.

That means the N-ONE boasts over a decade of
racing heritage.

Cars competing in these no-holds-barred races had to be outfitted
with roll cages and a host of specialized racing components.

Just watching them take to the track in their colorful
liveries is pure joy!
zh:
相信我，这辆N-ONE是天生的极品赛车！

这款车曾经征战日本各地的单一车种比赛。

Honda从2014年开始举办这些赛事，这就意味着……

N-ONE参与赛车运动的历史已有十年之久！

参加此类无护栏赛事的赛车必须配备
防滚架和其他指定赛车配件。

光是看着这些身披五颜六色涂装的赛车进入赛场
就足够让人心潮澎湃！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.

This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.

A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.

Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of two short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.

No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shining achievement in Renault’s long history.
zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。

虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。

实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。

它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。

该车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。

这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。

难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.

Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.

After all, it was the first Renault to
feature front-wheel drive.

For a company that had built its reputation on
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...

...this marked a significant departure with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.

Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!

This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed global sales of more than 8 million units!
zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。

这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。

要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。

对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……

这确实是一个重大转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。

值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！

作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?

With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.

But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.

Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.

Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.

Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.

Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。

凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！

不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。

也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。

多年来，Renault推出了不少大名鼎鼎的
“工作用车”车型。

其中就包括1960年代Renault 4的商用版本。

还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代Renault 5打造的！

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.

This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”

Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”

The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for being unstoppable.

Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.

The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.

Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.

And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,�
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.

Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...

...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.
,
zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……

而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。

因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。

前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。

按理说，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……

然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。

这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。

因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……

但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the vehicle that effectively wrote
the first chapter of Japanese off-road history.

Released in 1960, the “40” marked the third-generation model.

In Japan, fans affectionately call it the “Yonmaru,” a nickname
drawn from the Japanese pronunciation of its model number.

A commercial vehicle built to haul goods in agriculture and
farming, it also served first-responders in times of emergency.

Above all else, it was created with one purpose in mind—
to be a true “working vehicle."

From its ladder-frame chassis to its suspension, every component
was engineered with durability in mind.

Well-built and dependable, it embodied all the qualities
that made the Land Cruiser a legend.

With an impressive production run that has lasted 24 years...

...this best-selling SUV has made the Land Cruiser a household name
all over the world.
zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是真正开创
日本越野历史的车型。

这款1960年发布的“40系”是第三代车型。

它被日本车迷亲切地称为“四丸”，
这个昵称源自其车型编号的日语发音。

作为旨在运输农业物资和进行紧急救援的商用车辆……

它的首要且最重要的设计目的是成为一款“工具车”。

从梯形车架底盘到悬挂系统，
每个部件都可谓为经久耐用而打造。

制造精良且可靠耐用，它完美体现了
Land Cruiser的所有优秀特质。

凭借长达24年的辉煌生产周期……

这款畅销车型让Land Cruiser之名
享誉全球，家喻户晓。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
On the centennial running of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2023...

...a mid-engine race car claimed a brilliant victory
in the GT AM class...

...an achievement that forever redefined the legacy of
America’s sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette.

Its name—the C8—marked it as the eighth generation of
the storied Corvette.

It was also the first production model to break from tradition,
abandoning the front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout...

...in favor of a mid-engine design transforming the
character of the car.

It proved to be a wise move, as the mid-engine Corvette has since
become a formidable presence in GT racing worldwide.
zh:
在2023年勒芒24小时耐力赛百年庆典之际……

这款中置引擎赛车在GT AM组别
取得了辉煌胜利……

极大地改变了“美国跑车”——Chevrolet Corvette的
历史进程。

“C8”彰显了它作为这款标志性车型
第八代产品的身份。

这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动
布局的量产Corvette……

它转而将引擎置于车身中部！

这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为众多GT赛事中不可小觑的力量。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994
at the Paris Motor Show.

More than 30 years have passed since then,
yet it remains as astonishing as ever.

Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...

...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the
1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.

It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.

At the time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo
in Formula 1 racing.

But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a
minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.

Although it never reached production, it remains a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.
zh:
Espace F1于1994年在巴黎国际车展首次亮相。

三十余年后的今天，这款车型依然令人叹为观止。

基于风靡全球的家用车型Renault Espace打造……

Espace F1搭载的Renault V10引擎
源自1992年F1冠军赛车，Williams车队的FW14B……

并依照赛车规格采用中置布局。

当时Renault和Williams堪称
一级方程式赛场的黄金组合。

但谁也未曾料想，他们竟会将F1引擎
植入一台家用MPV！这无疑是天马行空的创举。

虽未量产上市，此车始终是Renault品牌史上
璀璨夺目的传奇之作。@

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to
become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.

The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers
all over the world.

The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated
with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation
of the compact car.

The objective was a car combining intuitive handling
with cost-effective production.

Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro
came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...

...such as the economical use of flat glass
for all of the car's window surfaces.

Indeed, this masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks
of his inimitable genius!
zh:
自1980年问世以来，这款初代菲亚特Panda
以长达二十余年的生产周期成为常青车型。

作为极致简约却性能卓著的经典代表，
至今仍深受全球车迷喜爱。

初代Panda可谓是与世界级设计大师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗最具渊源的车型。

菲亚特将这款紧凑车型的换代设计全权委托于他。

设计计划书要求打造兼具直观操控体验
与亲民制造成本的车型。

凭借深厚的汽车设计造诣，
乔治亚罗采用创新方案解决了诸多难题……

诸如全车玻璃表面均采用成本更有优势的平板玻璃。

毫无疑问，这件杰作处处闪耀着
大师独一无二的设计智慧！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The year was 2023.

Ferrari claimed its first-ever overall victory at the
Nürburgring 24 Hours!

The machine that achieved this remarkable feat was none other
than the Ferrari 296 GT3.

It was a historic race, completed in a record 162 laps.

But the 296 GT3 didn’t just secure the overall win.

All three of the team’s entries finished the race,
a testament to their outstanding reliability.

In the months that followed, the 296 GT3 continued to dominate,
earning victories in endurance races across the globe!
zh:
时间来到2023年……

Ferrari在纽博格林24小时耐力赛斩获首个全场冠军！

缔造这一历史性突破的正是Ferrari 296 GT3。

这场载入史册的比赛以162圈创纪录完成。

但296 GT3的成就远不止于此。

三台参赛赛车全部顺利完赛，充分证明了其优异的可靠性。

此后，296 GT3更在全球耐力赛场上连战连捷！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.

It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.

On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.

Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...

...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!
zh:
Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。

其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。

要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。

虽然此车型未能在全日本GT锦标赛摘得桂冠……

但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.

This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!

Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.

Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!

This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.

Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。

它竟然是著名日本改装厂Mine’s出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！

Mine’s是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
Skyline GT-R改装厂商之一。

无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！

这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。

而在Mine’s众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.

Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."

I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
zh:
296 GTB是Ferrari最具标志性的GT3赛车。

其命名取自引擎的核心参数。

具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。

两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！

我听说，在1970至1990年间，
Ferrari还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。

具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...

...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!

You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it
than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several
road-going sports cars.

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance
electric vehicle brand.

So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
zh:
Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……

这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！

事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。

2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。

总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！
?

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...

...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.

Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.

And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?

That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!

Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.
zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……

ELANTRA N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。

直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！

谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？

在那场比赛中，ELANTRA N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！

此外，这也是Hyundai在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。
\

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Did you know that, along with its increased engine
displacement over the previous model...

...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first
GT3 R to feature a swan-neck rear wing?

For me, its defining accomplishment remains those unforgettable
back-to-back victories at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

Both came in the LMGT3 Class, which replaced
the LMGTE category in 2024.

In its debut year, it secured a superb class win under
conditions that were anything but forgiving.

Then it did it all over again the following year—a truly
remarkable achievement, wouldn’t you agree?
zh:
你知道吗？Porsche 911 GT3 R (992)不仅
排量比其前任大……

也是第一款采用天鹅颈式尾翼的GT3 R？

就我个人而言，它最令人难忘的成就，
是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中实现了两夺冠。

它在LMGT3组别（2024年取代LMGTE组别）中
取得了这一佳绩。

在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。

然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？
+

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
zh:
Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。

眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。

尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。

而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。

从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
Ah yes, the second-generation Renault Captur.

The C-shaped motif in the front and rear lights...

...is a signature element of Renault design.

Not only does this car looks sharp, it drives with confidence.
It’s easy to see why it became a bestselling compact SUV...

...across the European market.

The original Captur outsold its compact SUV rivals in European
markets year after year.

And this second-generation model, introduced in 2019,
proved just as popular.
zh:
没错，这正是第二代Renault Captur。

其前后灯组采用的C形设计元素……

乃是Renault品牌的标志性语言。

它不仅颜值出众，驾控感受同样可圈可点。

无怪乎它能成为欧洲市场最畅销的紧凑型跨界SUV。

初代Captur的年销量便已傲视同级，

而这台于2019年推出的第二代车型，
其热度更是丝毫未减！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
This Camaro 1969 Race-Mod is classic on the outside
and modern within.

In other words, it perfectly embodies the spirit of every
great restomod.

It’s based on the legendary Camaro Z28, which was built
to compete in the popular Trans-Am Series of the 1960s.

Now the Camaro Z28 returns as an original custom car,
courtesy of Gran Turismo.

Built to sit lower on the ground, this car is equipped
with a special bumper and a host of new aero parts.

Meanwhile, the back features a large ducktail spoiler
and centre exit exhaust.

As for its engine, it runs on a mighty supercharged V8!

Now�I want to see it in action!
*
zh:
这辆科迈罗1969 Race-Mod，虽然保留了经典外观，
内里却焕然一新。

可以说，它完美诠释了修复改装车的顶尖水准。

此车的原型车是传奇的科迈罗Z28，
为了征战1960年代风靡一时的泛美房车锦标赛而生。

如今，科迈罗Z28以一款原创定制车的身份荣耀回归，
由《跑车浪漫旅》倾情呈现。

车身姿态经过精心调校，更为低趴，并配备了
专属前保险杠与大量全新空气动力学套件。

车尾则装有一个醒目的大型鸭尾式扰流板，
并采用中置排气布局。

至于它的心脏，则是一台动力磅礴的机械增压V8引擎！

现在，我真想一睹它在赛道上飞驰的风采！

speaker: Fabio Filippini
role_zh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
en:
Of all the 911’s countless evolutions, the 964 Turbo S
stands out for its exceptionally muscular, pure design.

To bring out its sculptural form...

The entire car is draped in a single hue, from its nose
to its 'whale tail' wing.

And its flared fenders and 18-inch aluminium cup wheels
complete the look.

But if you ask me...

Its most iconic detail is found in the rear fender
air intakes based on those of the Porsche 959!
zh:
在911漫长的进化历程中，964 Turbo S
以其极具力量感的纯粹设计独树一帜。

为了彰显此车雕塑般的形体美……

全车从车头到标志性的“鲸鱼尾”尾翼，
都采用了始终如一的配色。

宽体翼子板和18英寸的铝制赛车轮毂，
更是将这份视觉张力推向了极致。

如果你要问我哪处细节最有代表性……

还得是后翼子板上的进气口，
这正是传承自Porsche 959的独特设计！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
With its frog-eyed expression and compact body,
this first-generation Twingo is simply adorable!

Unexpectedly spacious inside, its seats can be reclined
to a full-flat position.

Say, do you know how it got its funny name?

It’s a play on three dance styles—the twist, swing,
and tango.

The Twingo had some limited-edition models
created in collaboration with fashion brands.

The 1993 model, this first-generation gem is a rare prize
for collectors!
zh:
蛙眼大灯和小巧的车身，第一代Twingo就是那么可爱！

它的内部空间出乎意料的宽裕，
座位甚至可以做到完全放平。

对了，你知道这个奇奇怪怪的名字是怎么来的吗？

它其实是三种舞蹈名称的变化组合——Twist（扭扭舞）、
Swing（摇摆舞）与Tango（探戈）。

Twingo还曾与多个时尚品牌联名推出限量特别版。

这款1993年的初代车型，
如今早已成为收藏家们竞相追捧的珍品！

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.

The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!

With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.

The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。

作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！

四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。

这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The 1999 Le Mans 24 Hours was one of those races
that stays with you.

Factory teams from the world’s biggest automakers arrived with
everything to prove, fighting for victory in an all-out war.

When the checkered flag fell, it was BMW’s V12 LMR prototype
that stood above them all.

It was BMW’s first overall win at the legendary 24-hour classic.

Now, some 20 years later, BMW has returned to the top category
with a machine built for the modern era...

...with this BMW M Hybrid V8!

The car made its presence felt, scoring a 1-2 finish at the 10th
round of the 2024 IMSA SportsCar Championship in Indianapolis...

It also took a hypercar class victory in
the World Endurance Championship.

There’s no doubt about it:
This machine has proven it belongs on the world stage.
zh:
1999年的勒芒24小时耐力赛堪称经典之战。

全球各大顶尖汽车制造商的厂队使出浑身解数，
全力角逐总冠军的殊荣。

而最终登顶的则是宝马的V12 LMR原型车。

这也是宝马首次登顶这一传奇的24小时耐力赛。

时隔二十余年，这一德系劲旅宣布重返顶级组别行列……

携宝马M Hybrid V8强势归来！

这台车在2024年国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第10站
印第安纳波利斯分站中强势包揽冠亚军，

还在世界耐力锦标赛中斩获超级跑车组别冠军。

毫无疑问，这台竞速机器已然在世界舞台证明了自身实力。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Ferrari 499P is the kind of machine built for the history books.
Who could forget its stunning run at Le Mans in 2023?

On the grand stage of the race’s historic centenary...

...Ferrari returned to the top flight after a 50-year absence.

Just imagine coming back on a milestone year like that.
The pressure must have been enormous!

And yet, in an all-out fight against opponents all chasing
the coveted overall championship title...

...it was the No. 51 Ferrari 499P that rose above them all.

The first overall victory for Ferrari in 58 years wasn't just a win,
it was one of the great comeback in motorsports history!
zh:
法拉利499P是一台注定载入史册的终极跑车，
它在2023年勒芒比赛上的惊艳表现至今让人难以忘怀。

在这项赛事迎来百年纪念的盛大赛场上，

法拉利暌违五十载后强势回归最高组别赛场。

想想便知——选择在这样一个极具纪念意义的年份复出……
压力绝对超乎寻常。

然而，在各路强敌全力以赴争夺总冠军的激烈鏖战中……

51号法拉利499P成功杀出重围夺得冠军。

这是法拉利时隔58年再度登顶勒芒总冠军。
这场胜利意义非凡，成就了一段王者归来的传奇篇章。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
Of all the race cars born from the Le Mans Hypercar regulations...

...the Peugeot 9X8 may be the most
distinctive of them all.

Its wingless concept made headlines
when it made its debut in 2021.

And that bold approach may have helped it briefly take the lead
during an especially wet and grueling Le Mans in 2023.

In 2024, the car underwent a major evolution, gaining an all-new
rear wing and a more conventional aerodynamic package.

A top-tier contender in the WEC, this is a machine
that never fails to make an impression.
zh:
在众多遵循勒芒终极跑车组别规则打造的赛车中……

Peugeot 9X8的设计最为独树一帜。

其“无尾翼”的设计理念在2021年首次亮相时便引发热议……

甚至在2023年雨水肆虐、赛程艰苦的勒芒赛场上，
一度助它领跑全场。

2024年这款赛车迎来重大升级，正式加装全新尾翼。

作为WEC赛场上的顶尖强者，这台车总能惊艳全场。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in
the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.

Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won
the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca,
Watkins Glen, and Road America...

Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers'
Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself
as a podium fixture...

Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece
of endurance racing!
zh:
Porsche 963是IMSA与WEC最高组别中的实力劲旅，

在IMSA赛场上的战绩尤其斐然。

征战2024年IMSA GTP赛事期间，
963一举拿下戴通纳24小时耐力赛揭幕战冠军。

随后又接连斩获拉古纳-塞卡赛道、
沃特金斯峡谷国际赛道与美国之路赛道的分站冠军……

最终包揽车厂与车手年度总冠军。

而在WEC赛场上，它也是领奖台的常客……

由此逐步奠定了它在耐力赛中当代经典神车的地位。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.

Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.

Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.

This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine
wwith a featherweight 500kg body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.

For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match the Superlight R500.
zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。

这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。

虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……

但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。

这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的500kg车身中，

搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。

其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。

它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。

毫无疑问，对于追求赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。

speaker: Chris
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
en:
The Toyota Mark II is widely regarded as one of Japan’s
most iconic luxury sedans.

Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable
36-year run spanning nine generations.

The original 1968 model was known
as the Corona Mark II.

The name suggested a larger, more luxurious
version of Toyota’s popular Corona sedan.

When the fifth-generation model arrived in 1984, the Corona
name was dropped in favor of Toyota Mark II.

This particular car is an eighth-generation Mark II.

More specifically, it is the highly sought-after Tourer V.

Under the hood is Toyota’s legendary turbocharged
1JZ-GTE inline-6.

What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement
of a luxury sedan with high performance.
zh:
丰田Mark II作为日本最经典的豪华轿车之一，可谓久负盛名。

从1968年到2004年，这款车的生产持续了足足36年，
期间一共迭代了九代。

1968年生产的初版车型
被命名为“Corona Mark II”。

“Mark II”代表它是丰田的
日常代步轿车车型Corona的豪华版。

在该系列于1984年发布第5代车型时，
其名称不再包含“Corona”标识，而是直接命名为“丰田Mark II”。

这里的这台是第8代的Mark II。

也就是车迷圈子中炙手可热、一车难求的Tourer V。

它所搭载的，正是丰田大名鼎鼎的
1JZ-GTE直列6缸涡轮增压引擎。

这款车的独特之处，便是将精致的豪华车设计
与生猛的动力进行了无缝的融合。

speaker: Jeremy
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
en:
The Mark II, Chaser and Cresta were known as
the three brothers of Toyota’s luxury-sedan lineup.

This sixth-generation Chaser earned particular fame
through its success in Japanese touring-car racing...

...most notably during the 1998 Japanese Touring Car
Championship.

By then, Honda and Nissan had withdrawn their factory teams
from the once fiercely contested series.

Although the 1998 season largely became
an all-Toyota affair...

Masanori Sekiya drove the ESSO TOM’S Chaser
to six victories in 11 races.

And he claimed the drivers’ championship.

The JTCC came to an end following
the 1998 season.

That made the Chaser’s championship victory
a fitting conclusion to an important era.
zh:
“Mark II”、“Chaser”和“Cresta”是丰田旗下
豪华轿车产品阵容的三兄弟。

这款第6代Chaser因其在日本房车赛中的傲人成绩而独负盛名……

特别是它在1998年日本房车锦标赛中的惊艳表现。

此前的一年，对手本田和日产
同时率旗下厂队退出了这一传奇赛事。

虽然这使得1998年赛季几乎变成了丰田的单一车种系列赛……

但关谷正德驾驶ESSO TOM'S Chaser发挥出色，
赢得了11场比赛中的6场……

并拿下了冠军。

全日本房车锦标赛组别的比赛正是在那个1998年赛季宣告终止。

因此，第6代Chaser获得的历史性胜利就更显得弥足珍贵。

speaker: Stella
role_zh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
en:
There's a lot to love about the Hyundai IONIQ 6 N.

But what I love most of all is its streamlined design.

In a fascinating nod to automotive history...

Its aerodynamic form mirrors the legendary
design trends...

That defined the industry throughout the 1930s and '40s.

Of course, bearing the iconic 'N' badge
means its performance is beyond question.

Capable of effortlessly pumping out 600 horsepower,
this is one electric sports car that doesn't disappoint!
[
zh:
Hyundai IONIQ 6 N一直广受车迷的青睐。

但我最喜欢的还是它流线型的设计。

它的设计可以说是对汽车发展史的精彩致敬……

其空气动力学造型反映了二十世纪30年代到40年代……

定义整个汽车行业的那股传奇潮流。

当然还有那标志性的“N”字品牌标识
代表了它毋庸质疑的性能。

这款电动跑车能轻松输出600马力，绝对不会让你失望！
